original: iti śrutireva atra pramāṇam | icchati, jānāti, prayatate iti sarvakāryasya ātmanaḥ ātmamanassaṃyogasya kāraṇatvaṃ pratītam | atassarvaviṣayabhoktṛtvaṃ jīvātmana upalabdheḥ | tasmātparamātmanā'nubhūyata ityāha--bhuṅkte iti |
analyzed: iti śrutiḥ eva atra pramāṇam icchati jānāti prayatate iti sarva kāryasya ātmanaḥ ātma manaḥ saṃyogasya kāraṇa tvam pratītam atas sarva viṣaya bhoktṛ tvam jīvātmanaḥ upalabdheḥ tasmāt paramātmanā anubhūyate iti āha bhuṅkte iti

original: svaprakāśarūpaḥ paramātmā saccidānaṃdānubhavaviṣayavāniti tātparyam | satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahmeti satyānantajñānaṃ svaviṣayānandātmanaḥ paramātmā |
analyzed: sva prakāśa rūpaḥ paramātmā saccidānaṃda anubhava viṣayavān iti tātparyam satyam jñānam anantam brahma iti satya ananta jñānam sva viṣaya ānanda ātmanaḥ paramātmā

original: nanu ekassakalaviṣayabhogānbhuṅkte | bhogāḥ karmādhīnāḥ | jīvasya karmabhoktṛtvaṃ vidhiriti vyaktavye sati upasthitaviṣayabhoktṛtvaṃ jīvasya, paramātmanassarvaviṣayabhoktṛtvaṃ bhāsate, sarvajñatvāt | ubhayoḥ karmabhoktṛtvaṃ prasaktamityasvarasādāha--anya iti |
analyzed: nanu ekaḥ sakala viṣaya bhogān bhuṅkte bhogāḥ karma adhīnāḥ jīvasya karma bhoktṛ tvam vidhiḥ iti vyaktavye sati upasthita viṣaya bhoktṛ tvam jīvasya paramātmanaḥ sarva viṣaya bhoktṛ tvam bhāsate sarvajñatvāt ubhayoḥ karma bhoktṛ tvam prasaktam iti asvarasāt āha anye iti
anyaḥ karma bhuṅkte

original: anyo jīvātmā karmādhikārī san svakarmādhīnaviṣayabhogān bhuṅkta ityarthaḥ | sukarmaṇā sukhapradānaviṣayaphalaṃ bhuṅkte | duṣṭakarmaṇā duḥkhaviṣayakaphalaṃ bhuṅkte | bhogasya sukhaduḥkhātmakatvāt | sukhaduḥkhānubhavo bhogaḥ jīvasya lakṣaṇaṃ pratibhāsitam | jīvasya sakalaviṣayānubhavatvaṃ prasajyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: anyaḥ jīvātmā karma adhikārī san sva karma adhīna viṣaya bhogān bhuṅkte iti arthaḥ su karmaṇā sukha pradāna viṣaya phalam bhuṅkte duṣṭa karmaṇā duḥkha viṣayaka phalam bhuṅkte bhogasya sukha duḥkha ātmaka tvāt sukha duḥkha anubhavaḥ bhogaḥ jīvasya lakṣaṇam pratibhāsitam jīvasya sakala viṣaya anubhava tvam prasajyate iti arthaḥ

original: duṣṭakarmajaṃ śarīre sati satkarmaiva sadā kuryādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: duṣṭa karma jam śarīre sati sat karma eva sadā kuryāt iti arthaḥ

original: paramātmanaḥ satkarmaviṣayakakarmakaraṇatvaṃ vidhiḥ | īśvarasyāpi yatkiṃcinkarmajanakakarmādhikāritvaṃ prasaktamityasvarasādāha--ya iti |
analyzed: paramātmanaḥ sat karma viṣayaka karma karaṇa tvam vidhiḥ īśvarasya api yat kiṃcid karma janaka karma adhikāri tvam prasaktam iti asvarasāt āhayaḥ iti

original: rājasatāmasaphalapradahetukadravyādanajātasukhaduḥkhaphalaṃ ahaṃkāraviśiṣṭakarmādhikāriṇaḥ prayacchata iti | sākṣātkarmaṇaḥ phalāvaśyaṃbhāvanigamādityata āha-- karteti |
analyzed: rājasa tāmasa phala prada hetuka dravya adana jāta sukha duḥkha phalam ahaṃkāra viśiṣṭa karma adhikāriṇaḥ prayacchate iti sākṣāt karmaṇaḥ phala avaśyaṃbhāva nigamāt iti atas āha kartā iti
kartā śarīrī

original: yāvatkarmakartā śarīrī atra kartā bhavatītyarthaḥ | yatkiṃcitphalamuddiśya yaḥ karma karoti sa śarīrītyuktam | śarīrābhāvādātmana anna danatvaṃ na yogyamityasvarasādāha-- aśarīrīti |
analyzed: yāvat karma kartā śarīrī atra kartā bhavati iti arthaḥ yat kiṃcid phalam uddiśya yaḥ karma karoti sa śarīrī iti uktam śarīra abhāvāt ātmanaḥ dana tvam na yogyam iti asvarasāt āha aśarīrī iti
aśarīrī na annam atti

original: karmaphalayoḥ kāryakāraṇatvaṃ niyamena annādanatvam | svakarmānukūlaphalaṃ labhyate | taccharīriṇaḥ sa phalaṃ prayacchatīti bhāvaḥ | aharaharmanuṣyā aśanamicchanti | pratyahamaśanārthaṃ loke tatphalopayogi karma cetkṛtaṃ tatra phalābhāvo na daśyate | tatrāpi śarīramasti | tasmāt karmaphalayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo nāstītyāha neti |
analyzed: karma phalayoḥ kārya kāraṇa tvam niyamena anna adana tvam sva karma anukūla phalam labhyate tat śarīriṇaḥ sa phalam prayacchati iti bhāvaḥ ahar ahar manuṣyāḥ aśanam icchanti pratyaham aśana artham loke tad phala upayogi karma ced kṛtam tatra phala abhāvaḥ na daśyate tatra api śarīram asti tasmāt karma phalayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na asti iti āha na iti
na kevalam śarīram bhoga yogyam ātmanaḥ yogāt

original: prathamataḥ śarīrotpattikālaḥ tajjanmāntarasaṃskārādeva bālakādīnāṃ stanyapānādiphalaṃ prayacchatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: prathamatas śarīra utpatti kālaḥ tad janma antara saṃskārāt eva bālaka ādīnām stanya pāna ādi phalam prayacchati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bālakādīnāmapi śarīramasti, tatra karma na kṛtaṃ, teṣāmayogyatvāt | stanyapānādiphalaṃ mātrā dīyate | tasmātkarmaphalayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo vaktuṃ na śakyata ityata āha-- bhogayogyamiti | tadānīṃ dṛṣṭakarmābhāve'pi janmāntarakarmakaraṇaṃ kalpyate, śarīravattvādātmanaḥ |
analyzed: nanu bālaka ādīnām api śarīram asti tatra karma na kṛtam teṣām ayogya tvāt stanya pāna ādi phalam mātrā dīyate tasmāt karma phalayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vaktum na śakyate iti atas āha bhoga yogyam iti tadānīm dṛṣṭa karma abhāve pi janma antara karma karaṇam kalpyate śarīravat tvāt ātmanaḥ

original: śarīradhāraṇasyocitatvādeva bālakādīnāṃ stanyapānādikaṃ mātrā dīyate iti cenna | śarīradhāraṇādīnāṃ janmāntarakarmahetuphalatvaṃ kalpyate | ātmanaśśarīravattvāt ātmanaśśarīradhāraṇasyocitatvāt ātmasaṃyogakāraṇabhūtasya śarīriṇo bhogāyatanatvaṃ jīvasya pratītam | tasmāccharīrādhiṣṭhānayogyatvaṃ nānyasyetyata āha-- ajāviti |
analyzed: śarīra dhāraṇasya ucita tvāt eva bālaka ādīnām stanya pāna ādikam mātrā dīyate iti ced na śarīra dhāraṇa ādīnām janma antara karma hetu phala tvam kalpyate ātmanaḥ śarīravat tvāt ātmanaḥ śarīra dhāraṇasya ucita tvāt ātma saṃyoga kāraṇa bhūtasya śarīriṇaḥ bhoga āyatana tvam jīvasya pratītam tasmāt śarīra adhiṣṭhāna yogya tvam na anyasya iti atas āha ajau iti
ajau hi adhiṣṭhitau

original: na jāyata ityajaḥ| tau jīvātmaparamātmānau śarīrādhiṣṭhitāvityarthaḥ | ghaṭajñānavānahamiti yasya pratītistasyaiva viṣayānubhavatvaṃ anayoranyatarasya sambhavatītyarthaḥ | ata āha--anya iti |
analyzed: na jāyate iti ajaḥ tau jīvātma paramātmānau śarīra dhiṣṭhitau iti arthaḥ ghaṭa jñānavān aham iti yasya pratītiḥ tasya eva viṣaya anubhava tvam anayoḥ anyatarasya sambhavati iti arthaḥ atas āha anyaḥ iti
anyā unnamatti 25

original: śarīrāṅgāni indriyāṇi, aṅgī śarīrī | jīvātmana indriyagocaraviṣayānubhavārthaṃ tadaṅgabhūtendriyāṇi saṃsṛjya jānāti, icchati, prayatate, ityetatpratyayānyathānupapattyā jīvātmā annamaśnute | tadvyatiriktātmanā kiṃ tadanubhūyata ityāśaṅkāyāmāha-- anattīti |
analyzed: śarīra aṅgāni indriyāṇi aṅgī śarīrī jīvātmanaḥ indriya gocara viṣaya anubhava artham tad aṅga bhūta indriyāṇi saṃsṛjya jānāti icchati prayatate iti etad pratyaya anyathā anupapattyā jīvātmā annam aśnute tad vyatirikta ātmanā kim tat anubhūyate iti āśaṅkāyām āha anatti iti
anatti evam anyaḥ

original: anyasya paramātmanaḥ sarvaviṣayānubhavatvaṃ prasiddhamiti anyasya phalenāviśiṣṭatvāt etādṛśārthaphalaṃ anatti svayaṃ svaprakāśātmakatvāt svayamevānubhavatītyarthaḥ |

original: śarīre sati sarvaviṣayabhogārhatvamātmanā sampāditamityāhetyarthaḥ | śarīriṇaḥ kānyaṅgāni ? pañcendriyāṇāmapyaṅgatvaṃ pradipāditam | manasa agocaratvena manaso'ntarindriyatvena ṣaḍityupadiṣṭam | ṣaṇṇāmātmano bhogaviṣayaprāpakahetubhūtārthatvāt | tasmāccharīrasya bhogayogyatvamiti svata eva siddhatvāt |

original: viṣayavijñānamindriyādhīnaṃ, indriyāṇi ca śarīrādhiṣṭhitāni | sarvaviṣayāḥ śarīrādhīnā ityarthaḥ |

original: nanu pravṛttirdvividhā iṣṭaprāptyarthamaniṣṭaparihārārthaṃ ceti | svādhiṣṭhānānubhūtaśarīraṃ saṃrakṣaṇīyamityekā pravṛttiḥ | sā dvividhā pravṛttirātmana upapadyate |

original: tatkathaṃ śarīrāṅgabhūtāni pañcendriyāṇi ? taddvārā iṣṭaprāptirūpakalaṃ kathaṃ labhyate ? aniṣṭaparihāradvārā iṣṭaprāptirūpaphalamapi labhyate ? aniṣṭaparihāradvārā ubhayaphalaṃ śarīriṇo bhāvyamityata āha-- aṣṭeti |
analyzed: tat katham śarīra aṅga bhūtāni pañca indriyāṇi tad dvārā iṣṭa prāpti rūpa kalam katham labhyate aniṣṭa parihāra dvārā iṣṭa prāpti rūpa phalam api labhyate aniṣṭa parihāra dvārā ubhaya phalam śarīriṇaḥ bhāvyam iti atas āha aṣṭa iti

aṣṭāvaṅgāni tasya āhuḥ cikitsā yeṣu saṃśritā

original: śarīropadravakāryakāraṇībhūtavyādhaya aupādhikabhūtāḥ vātapittakaphaprakupitahetukadhātavo'pi na pravardhanta iti aṣṭarogāṇāṃ aṅgatvaṃ pratipāditam | śarīrāṇāmetādṛśā vyādhayaḥ | teṣāṃ dhātūnāmaṅgatvaṃ pratipāditam | saptadhātumayaṃ śarīramiti aṅgopadravakārakavyādhīnā paramparayā aṅgatvaṃ pratipāditamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: śarīra upadrava kārya kāraṇībhūta vyādhayaḥ aupādhika bhūtāḥ vāta pitta kapha prakupita hetuka dhātavaḥ api na pravardhante iti aṣṭa rogāṇām aṅga tvam pratipāditam śarīrāṇām etādṛśāḥ vyādhayaḥ teṣām dhātūnām aṅga tvam pratipāditam sapta dhātu mayam śarīram iti aṅga upadrava kāraka vyādhīnā paramparayā aṅga tvam pratipāditam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu dhātupravardhakadravyāṇāmaṅgatvaṃ vakta'vyaṃ cet tathā sukaramiti dhātuvināśakārakāṇāṃ śarīranāśakānāṃ aṅgatvaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cenna, śarīrābhāvakāryasya vyādhīnāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu dhātu pravardhaka dravyāṇām aṅga tvam vaktavyam ced tathā sukaram iti dhātu vināśa kārakāṇām śarīra nāśakānām aṅga tvam katham syāt iti ced na śarīra abhāva kāryasya vyādhīnām kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya vaktum śakya tvāt iti arthaḥ
śarīra vināśa hetu bhūtānām aṣṭa rogāṇām lakṣaṇa pramāṇe vyapadiśati yāvat iti
yāvatkṛti vidheḥ kāyaḥ

original: yāvannidānajñānaviṣayakajñānajanyasādhakībhūtanivartakānāṃ kṛtiḥ kāryo nivartyaḥ | tatraitayoḥ yāvadvidhiḥ yāvacchāstroktakarmasahiṣṇutvaṃ yasya nivartakaṃ bhavati sa eva kāya iti upadeśaḥ | atra sūtravacanam--

śarīra jānām doṣāṇām krameṇa parama auṣadham

original: śarīratvāvacchedena kāyabālaśarīrasyāpyekatvena krameṇa paramauṣadhamiti kāyabālacikitsābhedena vivakṣitatvātkramaśabdārtho vivakṣitaḥ | nanu kāyabālāmayau āmahetujanyāmaroganivartakasāmagryāṃ satyāṃ tajjanyaroganivṛtterdṛṣṭatvāt tajjātāmayau kāyabāleti pratipāditau | tadanyajātarogā grahā grahajātarogāḥ | teṣāṃ kā gātirityāśayavānāha-- āmeti |
analyzed: śarīra tva avacchedena kāya bāla śarīrasya api ekatvena krameṇa parama auṣadham iti kāya bāla cikitsā bhedena vivakṣita tvāt krama śabda arthaḥ vivakṣitaḥ nanu kāya bāla āmayau āma hetu janya āma roga nivartaka sāmagryām satyām tad janya roga nivṛtteḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt tad jāta āmayau kāya bāla iti pratipāditau tad anya jāta rogāḥ grahāḥ graha jāta rogāḥ teṣām kā gātiḥ iti āśayavān āha āma iti
āma ja āmaya kārya hetuka citta kṣobha bhaya nigraha vigrahaḥ grahaḥ

original: atra kecit-- āmajanyā vyādhayaḥ | teṣāṃ kiṃcitsāmagrīprayuktakarma tatra bheṣajam | grahābhibhūtāmayānāṃ āmanivṛttikarmakaraṇasyāyogyatvāt, atra tannivartakasāmagryā ananubhūtatvāt, śāstrataḥ adṛṣṭatvācca | tasmādetatsūtramayuktamiti vadantaṃ prati parihartukāmassūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe-- āmeti |
analyzed: atra kecid āma janyāḥ vyādhayaḥ teṣām kiṃcid sāmagrī prayukta karma tatra bheṣajam graha abhibhūta āmayānām āma nivṛtti karma karaṇasya ayogya tvāt atra tad nivartaka sāmagryāḥ ananubhūta tvāt śāstrataḥ adṛṣṭa tvāt ca tasmāt etat sūtram ayuktam iti vadantam prati parihartu kāmaḥ sūtram vyācaṣṭe āma iti

original: tadroganivartakatadgrahanigraharūpaṃ tatra bheṣajam | mantratantrabalipradānādayo nivartakāḥ | graheṣvanuguṇeṣvekadoṣamārgā grahajanyādirujo'pi balidānamantratantrādyaiḥ nivartanaiḥ nivartayituṃ sukhena śakyā bhavantītyarthaḥ | tatra sāmagrīgraharūpamantratantraiḥ bhayanigraho bhavati | āmahetukasāmagrījanyarogābhāvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad roga nivartaka tad graha nigraha rūpam tatra bheṣajam mantra tantra bali pradāna ādayaḥ nivartakāḥ graheṣu anuguṇeṣu eka doṣa mārgāḥ graha janya ādi rujaḥ api bali dāna mantra tantra ādyaiḥ nivartanaiḥ nivartayitum sukhena śakyāḥ bhavanti iti arthaḥ tatra sāmagrī graha rūpa mantra tantraiḥ bhaya nigrahaḥ bhavati āma hetuka sāmagrī janya roga abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: ūrdhvāṅgajātā anekarogāḥ pūrvoktaprakāranivartakā nivartyāḥ te ūdhvāṅgajātarogā bahavo dṛṣṭāḥ | tannidānametadbhinnaviṣayakam, etannidānasyāpi tadbhinnaviṣayakatvāt | karṇanetraśironāsikājihvāsthitapavanapittaprakopakārakāḥ taddhetukāryāhetukāryahetubhūtāmayāḥ kāraṇajanyāḥ ityūrdhvāṅgarogānviśinaṣṭi-- āmeti |
analyzed: ūrdhva aṅga jātāḥ aneka rogāḥ pūrva ukta prakāra nivartakāḥ nivartyāḥ te ūdhva aṅga jāta rogāḥ bahavaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ tad nidānam etad bhinna viṣayakam etad nidānasya api tad bhinna viṣayaka tvāt karṇa netra śiraḥ nāsikā jihvā sthita pavana pitta prakopa kārakāḥ tad hetu kārya ahetu kārya hetu bhūta āmayāḥ kāraṇa janyāḥ iti ūrdhva aṅga rogān viśinaṣṭi āma iti
āma ja āmaya kārya hetuka anya hetuka āmaya nivartakāḥ apūrva aṅga hetukāḥ
pūrva kāya hetuka jāta roga kārya hetuka sāmagrī janya hetu pratipādanāt uttara kāya adhiṣṭhita roga pratipādaka āma jāta roga kārya hetu sthitāḥ nivartakaiḥ nivartayitum yogyāḥ bhavanti iti arthaḥ

original: recakalaṅghanābhyāṃ nivartayitumayogyā ityāśaṅkya tadāmayānāṃ tannivartakāḥ prakāśyante-- doṣeti |

analyzed: śarīra mātram sarvatra sirā āvṛtam tathā asthīni sandhayaḥ ca āśayāḥ ca sarvaiḥ ebhiḥ āvṛtam śarīram iti tat sarvam bhūta mayam mātuḥ eva utpadyante iti arthaḥ doṣāḥ sirā āvṛtāḥ marma gatāḥ āśaya sthāḥ ca ete svastha doṣa mārgāḥ anya svastha dhātūn praviśanti

original: svasthāsvasthadoṣavijñānārthaṃ sarvaśarīraṃ vibhajya tattajjñānaṃ vijñāya doṣaprakopānapahartuṃ śakyata evetyarthaḥ | śarīrasthitasirādīnvibhajati |
analyzed: svastha asvastha doṣa vijñāna artham sarva śarīram vibhajya tat tat jñānam vijñāya doṣa prakopān apahartum śakyate eva iti arthaḥ śarīra sthita sirā ādīn vibhajati

original: nanu saptadhātudharāssaptatvaṃ ca pavanasaptatvaṃ cāśritam | antaḥpraviṣṭassvāduraso bhūtvā'nilaprakopaṃ haratīti yattadayuktaṃ, dhātupoṣakakāryopakārakatvenānyathāsiddhatvāt | tvagantasstharasāsṛgādayo yathāvidhi mārge sañcārīkṛtāḥ | pavanaprakopasya nivārakatvaṃ svādurasasya kathaṃ bhavedityasvarasādāha-- sapteti |
analyzed: nanu sapta dhātu dharāḥ saptatvam ca pavana saptatvam ca āśritam antar praviṣṭaḥ svādu rasaḥ bhūtvā anila prakopam harati iti yat tat ayuktam dhātu poṣaka kārya upakāraka tvena anyathā siddha tvāt tvac antar stha rasa asṛj ādayaḥ yathāvidhi mārge sañcārīkṛtāḥ pavana prakopasya nivāraka tvam svādu rasasya katham bhavet iti asvarasāt āha sapta iti
sapta dhātu dharāḥ sapta āśayāḥ tad madhya ga grahaṇī kalā jātaḥ svādu rasaḥ anila prakopam harati 3

original: asyārthaḥ–- saptatvacaḥ saptadhātūndadhati | rasaraktādyapi anilasañcārādyathāmārgamanatikramya sthitasthāpakatvamanila eva harati | tasya tāvanmātropakārakaguṇatvāt svādurasaḥ anilaprakopaṃ haratīti yattadyuktamitārthaḥ | gatāgatakalopakārakatvaṃ anila eva karoti | tasmādanilaprakopanivṛttyarthaṃ svādurasadravyādanaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: asya arthaḥ sapta tvacaḥ sapta dhātūn dadhati rasa rakta ādi api anila sañcārāt yathāmārgam an atikramya sthita sthāpaka tvam anilaḥ eva harati tasya tāvat mātra upakāraka guṇa tvāt svādu rasaḥ anila prakopam harati iti yat tat yuktam itārthaḥ gata āgata kalā upakāraka tvam anilaḥ eva karoti tasmāt anila prakopa nivṛtti artham svādu rasa dravya adanam yuktam iti arthaḥ

uraḥ sthānam udānasya nāsā nābhi galān caret

original: iti | etadvacanānusāreṇa sarvaśarīravyāpakatvamanilasya | tasmātsvādurasaḥ anilakopaṃ haratītyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: iti etad vacana anusāreṇa sarva śarīra vyāpaka tvam anilasya tasmāt svādu rasaḥ anila kopam harati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu etādṛśāśayānāṃ sarvaśarīrāntassthitatvasya sārvajanīnatvena tattatkāryopalambhakatvaṃ yathāvidhi coditamiti saptāśayāssaptadhātumantaḥ sarvasādhāraṇatvāt | tathā sati eṣvāśayeṣu prajājananadeśaṃ nirṇītumaśakyatvāt, kiṃ ca saptatvaksirādhātvāśayābhivardhanaṃ pañcapācakapittānilajātasvāduraso'nilaprakopamapaharatu |
analyzed: nanu etādṛśa āśayānām sarva śarīra antar sthitatvasya sārvajanīna tvena tad tad kārya upalambhaka tvam yathāvidhi coditam iti sapta āśayāḥ sapta dhātumantaḥ sarva sādhāraṇa tvāt tathā sati eṣu āśayeṣu prajā janana deśam nirṇītum aśakya tvāt kim ca sapta tvak sirā dhātu āśaya abhivardhanam pañca pācaka pitta anila jāta svādu rasa unila prakopam apaharatu

original: tasya rogārogaikakāraṇatvaṃ sarvaśarīrāṇāṃ suprasiddhamiti tātparyaṃ manasi nidhāya prajājananahetupradeśaṃ vivṛṇoti-- aṣṭeti |
analyzed: tasya roga aroga eka kāraṇa tvam sarva śarīrāṇām su prasiddham iti tātparyam manasi nidhāya prajā janana hetu pradeśam vivṛṇoti aṣṭa iti
aṣṭamaḥ garbhāśayaḥ strīṇām

original: prajājananahetukāśayaḥ strīṇāmeva sambhāvya ityarthaḥ | tatra śārīravacanaṃ--
analyzed: prajā janana hetuka āśayaḥ strīṇām eva sambhāvyaḥ iti arthaḥ tatra śārīra vacanam
garbhāśaya uṣṭamaḥ strīṇām pitta pakvāśaya antare

original: saptāśayātiriktaṃ pittapakvāśayāntaraṃ netareṣu sambhāvitamiti garbhādhānahetukatvaṃ strīṇāmeva sambhāvitatvāt | ata eva prathamataḥ strīṇāṃ nāmoccāraṇānantaraṃ puṃnāmoccāraṇamiti sakalaśāstreṣu śreṣṭhakramo'stīti vyapadeśitam | ādau strīpuruṣayordhātureva yonyāṃ praviśya janayati | tathā sati dhātumelanameva piṇḍaṃ bhavet |
analyzed: sapta āśaya atiriktam pitta pakvāśaya antaram na itareṣu sambhāvitam iti garbhādhāna hetuka tvam strīṇām eva sambhāvita tvāt atas eva prathamatas strīṇām nāma uccāraṇa anantaram puṃnāma uccāraṇam iti sakala śāstreṣu śreṣṭha kramaḥ asti iti vyapadeśitam ādau strī puruṣayoḥ dhātuḥ eva yonyām praviśya janayati tathā sati dhātu melanam eva piṇḍam bhavet

original: yāvatkāraṇaṃ tāvatkāryamiti nyāyāt | idānīmaṅgajananakā ryadarśanasya hetvabhāvo dṛśyate | kāraṇena vinā kathaṃ kāryotpattirityasvarasādāha-- svamiti |
analyzed: yāvat kāraṇam tāvat kāryam iti nyāyāt idānīm aṅga janana kārya darśanasya hetu abhāvaḥ dṛśyate kāraṇena vinā katham kārya utpattiḥ iti asvarasāt āha svam iti

original: svaṃ svaṃ svoṣmaṇā sravadrasātmaṃ caujaḥ | svaṃ svaṃ svasya svayameva heturbhavati || 5 ||
analyzed: svam svam sva oṣmaṇā sravat rasa ātmam ca ojaḥ svam svam svasya svayam eva hetuḥ bhavati

original: svāṅgāni svasminneva prajāḥ prajāyante, anyathā tadanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sukhaduḥkhe kathamupapadyete | anyajananasya tadanvayavyatireke sati sukhaduḥkhānubhavo'stītyata itarajanane svaśarīrameva kāraṇamiti | tatra kāvyavacanaṃ--
analyzed: sva aṅgāni svasmin eva prajāḥ prajāyante anyathā tad anvaya vyatirekābhyām sukha duḥkhe katham upapadyete anya jananasya tad anvaya vyatireke sati sukha duḥkha anubhavaḥ asti iti atas itara janane sva śarīram eva kāraṇam iti tatra kāvya vacanam
ātmānam ātmanā vetsi sṛjasi ātmānam ātmanā
ātmanā kṛtinā ca tvam ātmanā eva pralīyase

original: ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradāṃ śatam ||
analyzed: ātmā vai putra nāmā asi sa jīva śaradām śatam

original: garbhāśayagatoṣmaṇā mātuḥ pittasāraḥ stravati | tatsārajanyassāraḥ śirautpādako bhavati | tadrasātmakaṃ caujo bhavati | garbhāśayagatoṣmaṇā mātuḥ pāṇiḥ sravati | tatsārajanyo rasaḥ pāṇyutpādako bhavati | garbhāśayagatoṣmaṇā mātuḥ pādasārassravati | tatsārajanyasāraḥ pādotpādako bhavati | evaṃ pārśvau ca |
analyzed: garbhāśaya gata ūṣmaṇā mātuḥ pitta sāraḥ sravati tad sāra janyaḥ sāraḥ śiraḥ utpādakaḥ bhavati tad rasa ātmakam ca ojaḥ bhavati garbhāśaya gata ūṣmaṇā mātuḥ pāṇiḥ sravati tad sāra janyaḥ rasaḥ pāṇi utpādakaḥ bhavati garbhāśaya gata ūṣmaṇā mātuḥ pāda sāraḥ sravati tad sāra janya sāraḥ pāda utpādakaḥ bhavati evam pārśvau ca

original: pṛṣṭhodarajaṅghaśiśnopasthapāyvaṅgādīni garbhāśayagatoṣmaṇā māturaṅgāni eṣu sravanti | tatsārajanyasārāṇi tadutpādakāni bhavanti | māturāhārarasāhārāstadvyatiriktāṅgābhivardhakāḥ | tānyaṅgāni raktabhūtāni santi | tattadaṅgeṣu vāyuḥ prakupyate | tatpavanakopanivṛttyarthaṃ svādurasavaddravyam, tannivartanadvārā bheṣajaṃ svādurasamaśnīyāt ||
analyzed: pṛṣṭha udara jaṅgha śiśna upastha pāyu aṅga ādīni garbhāśaya gata ūṣmaṇā mātuḥ aṅgāni eṣu sravanti tad sāra janya sārāṇi tad utpādakāni bhavanti mātuḥ āhāra rasa āhārāḥ tad vyatirikta aṅga abhivardhakāḥ tāni aṅgāni rakta bhūtāni santi tad tad aṅgeṣu vāyuḥ prakupyate tad pavana kopa nivṛtti artham svādu rasavat dravyam tad nivartana dvārā bheṣajam svādu rasam aśnīyāt
atha jñāpana artham tad utpādakāni aṅgāni āha śiraḥ iti
śiraḥ pāṇi pāda pārśva pṛṣṭha ūru udara jaṅgha śiśna upastha pāyu aṅgāni bhavanti

original: etāni māturgarbhāśaye sravanti | tattadaṅgānyāvirbhavantītyarthaḥ | te rasā garbhāśayamukhaṃ puṣṇantītyarthaḥ | garbhāśayagatoṣmaṇā mātuḥ pādapārśvapṛṣṭhodarajaṅghaśiśnopasthebhyassārāsravanti | tatsārajanyasārāḥ pārśvādyaṅgotpādakāḥ | tadrasātmakaṃ caujo bhavati | antarvatnyāḥ śiromāṃsāśayānāṃ sārasya garbhe srāvitatvāt |
analyzed: etāni mātuḥ garbhāśaye sravanti tad tad aṅgāni āvirbhavanti iti arthaḥ te rasāḥ garbhāśaya mukham puṣṇanti iti arthaḥ garbhāśaya gata ūṣmaṇā mātuḥ pāda pārśva pṛṣṭha udara jaṅgha śiśna upasthebhyaḥ sārāḥ sravanti tad sāra janya sārāḥ pārśva ādi aṅga utpādakāḥ tad rasa ātmakam ca ojaḥ bhavati antarvatnyāḥ śiraḥ māṃsa āśayānām sārasya garbhe srāvita tvāt

original: garbhāśaye pavanaprakopasya yuktatvāt, tadarthaṃ svādu rasavaddravyamadyāt | aṅgāvirbhāvānantaraṃ śrotratvakcakṣurjihvāghrāṇānāmatikṣatvāt tattatsthitāni tattatsthānaṃ vihāya garbhāśayaṃ praveṣṭumayogyatvāt śrotrādīnāmāvirbhāvaḥ kathaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- śrotreti ||
analyzed: garbhāśaye pavana prakopasya yukta tvāt tad artham svādu rasavat dravya madyāt aṅga āvirbhāva anantaram śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇānām tad tad sthitāni tad tad sthānam vihāya garbhāśayam praveṣṭum ayogya tvāt śrotra ādīnām āvirbhāvaḥ katham syāt iti asvarasāt āha śrotra iti
śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇāḥ tathā

original: sarvendriyāṇi sūkṣmaśarīrāṇyapi mātussvaśarīrasthitapañcabhūtānāṃ garbhāśaye upalabhyamānatvāt | indriyādīnāṃ tattadguṇatvādeva guṇinamantareṇa guṇāvasthānasya vaktumayogyatvāt tattadbhūtapraveśanāttattadindriyasahitā eva garbhāśayaṃ praviśantītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sarva indriyāṇi sūkṣmaśarīrāṇi api mātuḥ sva śarīra sthita pañcabhūtānām garbhāśaye upalabhyamāna tvāt indriya ādīnām tad tad guṇa tvāt eva guṇinam antareṇa guṇa avasthānasya vaktum ayogya tvāt tad tad bhūta praveśanāt tad tad indriya sahitāḥ eva garbhāśayam praviśanti iti arthaḥ

original: dhātvādīnāṃ sāradravyatvena svaṃ svaṃ svoṣmaṇā sravattattadākṛtikāryahetukamātṛdhātusrāvitāvayavo garbhāśaye kuṇapāvayavābhivṛddhihetukakāryaṃ rasāvakāśavadbhavatīti tasmāttayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo vaktuṃ śakyate | atra tu nirākṛti dravyaṃ sarandhrakaṃ kathamanyatra praveṣṭuṃ śakyate ? śiraḥpāṇyādivatsāvayavadravyatvābhāvāt sāvakāśapraveśānavakāśaḥ |
analyzed: dhātu ādīnām sāra dravya tvena svam svam sva ūṣmaṇā sravat tad tad ākṛti kārya hetuka mātṛ dhātu srāvita avayavaḥ garbhāśaye kuṇapa avayava abhivṛddhi hetuka kāryam rasa avakāśa vat bhavati iti tasmāt tayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vaktum śakyate atra tu nirākṛti dravyam sarandhrakam katham anyatra praveṣṭum śakyate śiraḥ pāṇi ādi vat sa avayava dravya tva abhāvāt sa avakāśa praveśa anavakāśaḥ

original: idaṃ tu niravayavadravyaṃ svamātṛsthāvayavasāraṃ garbhāśaye sravatīti vaktumaśakyamityasvarasādāha-- sarandhreti |
analyzed: idam tu niravayava dravyam sva mātṛ stha avayava sāram garbhāśaye sravati iti vaktum aśakyam iti asvarasāt āha sa randhra iti
sa randhraka abhyantara dharāḥ trayaḥ trayaḥ sirāḥ pādayoḥ catustriṃśat sarandhraka abhyantara dharāḥ
asya arthaḥ

original: kāścidabhyantaradharāḥ kāścitsarandhrakāḥ ekaikaśastrisirāvṛtāḥ | sāvakāśadravyasya vyāpyākāśatvena śarīrasya paścabhūtātmakatvena ākāśadravyasyāpi tatpraviṣṭatvāt tasya tritrisirāvṛtadravyatvāt garbhāśaye srāvayituṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | atra tritrisiravṛtāḥ sarandhrakābhyantaradharāḥ saptaśatasaṅkhyākāḥ pādamastakādhiṣṭhitā ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kāścid abhyantara dharāḥ kāścid sarandhrakāḥ ekaikaśas tri sirā āvṛtāḥ sa avakāśa dravyasya vyāpya ākāśa tvena śarīrasya paścabhūta ātmaka tvena ākāśa dravyasya api tad praviṣṭa tvāt tasya tri tri sirā āvṛta dravya tvāt garbhāśaye srāvayitum yuktam iti arthaḥ atra tri tri sira vṛtāḥ sarandhraka abhyantara dharāḥ saptaśata saṅkhyākāḥ pāda mastaka adhiṣṭhitāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: mātṛgarbhāśaye tadaṅgāni tatraiva sravantītyuktam | tadeva vivṛṇoti-- pādeti | pādayugmasthitapadmaṃ garbhāśaye srāvitatvāt tatpādayugamajāyata | avarṇadvayamapi tatraivājāyata | tadanantaraṃ mātṛjānusthitatrisirāvṛtaṃ ca mātṛgarbhāśaye kuṇapapiṇḍarūpasyāvirbhāve kathaṃ nu māturaṅgasāra eva tatrāvirbhavatītyata āha-- pādeti |
analyzed: mātṛ garbhāśaye tad aṅgāni tatra eva sravanti iti uktam tat eva vivṛṇoti pāda iti pāda yugma sthita padmam garbhāśaye srāvita tvāt tat pāda yugam ajāyata avarṇa dvayam api tatra eva ajāyata tad anantaram mātṛ jānu sthita tri sirā vṛtam ca mātṛ garbhāśaye kuṇapa piṇḍa rūpasya āvirbhāve katham nu mātuḥ aṅga sāraḥ eva tatra āvirbhavati iti atas āha pāda iti
pāda sthita padmam avarṇa janakam catustriṃśat sirā āvṛtam

original: māturaṅgabhūtapādaṃ svaṃ svaṃ svoṣmaṇā sravadrasātmakasarandhrakābhyantaraṃ catustriṃśatsirāvṛtaṃ tatpādasthitāvarṇaṃ vāmapāde svaritaplutasahitāvarṇātmakaṃ pādayugamajāyatetyarthaḥ | tadūrdhvāṅgaṃ jānuyugaṃ svaṃ svaṃ svoṣmaṇā sravadrasātmakamajāyatetyāha--jānviti |
analyzed: mātuḥ aṅga bhūta pādam svam svam sva ūṣmaṇā sravat rasa ātmaka sarandhraka abhyantaram catustriṃśat sirā āvṛtam tad pāda sthita avarṇam vāma pāde svarita pluta sahita avarṇa ātmakam pāda yugam ajāyata iti arthaḥ tad ūrdhva aṅgam jānu yugam svam svam sva ūṣmaṇā sravat rasa ātmakam ajāyata iti āha jānu iti
jānu padma gatam iva arṇa janakam catustriṃśat sirā āvṛtam
sa randhraka abhyantara dhara catustriṃśat sirā āvṛtam vāma itara jānu yugam garbhāśaye srāvitam tat jānu yugam ajāyata iti arthaḥ

gata āgata karma upakāraka varṇa prayukta vāta pitta kapha doṣa āśraya dravya adanena avikṛtāḥ santaḥ gata āgata karma upakāraka jaṅghā deśa gata padmam sarandhraka abhyantara viṃśati sirā āvṛtam jānu padmam ajāyata iti āha uvarṇa iti
u varṇa ātmakam ūrum pradeśa padmam viṃśati sirā āvṛtam

original: svaritaplutasahitovarṇajaṅghāpadmaṃ svaṃ svaṃ svoṣmaṇā sravedrasātmakaṃ garbhāśaye āvirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: svarita pluta sahita uvarṇa jaṅghā padmam svam svam sva ūṣmaṇā sravet rasa ātmakam garbhāśaye āvirbhavati iti arthaḥ

original: śroṇipradeśasthitasarandhrakābhyantaradharāśritarvarṇajñāpakamūrupradeśapadmaṃ svaṃ svaṃ svoṣmaṇā sravadrasātmakaṃ dṛśyata ityāha-- ṛvarṇeti |
analyzed: śroṇi pradeśa sthita sarandhraka abhyantara dharā āśrita ṛvarṇa jñāpakam ūru pradeśa padmam svam svam sva ūṣmaṇā sravat rasa ātmakam dṛśyate iti āha ṛvarṇa iti
ṛvarṇa janakam śroṇi pradeśa padmam viṃśati sirā vṛtam

original: ṛvarṇahetukamūrupradeśapadmaṃ viṃśatisirāvṛtaṃ svaritaplutasahitarvarṇādhārabhūtaṃ pācakapittoṣmabhirviṃśatisirāvṛtaṃ vāmetarorupadmaṃ gatāgatakarmopakārakabahubhārajaṃ māturaṅgādeva garbhāśaye āvirbhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ṛvarṇa hetukam ūru pradeśa padmam viṃśati sirā āvṛtam svarita pluta sahita ṛ varṇa ādhāra bhūtam pācaka pitta ūṣmabhiḥ viṃśati sirā āvṛtam vāmetara ūru padmam gata āgata karma upakāraka bahu bhāra jam mātuḥ aṅgāt eva garbhāśaye āvirbhavati iti arthaḥ
lṛ varṇa jñāpakam śroṇi pradeśa padmam tathā eva ajāyata iti āha lṛ varṇa iti

analyzed: iti ukta tvāt yena kena prakāreṇa tat nivartanam kārayet id iti arthaḥ śrotra upalabdha varṇa ātmaka śabdaḥ sirā anya doṣa gati kriyā janya hetu vat anya ahetuka tve sati tad hetu janya tvāt ghaṭa vat etad anumānena sarva varṇa ātmaka śabdānām sirā anya doṣa gati kriyā janya tvam bhāsate trayāṇām kāraṇa tvam saṅghe saṅghe śaktiḥ na tu ekaikasya iti pratipāditam

original: nanu sirāṇāṃ śarīrayantradhāraṇaprayojakakāryahetukatvaṃ brūmaḥ | saśabdotpādakakāryahetubhūtatvasya anyathāsiddhatvāt | doṣagatiprakopena ca rogasambhavāt | tathā hi viruddharasādanādajīrṇe sati yāvatkāraṇādhikyajātāḥ tattadrogakāryahetukāḥ saśabdopalambhakānyahetukāḥ |
analyzed: nanu sirāṇām śarīra yantra dhāraṇa prayojaka kārya hetuka tvam brūmaḥ sa śabda utpādaka kārya hetu bhūta tvasya anyathā siddha tvāt doṣa gati prakopena ca roga sambhavāt tathā hi viruddha rasa adanāt ajīrṇe sati yāvat kāraṇa ādhikya jātāḥ tad tad roga kārya hetukāḥ sa śabda upalambhaka anya hetukāḥ

original: tattadroganivṛtyarthaṃ tattatpradeśasirāgatāsṛgvimocanena tattaddhetubhūtaroganivartanasya dṛṣṭatvāt | sirānyagatarogasya tanniṣṭhāsṛgvimocananivartakakāryasya kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sūcyate | karaṇasya kriyāviśeṣavailakṣaṇyamātrapratipādakatvāt | tatra vacanam--
analyzed: tad tad roga nivṛti artham tad tad pradeśa sirā gata asṛj vimocanena tad tad hetu bhūta roga nivartanasya dṛṣṭa tvāt sirā nya gata rogasya tad niṣṭha asṛj vimocana nivartaka kāryasya kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sūcyate karaṇasya kriyā viśeṣa vailakṣaṇya mātra pratipādaka tvāt tatra vacanam
sirā vidhiḥ śalya vidhiḥ śastra kṣāra agnikarma ca

original: iti | sūtravacanasya sirāsṛgvimocanarūpakāryapratipādakatvācca na te śabdajanyakāryahetukā iti | atrocyate-- viruddharasādanājjātaroganidānabhūtalakṣaṇāttattatsirāprabodhakavarṇaniṣṭhavikāraviruddhasvarāghoṣavarṇātmakāni liṅgāni vijñāya tattadroganivṛttyarthaṃ tattatsirāgataduṣṭaraktavimocanamātra eva caritārthatvāt |
analyzed: iti sūtra vacanasya sirā asṛj vimocana rūpa kārya pratipādaka tvāt ca na te śabda janya kārya hetukāḥ iti atra ucyate viruddha rasa adanāt jāta roga nidāna bhūta lakṣaṇāt tad tad sirā prabodhaka varṇa niṣṭha vikāra viruddha svara aghoṣa varṇa ātmakāni liṅgāni vijñāya tad tad roga nivṛtti artham tad tad sirā gata duṣṭa rakta vimocana mātre eva caritārtha tvāt
tasmāt na anyathā asiddhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu varṇaprabodhakasirāḥ saptaśatasaṅkhyākāḥ | tā eva marmasthānabhūtāḥ āvedhyā ityuktam | yatra yatra vikāre jāte tattatpradeśasthitasirāsṛgvimocanaṃ kartavyamityuktam |
analyzed: nanu varṇa prabodhaka sirāḥ sapta śata saṅkhyākāḥ tāḥ eva marma sthāna bhūtāḥ āvedhyāḥ iti uktam yatra yatra vikāre jāte tad tad pradeśa sthita sirā asṛj vimocanam kartavyam iti uktam
śiraḥ netra vikāreṣu lalāṭyām mocayet sirām

original: ityādivacanāni bahūni santi | tattadvacanānusāreṇa tattatpradeśasthitasirā vedhyāḥ | vedhārhasirāṇāmavedhakatvapratipādanaparaṃ sirāsyasūtraṃ vyarthaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- rikteti |
analyzed: ityādi vacanāni bahūni santi tad tad vacana anusāreṇa tad tad pradeśa sthita sirāḥ vedhyāḥ vedha arha sirāṇām avedhaka tva pratipādana param sirā āsya sūtram vyartham syāt iti asvarasāt āha rikta iti
rikta atirikta ati pūrṇāḥ sirāḥ na vedhyāḥ
riktāḥ sirāḥ hrasva varṇa uccāraṇa hetu bhūtāḥ atiriktāḥ sirāḥ dīrgha varṇa uccāraṇa hetu bhūtāḥ atipūrṇāḥ svarāḥ svarita pluta varṇa uccāraṇa hetu bhūtāḥ

original: nanu tatra saptaśatasirāṇāṃ madhye aṣṭāśītisirā varṇotpādakahetubhūtāḥ hrasvasaṃyogoccāraṇahetubhūtatattadvedhavijñānaviṣayakajñānaviṣayānubhavapramāpadavṛttinimittakāḥ susvarāḥ aṣṭāśītisirājanyapadaviṣayakapravṛttihetubhūtatvāt | tā na vedhyā iti brumaḥ | hrasvavarṇānāmadhomukhāssirāḥ tajjanakahetubhūtāḥ sirā riktāḥ |
analyzed: nanu tatra sapta śata sirāṇām madhye aṣṭāśīti sirāḥ varṇa utpādaka hetu bhūtāḥ hrasva saṃyoga uccāraṇa hetu bhūta tad tad vedha vijñāna viṣayaka jñāna viṣaya anubhava pramā pada vṛtti nimittakāḥ su svarāḥ aṣṭāśīti sirā janya pada viṣayaka pravṛtti hetu bhūta tvāt tāḥ na vedhyāḥ iti brumaḥ hrasva varṇānām adhomukhāḥ sirāḥ tad janaka hetu bhūtāḥ sirāḥ riktāḥ

original: atiriktāssirāḥ saṃsargavarṇotpādakavakramārgagāḥ | atipūrṇāḥ sirā gatāgatodbodhakapravartakapavanagatakāryānukūlasusvarāḥ plutāśca | tāsāṃ karaṇatvaṃ pratipāditam | karaṇasya kriyāviśeṣavailakṣaṇyadyotakakāryahetubhūtatvāt | saptaśatasirāṇāṃ madhye aṣṭānavatisirāḥ sarandhrakābhyantaradharāḥ | tā eva riktātiriktātipūrṇāssirā na vedhyāḥ |
analyzed: atiriktāḥ sirāḥ saṃsarga varṇa utpādaka vakra mārga gāḥ ati pūrṇāḥ sirāḥ gata āgata udbodhaka pravartaka pavana gata kārya anukūla su svarāḥ plutāḥ ca tāsām karaṇa tvam pratipāditam karaṇasya kriyā viśeṣa vailakṣaṇya dyotaka kārya hetu bhūta tvāt saptaśata sirāṇām madhye aṣṭānavati sirāḥ sarandhraka abhyantara dharāḥ tāḥ eva rikta atirikta ati pūrṇāḥ sirāḥ na vedhyāḥ

original: kasya ciddehabhedena aṣṭānavatisirāḥ | kāścitsarandhrakābhyantaradharāḥ | sarveṣāmekaprakārakavarṇotpādakavarṇasamūhapadajanyavākyānāṃ tattaccharīrāvacchedadarśanāt | saptaśatasirāṇāṃ madhye tādṛśā eva notpādakā iti vyavacchettuṃ vaktumaśakyatvāt |
analyzed: kasya cit dehabhedena aṣṭānavati sirāḥ kāścid sarandhraka abhyantara dharāḥ sarveṣām eka prakāraka varṇa utpādaka varṇa samūha pada janya vākyānām tad tad śarīra avaccheda darśanāt sapta śata sirāṇām madhye tādṛśāḥ eva na utpādakāḥ iti vyavacchettum vaktum aśakya tvāt

original: tattaccharīrarūpavicitrasvaraśabdajñānaviṣayakaḥ ātmā pratiśarīraṃ bhinnaḥ sukhaduḥkhādivaicitryādibhedenopalabhyamānatvāt, śabdasvaravicitravarṇāṅgabhedadravyaguṇādhārakatvāt | tasmātparodbodhakatvasarvavarṇapradātmakānāṃ te vaicitryopalambhakatvāt | saptaśatasirāṇāṃ avedhakatvaṃ vaktuṃ vidheyāḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ bhedodbodhakāḥ |
analyzed: tad tad śarīra rūpa vicitra svara śabda jñāna viṣayakaḥ ātmā pratiśarīram bhinnaḥ sukha duḥkha ādi vaicitrya ādi bhedena upalabhyamāna tvāt śabda svara vicitra varṇa aṅga bheda dravya guṇa ādhāraka tvāt tasmāt para udbodhaka tva sarva varṇa prada ātmakānām te vaicitrya upalambhaka tvāt sapta śata sirāṇām avedhaka tvam vaktum vidheyāḥ sarva varṇānām bheda udbodhakāḥ
tasmāt sapta śata sirāṇām adhomukha tvam pratipāditam iti arthaḥ
dhanvantariḥ tu trīṇi āha sandhīnām ca śata dvayam
etat vacanam ārabhya na hi dhanvantari mate
tad adhiṣṭhānam annasya grahaṇāt grahaṇī matā
sā eva dhanvantari mate kalā pitta dhara āhvayā

original: etāvatpratipāditārthaṃ sadvarṇātmakapadārthapravṛttiviṣayakajñānagocarajñānakāryodbodhakasirāḥ saptaśatasaṅkhyākāḥ tā na vedhyā iti jñāpanārthaṃ "saiva dhanvantarimate" iti śārīre pratipāditam |
analyzed: etāvat pratipādita artham sat varṇa ātmaka padārtha pravṛtti viṣayaka jñāna gocara jñāna kārya udbodhaka sirāḥ saptaśata saṅkhyākāḥ tāḥ na vedhyāḥ iti jñāpana artham sā eva dhanvantari mate iti śārīre pratipāditam

original: tadevāyurvedapratipāditārthamidamiti vivicya darśanāt 'saiva' ityuktam āmapittaṃ paktvā pācakakalā suprasannā satī tadadhiṣṭhānavarṇānāṃ jñāpakatvāt grahaṇītyabhidhīyate | aviruddharasadravyādanājjātakalā prabalā satī suvarṇasusvarasupadasuvākyabodhikā | karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnākāśasya etena āyurārogyatejodhātupratipādikā bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva āyurveda pratipādita artham idam iti vivicya darśanāt sā eva iti uktam āma pittam paktvā pācaka kalā su prasannā satī tad adhiṣṭhāna varṇānām jñāpaka tvāt grahaṇī iti abhidhīyate aviruddha rasa dravya adanāt jāta kalā prabalā satī suvarṇa su svara su pada su vākya bodhikā karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinna ākāśasya etena āyuḥ ārogya tejaḥ dhātu pratipādikā bhavati iti arthaḥ
atra sūtra vacanam
unmārga gāḥ yantra nipīḍanena
sva sthānam āyānti punar na yāvat
doṣāḥ praduṣṭāḥ rudhiram prapannā
tāvat hita āhāra vihāra bhāj syāt
na ati uṣṇa śītam laghu dīpanīyam rakta upanīte hitam anna pānam
tadā śarīram hi anavasthita asram agniḥ viśeṣāt iti rakṣaṇīyaḥ

original: savyādhinidānahetubhūtasya śabdoccāraṇādavagamya tadvyādhividhiriti jñānamupalabhya cikitsāṃ kārayediti | yadyantassthitavikāraṃ śabdoccāraṇādeva jñātvā sādhyavidhiṃ vijñāya kārayediti tātparyam | svarāsvaraṃ jīrṇahetukasirābhibodhakakāryaṃ duṣṭāsṛgvimocanadvārā sirāyā hetutvaṃ pratipāditamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sa vyādhi nidāna hetu bhūtasya śabda uccāraṇāt avagamya tad vyādhi vidhiḥ iti jñānam upalabhya cikitsām kārayet iti yadi antar sthita vikāram śabda uccāraṇāt eva jñātvā sādhya vidhim vijñāya kārayet iti tātparyam svara asvaram jīrṇa hetuka sirā abhibodhaka kāryam duṣṭa asṛj vimocana dvārā sirāyāḥ hetu tvam pratipāditam iti arthaḥ

original: riktātiriktā tipūrṇasirāṇāmavedhyatvajñāpakaṃ yādṛśānāṃ svarūpajñāne sati vaktuṃ śakyate tatprayojanamapi tathā | tasmānmarmāśayamajñātvā tanniṣeddhumaśakyamityasvarasādāha-- tā iti |
analyzed: rikta atiriktā ati pūrṇa sirāṇām avedhya tva jñāpakam yādṛśānām svarūpa jñāne sati vaktum śakyate tad prayojanam api tathā tasmāt marma āśayam a jñātvā tat niṣeddhum aśakyam iti asvarasāt āha tāḥ iti
tāḥ sirāḥ marma āśaya gāḥ riktāḥ

original: randhrasañcāre pavanasya yogādhārakatvāt sarandhrakāyasirāvacchedanena doṣaprakopo bhavati | tā na vedhyāḥ | yā sirā atiriktābhyantaradharadoṣasañcārārthaṃ avakāśābhāvadravyatvāt sarandhrā satī antarindriyaṃ bhūtvā vartate sā sirā na vedhyā marmasthānatadguṇahetubhūtatvāt | tatprayojanaṃ yāvadvarṇamātroccāraṇaṃ tadanvayādhīnam |
analyzed: randhra sañcāre pavanasya yoga ādhāraka tvāt sarandhra kāya sirā avacchedanena doṣa prakopaḥ bhavati tāḥ na vedhyāḥ yā sirā atirikta abhyantara dhara doṣa sañcāra artham avakāśa abhāva dravya tvāt sarandhrā satī antar indriyam bhūtvā vartate sā sirā na vedhyā marma sthāna tad guṇa hetu bhūta tvāt tad prayojanam yāvat varṇa mātra uccāraṇam tad anvaya adhīnam

original: tāssirā na vedhyāḥ | atipūrṇāssarvakāleṣu pavanapūritarandhreṣu doṣasaṃcārahetubhūtāḥ śrotrākāśasya svabhedaprāpyopakārakāḥ tāśca marmāśayagā ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tāḥ sirāḥ na vedhyāḥ ati pūrṇāḥ sarva kāleṣu pavana pūrita randhreṣu doṣa saṃcāra hetu bhūtāḥ śrotra ākāśasya sva bheda prāpya upakārakāḥ tāḥ ca marma āśaya gāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu aṣṭanavatisirāṇāṃ madhye yatra yatra sthāne yatsirāśritavarṇadoṣaḥ pradṛśyate, kiṃ ca virasādanājjātagrahaṇīkalādaurbalyena tatrasthitavarṇadoṣaḥ gamanāgamanamārganirodhātpavanādiṣu vikāraśca pradṛśyate, tatra tattadvarṇotpādakasirāśrayasthaleṣu tattaddhetubhūtarasavirasajātarogāḥ prāpnuvanti |
analyzed: nanu aṣṭanavati sirāṇām madhye yatra yatra sthāne yat sirā āśrita varṇa doṣaḥ pradṛśyate kim ca virasa adanāt jāta grahaṇī kalā daurbalyena tatra sthita varṇa doṣaḥ gamana āgamana mārga nirodhāt pavana ādiṣu vikāraḥ ca pradṛśyate tatra tad tad varṇa utpādaka sirā āśraya sthaleṣu tad tad hetu bhūta rasa virasa jāta rogāḥ prāpnuvanti

original: śiro'sthivikāreṣu satsu śirorogā iti vyavahriyante | sirāvikāreṣu netradeśeṣu satsu, tatrāyaṃ netrarogavāniti vyavahriyate | karṇadeśasthitasirāvikāreṣu satsu karṇarogavāniti vyavahriyate |
analyzed: śiraḥ sthi vikāreṣu satsu śiraḥ rogāḥ iti vyavahriyante sirā vikāreṣu netra deśeṣu satsu tatra ayam netra rogavān iti vyavahriyate karṇa deśa sthita sirā vikāreṣu satsu karṇa rogavān iti vyavahriyate

original: tattatsirādhiṣṭhānasthitadoṣādayaḥ virasādanajātagrahaṇīkalādaurbalye tattadadhiṣṭhānasthitasirāmārgagamanābhāvajātarogāḥ gamanāgamanakṣobhavaśāt tattatsthānasthitasirāvikārān prāpnuvanti | tattadvikārān tāvatsirā eva bodhayanti |
analyzed: tad tad sirā adhiṣṭhāna sthita doṣa ādayaḥ virasa adana jāta grahaṇī kalā daurbalye tad tad adhiṣṭhāna sthita sirā mārga gamana abhāva jāta rogāḥ gamana āgamana kṣobha vaśāt tad tad sthāna sthita sirā vikārān prāpnuvanti tad tad vikārān tāvat sirāḥ eva bodhayanti

tad tad pradeśa adhiṣṭhita tvāt tad tad deśa upādhinā śirāḥ roga netra roga karṇa roga mukha roga nāsikā roga jihvā roga kaṇṭha roga bāhu roga hṛd kukṣi roga ajīrṇa agni māndya ādi roga gulma roga meha roga grahaṇī atisāra arśaḥ roga śvāsa roga romarāji pradeśa udbhava śobha pāṇḍu roga aṇḍa jāta roga jaṃghā jānu roga śroṇi kaṭi pradeśa utthita roga bodhaka sirāḥ eva tad tad pradeśeṣu

original: vyādhīnsaṃsṛjya tattatpadeśasthitasirā eva vyādhīn jñāpayituṃ pavanagatyā tāvatsirā eva tattadvyādhilakṣaṇāni vijñāpayanti | tattadrogahetubhūtavirasādanāt kalādaurbalyāt āmaprakope sati tattadrasābhivardhakarasā eva tattadroganirvartakā ityāśayaṃ manasi nidhāya "tāssirā marmāśayagāḥ" ityāha |
analyzed: vyādhīn saṃsṛjya tad tad padeśa sthita sirāḥ eva vyādhīn jñāpayitum pavana gatyā tāvat sirāḥ eva tad tad vyādhi lakṣaṇāni vijñāpayanti tad tad roga hetu bhūta virasa adanāt kalā daurbalyāt āma prakope sati tad tad rasa abhivardhaka rasāḥ eva tad tad roga nirvartakāḥ iti āśayam manasi nidhāya tāḥ sirāḥ marma āśaya gāḥ iti āha

original: nanu aṣṭanavatisirāssaptaśatasirā riktātiriktātipūrṇāssirā na vedhyā iti pratipāditam | idānīṃ sarvarogeṣu tattadvidhicoditasirāgatāsṛgvimocanameva roganivartakasāmagrīti tatkāryāpekṣitatvāt vedhārhasirāṇāṃ pratipādanaṃ yuktam | tāssirāḥ kīdṛśāḥ ? tadjñānānantaraṃ tatpratipādakaṃ tadeva jñātumāvaśyakamityasvarasādāha--sireti |
analyzed: nanu aṣṭanavati sirāḥ saptaśata sirāḥ rikta atirikta atipūrṇāḥ sirāḥ na vedhyāḥ iti pratipāditam idānīm sarva rogeṣu tad tad vidhi codita sirā gata asṛj vimocanam eva roga nivartaka sāmagrī iti tad kārya apekṣita tvāt vedha arha sirāṇām pratipādanam yuktam tāḥ sirāḥ kīdṛśāḥ tad jñāna anantaram tad pratipādakam tat eva jñātum āvaśyakam iti asvarasāt āha sirā iti
sirā asṛj vibhāga vidhim jñātvā vimocayet

original: sirāgatāsṛgvimocanamātravidhiḥ | kāścidavedhyāḥ | tasmāt vedhyāvedhyatvapratipādanakarmaṇaḥ prastutatvāt tattatsirāgatāsṛggatakāryasya tatsirāgatāsṛggatarogasya nivṛttyarthaṃ sirāsṛgvimocanaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sirā gata asṛj vimocana mātra vidhiḥ kāścid avedhyāḥ tasmāt vedhya avedhya tva pratipādana karmaṇaḥ prastuta tvāt tad tad sirā gata asṛj gata kāryasya tad sirā gata asṛj gata rogasya nivṛtti artham sirā asṛj vimocanam kuryāt iti arthaḥ

original: na ca tattadroganivṛttyarthaṃ taddhetukasirābhedanaṃ avasaratvāt marmasthānādhiṣṭhitasirāvyatirekeṇa taddhetukasirābhedavijñānaviṣayakajñānaṃ grahītumaśakyamiti vācyam | yatra viruddharasādanāt jātājīrṇajanyāmayā eva doṣavikāragatayo bhavantīti tasmāddoṣapacanaparyantaṃ laṅghanaṃ kāryamiti |

analyzed: yatra viruddha rasa adanāt jāta ajīrṇa janya āmaya vikāraḥ viruddha dhātu prabhavaḥ bhavati tatra tena uccārita śabda bhedāt sirāḥ vijñāya tad sthāna gata varṇa viruddham idam varṇam iti tad varṇa janaka sirā sthitim vijñāya doṣa dhātu gatyā asṛj vikāraḥ yatra dṛśyate tatra duṣṭa āśayam vijñāya tad tad hetuka sirā jālam ca vijñāya tad hetu kṛta āmaya adhiṣṭhāna sthalam vijñāya

original: nanu prajājananahetubhūtaṃ vārdhikadravyameva bhavati | itthameva prathamasūtre pratipāditam | yāvadvikāro yatra dṛśyate tadānīmeva tannivartakena sa nivartito bhavatīti pratipāditam | yāvadvikāre'pi laṅghanenaiva nivartata iti kathaṃ pratipāditam ? kathametatsirāsṛgvimocanena kāryamityasvarasādāha-- nīrujeti |

original: tayośca sarvāvayavāḥ puṣṭāssantaḥ prajotpādakā bhavantīti teṣāmavayavānāṃ raktadhātuvikāre sati pratibandhakaṃ bhavati | tadavikārakaraṇārthamayaṃ vidhiriti, tathā mātāpitroravayavāḥ avikāraphalaṃ prayacchantīti sūtramīritam |
analyzed: tayoḥ ca sarva avayavāḥ puṣṭāḥ santaḥ prajā utpādakāḥ bhavanti iti teṣām avayavānām rakta dhātu vikāre sati pratibandhakam bhavati tad avikāra karaṇa artham ayam vidhiḥ iti tathā mātā pitroḥ avayavāḥ avikāra phalam prayacchanti iti sūtram īritam

original: mātāpitrośca śarīraviṣayakaśāstravijñānajanyakarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ śarīrāvayavadārḍhyakaraṇasāmagrīsampādanānubhavāvayavāvayavitvaṃ sampadyate | tayoḥ strīpuruṣayośśuklaṃ cārtavaṃ ca tau tathābhūtau garbhāśaye piṇḍatvena pratiṣṭhitau | tābhyāmeva bījātmakābhyāmavikārabhūtābhyāṃ prajājananahetubhūtābhyāṃ satvamāvirbhavati | tatra śārīravacanaṃ--
analyzed: mātā pitroḥ ca śarīra viṣayaka śāstra vijñāna janya karmaṇaḥ phalam śarīra avayava dārḍhya karaṇa sāmagrī sampādana anubhava avayava avayavi tvam sampadyate tayoḥ strī puruṣayoḥ śuklam ca ārtavam ca tau tathābhūtau garbhāśaye piṇḍa tvena pratiṣṭhitau tābhyām eva bīja ātmakābhyām avikāra bhūtābhyām prajā janana hetu bhūtābhyām satvam āvirbhavati tatra śārīra vacanam

original: nanu āmayakārakasirāgatāsṛgvimocanamātreṇa śuklārtavau | pariśuddhāvityuktam | na tāvanmātreṇa saṅgacchate'duṣṭāśayaḥ | aviruddhadoṣaśuddhendriyaśuddhānalā ete vārdhikadravyādanādbhāvyā etatsūtragatasirāgataduṣṭaraktavimocanamātrādeva | idānīṃ śukrārtavau bījotpādakahetubhūtāviti pārthivadravyādanaṃ vinā kathaṃ bhavetāmityasvarasādāha-- śuddhoti |

śuddha āśaya śuddha doṣa śuddha anala śuddha indriya guṇa hetuka pārthiva dravyaiḥ prajāḥ prajāyante 50

original: vārdhikadravyādanādeva sarvāśayāḥ pariśuddhā bhavanti | indriyāṇi cāvikāradoṣāṇi | tathā pañcānilāśca pañca pācapittāni cāduṣṭāssantaḥ laghuguṇakārakavārdhikadravyādanādbhavanti | kiṃ ca sātvikadravyādanaṃ sāttvikaguṇahetukam | rājasadravyādanaṃ rājasaguṇakārakam | tāmasadravyādanaṃ ca tāmasaguṇakārakam |
analyzed: vārdhika dravya adanāt eva sarva āśayāḥ pariśuddhāḥ bhavanti indriyāṇi ca avikāra doṣāṇi tathā pañca anilāḥ ca pañca pāca pittāni ca aduṣṭāḥ santaḥ laghu guṇa kāraka vārdhika dravya adanāt bhavanti kim ca sātvika dravya adanam sāttvika guṇa hetukam rājasa dravya adanam rājasa guṇa kārakam tāmasa dravya adanam ca tāmasa guṇa kārakam
vārdhika dravya adanāt jāta āśaya ādikam vinā bīja utpādanam na bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: idānīṃ śarīrajananakārye tatpratipādakasāmagrī sampādanīyā | sā āvaśyakī bhavati | āśayāśca doṣāśca analāśca indriyāṇi ca vārdhikadravyādanātte tu pariśuddhāssantaḥ śarīraṃ puṣṇanti na te śarīrotpādakā iti ādau śarīrotpādanakārye tadutpādakasāmagrīsampādanaṃ vinā kathaṃ śarīrotpādanasya āśayādīnāṃ ca sambandho ghaṭate ? ityasvarasādāha-- śukreti |

original: puruṣajanyaṃ śukram | strījanyaṃ śoṇitam | tayorhetubhūtaṃ yoniḥ | sānipātyaṃ saṃsargahetubhūtātmakaṃ tayossānnipātyamabhidhīyate | śukrasya sarvadā bījotpādakatvaṃ vaktumaśakyam | kintu āśayāḥ pariśuddhāssantaḥ tathā prajājananahetubhūtā bhavanti | strījanyaśoṇitasyāpi tathaiva |

original: yogyakālastrīpuruṣasaṃyogavyāpārahetubhūtadivyayonidṛḍhatarasaṃparkāt bījādhārapradeśo garbhāśaya iti tajjanakatvasya ca suprasiddhatvāt | yonāveva satvaḥ garbhassan tadanantaraṃ garbhāśayaṃ praviśya vivardhata ityarthaḥ | nanu asminkārye āśayāḥ pariśuddhā bhavantu | taddvārā śukraśoṇite api pariśuddhe ca tayoreva bījātmakatvāt |

original: kathaṃ tadedhate ? kathaṃ vivardhate ? kathaṃ ceṣṭāśrayaṃ calanāmakaṃ ceti vaktuṃ śakyate ? ityasvarasādāha-- yonyāmiti |

original: nanu "ādhikaṃ naiva dūṣyate" iti nyāyena anekasvādurasavaddravyaṃ vāyunivartakam | anekāmlarasavaddravyamelanaṃ pittaroganiva rtakam | anekalavaṇoṣṇarasavaddravyaṃ kaphanivartakam | etādṛśayogakalpanameva yogyayogo bhavedityasvarasādāha-- citteti |

original: yāvadrogapittarasavaddravyamelanavyatirekeṇa yogakaraṇaṃ viruddhayogo bhavati | tattu cittavibhramo bhavati | cittaṃ manaḥ | tayoraikyena rajatatvābhāvavati śuktau rajataṃ yatra bhāsate tatra cittavibhramo bhavatītyarthaḥ |

original: nanu rajatatvaprakārakajñānagrāhakasāmagrīviśiṣṭapurovartinaṃ yadā viṣayīkaroti rajatatvaprakārakajñānagrāhakasāmagryā tadviśiṣṭameva bhāsate haṭṭapaṭṭaṇādau | tathā dṛṣṭatvāt | yāvajjñānagocarasāmagryā abhāvāt cittavibhramaḥ kathaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- ataditi |

original: pittaprakoparasādanena pitarogodbhavo bhavati | tatra kācakāmālādirogavaśāt śvaityaguṇaviśiṣṭapurovartini pītaguṇaviśiṣṭo'yamiti jñānaṃ jāyate, tattaddoṣavaśāt | tacca taddoṣaviruddhādanādbhavati | tadā pītaśśaṅkha iti jñānaṃ jāyate |

original: nanu sarve vyādhayaḥ doṣatrayajanyāḥ | te sarve'pi tattaddrasādanajanyāḥ | ataḥ sūtre pittaviruddhadravyādanāccittavibhramo bhavatīti yattaccintyam | śvaityaguṇaviśiṣṭe śaṅkhe pīto'yamiti jñānaṃ bhāsate | tadayuktamityasvarasādāha-- seti |

original: bhramaviṣayakajñānaṃ ca pittajanyam | pītaśśaṅkha iti jñānaṃ ca śuddhapittaviruddhāhārajanyam | pavanapittarogajanakaviruddharasajanyatve sati tadviruddhāhārajanyatvāt, yannaivaṃ tannaivaṃ yathā ghaṭādiḥ |

original: nanu yatkiṃciddravyaṃ viṣayīkṛtya atyantanirīkṣaṇāt pūrvaṃ pramāṇatvenānubhūtamapi tatraiva saṃśayo jāyate | tatra rasavaddravyādanaṃ heturna bhavati ityata āha-- atīti |

original: nanu yadviruddharasavaddravyādanaṃ yāvadrogahetukaṃ tadviruddhadravyādanaṃ tattadroganivartakamiti vaktavyam | tathā satyamadhurarasajanyarogāṇāṃ nivartako madhurarasa eva bhavati | yathā kadalīphalavirasajanyarogasya ajīrṇasya kadalīphalarasadravyādanaṃ nivartakamiti vaktumaśakyamityarthaḥ | kiṃtu āmlarasādyā nivartakā bhaveyuriti tātparyam |
analyzed: nanu yat viruddha rasavat dravya adanam yāvat roga hetukam tad viruddha dravya adanam tad tad roga nivartakam iti vaktavyam tathā satya madhura rasa janya rogāṇām nivartakaḥ madhura rasaḥ eva bhavati yathā kadalī phala virasa janya rogasya ajīrṇasya kadalī phala rasa dravya adanam nivartakam iti vaktum aśakyam iti arthaḥ kiṃtu āmla rasa ādyāḥ nivartakāḥ bhaveyuḥ iti tātparyam

original: yāvaddravyādanajñānaṃ yatkāle yathopalabdhaṃ tatkāla eva pūrvadinānnāpekṣayā laghutarānnādanaṃ pathyaṃ bhavatīti tatkālayogyadravyeṇa prathamadinajanyarogasya tatkālocitarogābhāvakāryasya prāgabhāvaparipālanaṃ puruṣārtha ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yāvat dravya adana jñānam yad kāle yathā upalabdham tad kāle eva pūrva dina anna apekṣayā laghutara anna adanam pathyam bhavati iti tad kāla yogya dravyeṇa prathama dina janya rogasya tad kāla ucita roga abhāva kāryasya prāgabhāva paripālanam puruṣa arthaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu rasavirasānnādanājjātapramāpratītasthale yathā ghaṭajñānagocarajñānānantaraṃ tatraivātinirīkṣaṇena cakṣurdoṣavaśāt tatpratītiviṣayatadviṣayatātkālikasaṃśayaḥ kathaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- atyanteti |

original: etadvacanānusāreṇa indriyātilālanameva animiṣadṛṣṭiriti na saṃśayaḥ | viruddharasādanajanyaṃ na bhavatīti viśeṣadarśanasāmagrīsaṃśayapratibandhakāt tannivartakarasādanasāmagrī ? tasya janakatvābhā vāt | yadā yasya bhramo bhavati tasya rājasatāmasaguṇapratipādakasāmagryā bhinnatvādityasvarasādāha raja iti |

original: nanu indriyārthasannikarṣānantaraṃ ayaṃ ghaṭa iti jñānānubhūtārthe jāte sati mamotpannaṃ jñānamapramāṇamiti yo mānasikabhramo jāyate tadyāvadrasavaddravyādanajanyarogagrastendriyajñānagocaratvābhāvādityasvarasādāha-- yāvaditi |

original: pratyahaṃ āmanissaraṇakāryaṃ kartavyamiti boddhavyam | "mama āmavṛddhiḥ jātā" iti jñānānantaraṃ āmanissaraṇakāryaṃ vidhiriti jñāpanārthaṃ āmanivṛttikaraṇameva "pratyahaṃ mama āmavṛddhirjāyate" iti yasya jñānamasti tādṛśaṃ prati idaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pratyaham āma nissaraṇa kāryam kartavyam iti boddhavyam mama āma vṛddhiḥ jātā iti jñāna anantaram āma nissaraṇa kāryam vidhiḥ iti jñāpana artham āma nivṛtti karaṇam eva pratyaham mama āma vṛddhiḥ jāyate iti yasya jñānam asti tādṛśam prati idam bheṣajam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu śoṣakadravyādanajātarogāṇāṃ poṣakadravyaṃ tatra bheṣajamiti vaktuṃ na śakyate | śoṣakadravyādanaṃ nāma śuṣkadravyādanam | tena ajīrṇe jāte sati tannivṛtyarthaṃ laṅghanameva kartavyam |

original: tatra nivartakībhūtapoṣakadravyaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavatīti rukpradarśanānantaraṃ laṅghanena doṣaprakopanivṛttiṃ kṛtvā dhātvabhivṛddhyarthaṃ poṣakadravyaṃ tatra bheṣajaṃ bhavatu, ādāveva rukpradarśane jāte prathamata eva poṣakadravyapradānena doṣāḥ prakupitā bhaveyurityasvarasādāha-- yāvaditi |

yāvat dhātu aṅkura abhivardhaka dravya abhāva jāta rogāḥ tad poṣaka saṃskāra yukta sneha ādayaḥ nivartakāḥ

original: kiṃcidviruddharasadravyādanajñānena rogāvirbhāvātpūrvameva tannivartakena nivartayituṃ sukarameva | taddravyānnādanādeva nivartayituṃ śakyate | anyathā rogāṅkure jāte sati tannidānahetubhūtāṅgāvirbhāvaparyantaṃ nivartakena te nivartyā bhaveyuḥ | dhātuṣu vyādhyaṅkurāvirbhāvakāryābhāvakāraṇājjātarujaḥ tatra poṣakadravyayuktasnehādayo nivartakāḥ |
analyzed: kiṃcid viruddha rasa dravya adana jñānena roga āvirbhāvāt pūrvam eva tad nivartakena nivartayitum sukaram eva tad dravya anna adanāt eva nivartayitum śakyate anyathā roga aṅkure jāte sati tad nidāna hetu bhūta aṅga āvirbhāva paryantam nivartakena te nivartyāḥ bhaveyuḥ dhātuṣu vyādhi aṅkura āvirbhāva kārya abhāva kāraṇāt jāta rujaḥ tatra poṣaka dravya yukta sneha ādayaḥ nivartakāḥ
anyathā tad poṣaka dravya yukta sneha ādyāḥ tad dravyaiḥ sahitāḥ tad pāna abhyaṅga avalepanāt vyādhīn nivartayanti iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarveṣāṃ sarvapadārthādanasya prastutatvāt sarvadravyādanaṃ rogahetukaṃ bhavati | yāvadrogāṇāṃ yāvaddravyāṇāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāve jñāte sati idaṃ vyādhihetukaṃ dravyaṃ idaṃ vyādhinivartakaṃ dravyaṃ iti tayorvyāptigrahe sati tathā vaktuṃ śakyate | sarvatrāpi tathāpyananubhavena tayorvyāpterabhāvādityasvarasādāha-- māturiti |
analyzed: nanu sarveṣām sarva padārtha adanasya prastuta tvāt sarva dravya adanam roga hetukam bhavati yāvat rogāṇām yāvat dravyāṇām kārya kāraṇa bhāve jñāte sati idam vyādhi hetukam dravyam idam vyādhi nivartakam dravyam iti tayoḥ vyāpti grahe sati tathā vaktum śakyate sarvatra api tathā api ananubhavena tayoḥ vyāpteḥ abhāvāt iti asvarasāt āha mātuḥ iti

original: tatra śiśūnāṃ stanyapānādanena yāvaddhātuṣu vyādhyaṅkurāvirbhāvakāryābhāvakaraṇājjātarogāṇāṃ tannivartakībhūtāḥ śoṣakapoṣakādayo mātuḥ rasāhārapariṇāmena sarvarogaprāgabhāvaparipālanam | stanyapānena arogāssantaḥ "śatāyuḥ puruṣaśśatendriyaḥ" iti rogakāryapratibandhakasya vidyamānatvāt nivartakanivartyānumitau vyāptirgṛhītuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra śiśūnām stanya pāna adanena yāvat dhātuṣu vyādhi aṅkura āvirbhāva kārya abhāva karaṇāt jāta rogāṇām tad nivartakībhūtāḥ śoṣaka poṣaka ādayaḥ mātuḥ rasa āhāra pariṇāmena sarva roga prāgabhāva paripālanam stanya pānena arogāḥ santaḥ śata āyuḥ puruṣaḥ śata indriyaḥ iti roga kārya pratibandhakasya vidyamāna tvāt nivartaka nivartya anumitau vyāptiḥ gṛhītum śakyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu māturāhārarasāhārajanyāvayavasthitarasā vā āmayanivartakā iti pratipādyante | virasādanena māturvikāre jāte sati tatra payassthitarasāḥ anivartakā bhavanti pravṛttyādihitā ityasvarasādāha-- avikāramiti |
analyzed: nanu mātuḥ āhāra rasa āhāra janya avayava sthita rasāḥ vā āmaya nivartakāḥ iti pratipādyante virasa adanena mātuḥ vikāre jāte sati tatra payaḥ sthita rasāḥ anivartakāḥ bhavanti pravṛtti ādi hitāḥ iti asvarasāt āha avikāram iti
a vikāram nirīkṣya enām mātṛ jam pāyayet 36

original: mātusstanyapānaṃ śiśorāmayanivartakaṃ na pravartakaṃ yadā bhavati tadā enāṃ mātaraṃ roganivartakadravyebhyaḥ avikāro yathā bhavati tathā kurvan tajjanyaśiśūn mātṛjaṃ stanyaṃ pānayogyaṃ pāyayedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: mātuḥ stanya pānam śiśoḥ āmaya nivartakam na pravartakam yadā bhavati tadā enām mātaram roga nivartaka dravyebhyaḥ avikāraḥ yathā bhavati tathā kurvan tad janya śiśūn mātṛ jam stanyam pāna yogyam pāyayet iti arthaḥ

original: śiśoḥ poṣakaśoṣakadravyamapi pravartakaṃ bhavati | kevalaṃ stanyapānamātraṃ na pravartakamityata āha-- yogyeti |
analyzed: śiśoḥ poṣaka śoṣaka dravyam api pravartakam bhavati kevalam stanya pāna mātram na pravartakam iti atas āha yogya iti
yogya dravyeṇa ca tān poṣayet 37

original: yogyadravyeṇaiva ca tān poṣayet | mātṛstanyapānādinā ajīrṇe jāte na snehadravyaṃ tatra prayojakaṃ bhavati | tattadrogopayogayogyayogayuktaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca tailaṃ ca nivartakaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | tadeva yogyadravyamiti tātparyam | tān śiśūn pratyahaṃ poṣayedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yogya dravyeṇa eva ca tān poṣayet mātṛ stanya pāna ādinā ajīrṇe jāte na sneha dravyam tatra prayojakam bhavati tad tad roga upayoga yogya yoga yuktam ghṛtam ca tailam ca nivartakam bhavati iti arthaḥ tat eva yogya dravyam iti tātparyam tān śiśūn pratyaham poṣayet iti arthaḥ

original: nanu mātṛstanyapayaḥ tajjanyaśarīrāṇāṃ rogagrastānāṃ tatpayo nivartakaṃ bhavatītyuktam | itaḥ pūrvaṃ ṣaḍrasavaddravyāṇāṃ nivartakatvaṃ pratipāditam | idānīṃ mātṛstanyameva sarvavyādhīnāṃ nivartakaṃ bhavatītyuktam | tathā cet ṣaḍrasavaddravyāṇāṃ nivartakatvaṃ na syādityasvarasādāha-- yāvaditi |
analyzed: nanu mātṛ stanya payaḥ tad janya śarīrāṇām roga grastānām tat payaḥ nivartakam bhavati iti uktam itas pūrvam ṣaṣ rasavat dravyāṇām nivartaka tvam pratipāditam idānīm mātṛ stanyam eva sarva vyādhīnām nivartakam bhavati iti uktam tathā ced ṣaṣ rasavat dravyāṇām nivartaka tvam na syāt iti asvarasāt āha yāvat iti
yāvat stanyapāḥ tāvat bālakāḥ stanya pānam

original: stanyapānaṃ śiśūnāṃ dhātupoṣakaṃ annādanāhetukatve sati rasavaddravyapoṣakahetukatvāt | annādanaṃ tu na dhātupoṣakaṃ annādanāyogyadhātupoṣakatvāt poṣakadravyajanyatvācca ityanumānavidhayā mātṛjanyapayasāṃ śiśordhātupoṣakatvaṃ anvayavyatirekapramāṇasiddham | yāvatstanyapānopajīvyaṃ śiśośśarīramiti |
analyzed: stanya pānam śiśūnām dhātu poṣakam anna adana ahetuka tve sati rasavat dravya poṣaka hetuka tvāt anna adanam tu na dhātu poṣakam anna adana ayogya dhātu poṣaka tvāt poṣaka dravya janya tvāt ca iti anumāna vidhayā mātṛ janya payasām śiśoḥ dhātu poṣaka tvam anvaya vyatireka pramāṇa siddham yāvat stanya pāna upajīvyam śiśoḥ śarīram iti

original: sarvadā mātṛputratvamātraṃ śiśutvajñāpakaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | māturajīrṇejāte sati tacchiśostadajīrṇavaśāt tatsadṛśā āmayāssambhavanti | tatpratīkārastu kena kāraṇena bhāvyaḥ | teṣāṃ śiśūnāṃ cūrṇaghṛtatailādīnāmasaṃbhāvitvāt, ayogyatvācca | tattadāmajanyāmayānāṃ tattadvidhivihitena nivartayitumaśakyatvāt ityasvarasādāha-- bāleti |
analyzed: sarvadā mātṛ putra tva mātram śiśu tva jñāpakam na bhavati iti arthaḥ mātuḥ ajīrṇe jāte sati tad śiśoḥ tad ajīrṇa vaśāt tad sadṛśāḥ āmayāḥ sambhavanti tad pratīkāraḥ tu kena kāraṇena bhāvyaḥ teṣām śiśūnām cūrṇa ghṛta taila ādīnām asaṃbhāvi tvāt ayogya tvāt ca tad tad āma janya āmayānām tad tad vidhi vihitena nivartayitum aśakya tvāt iti asvarasāt āha bāla iti
bāla yogya nivartakam kuryāt

original: stanyapānāhāropajīvyakāryaviśiṣṭabālāmayānāṃ nivartakaṃ brūmaḥ | tannivartakaṃ recakaprasādhyam | māturāhārajātastanyapānena amitatvena jātaruja ubhayaśarīrajanyatvāt | prāyaśa āmapravṛddhyā tattadvirecakaṃ sukumāradravyayogyakarmakaraṇāt tattadvyādhīnāṃ nivartakamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: stanya pāna āhāra upajīvya kārya viśiṣṭa bāla āmayānām nivartakam brūmaḥ tat nivartakam recaka prasādhyam mātuḥ āhāra jāta stanya pānena amita tvena jāta rujaḥ ubhaya śarīra janya tvāt prāyaśas āma pravṛddhyā tat tat virecakam sukumāra dravya yogya karma karaṇāt tat tat vyādhīnām nivartakam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu cākṣuṣapratītijanyapramāpratibandhakalavaṇoṣṇarasavaddravyasaṃśayavibhramau cakṣurindriyadoṣajanyau | tannivartakaistu kathaṃ nivartata ityata āha-- śrotreti |
analyzed: nanu cākṣuṣa pratīti janya pramā pratibandhaka lavaṇa uṣṇa rasavat dravya saṃśaya vibhramau cakṣuḥ indriya doṣa janyau tad nivartakaiḥ tu katham nivartate iti atas āha śrotra iti
śrotra indriyāt śabda jñānam

original: śrotrendriyajanyaśābdapramāpratibandhakatiktarasavaddravyādanaṃ tatsaṃśayavyatirekānvayau yajjñānapramāpratibandhakau |kaṣāyatiktamadhurarasāḥ pariśuddhāssantaḥ nivartakā bhaveyuriti vaktavyatvāt | tathā sati rasanendriyaviṣayakarasajñānajanyapratītipratibandhakasaṃśayavibhramau kena kāraṇena nivartanīyāvityata āha-- rasaneti |
analyzed: śrotra indriya janya śābda pramā pratibandhaka tikta rasavat dravya adanam tad saṃśaya vyatireka anvayau yad jñāna pramā pratibandhakau kaṣāya tikta madhura rasāḥ pariśuddhāḥ santaḥ nivartakāḥ bhaveyuḥ iti vaktavya tvāt tathā sati rasanā indriya viṣayaka rasa jñāna janya pratīti pratibandhaka saṃśaya vibhramau kena kāraṇena nivartanīyau iti atas āha rasanā iti
rasanā indriya janya bhramāt āma virasa doṣa ādika eka rasāt saṃśaya vibhramau bhavataḥ

rasanā indriya janya śuddha rasa jñāna pratibandhakau svādu rasavat dravya adana vibhrama ādi hetukau yat saṃśaya vyatireka niścayau yāvat indriya jñāna gocara pramā pratīti pratibandhakau tad viruddha dravya adanam tad hetuḥ iti arthaḥ
ghrāṇa indriya viṣayaka gandha jñāna janya pramā pratibandhaka saṃśaya vibhramau kena hetunā nivartyete iti atas āha ghrāṇa iti
ghrāṇa indriyāt gandha pratītiḥ tathā
ghrāṇa indriya janya śuddha gandha jñāna pramā pratibandhaka amla rasavat dravya adanam bhrama saṃśaya hetukam tad niścayaḥ tad hetuḥ iti arthaḥ
śrotra indriya viṣayaka śabda jñāna janya śābda pramā pratibandhaka saṃśaya bhramau katham nivartyete iti atas āha śrotra iti
śrotra indriyāt śabda jñānam tathā
śrotra indriya janya śābda pramā pratīti pratibandhaka kaṣāya virasa dravya adanam śābdika saṃśaya bhrama hetukam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: tvagindriyaviṣayakasparśajñānajanyapramāpratītipratibandhakatiktarasavaddravyādanaṃ tatsaṃśayabhramajanakam | yatsaṃśayavyatirekaniścayau pratibandhakau tanniścayastaddheturiti nyāyenaiva niścaya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tvac indriya viṣayaka sparśa jñāna janya pramā pratīti pratibandhaka tikta rasavat dravya adanam tat saṃśaya bhrama janakam yat saṃśaya vyatireka niścayau pratibandhakau tad niścayaḥ tad hetuḥ iti nyāyena eva niścayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tvagindriyaviṣayakajñānapramāpratītipratibandhakadoṣanivṛttyarthaṃ poṣakādhikyaśoṣakadravyayogyakāraṇaṃ tannivartakaṃ bhavatu | poṣakadravyāṇāṃ nivartakatvaṃ svādudravyayuktayogakaraṇaṃ yasya bheṣajaṃ nivartakaṃ bhavati tadeva tvagindriyamityata āha-- śoṣaketi |
analyzed: tvac indriya viṣayaka jñāna pramā pratīti pratibandhaka doṣa nivṛtti artham poṣaka ādhikya śoṣaka dravya yogya kāraṇam tat nivartakam bhavatu poṣaka dravyāṇām nivartaka tvam svādu dravya yukta yoga karaṇam yasya bheṣajam nivartakam bhavati tat eva tvac indriyam iti atas āha śoṣaka iti
śoṣaka dravya ādhikya jāta asṛj pratibandhaka pavana anala gati jāta doṣa viṣayaka viparyaya jñānam pramā pratibandhaka hetukam

original: nanu pañcendriyaviṣayakajñānaṃ pratibandhakaruṅnivartakaṃ bhavatu | poṣakadravyayogārthaśoṣakadravyayogakaraṇaṃ kathaṃ bhavedityasvarasādāha-- sārdramiti |
analyzed: nanu pañca indriya viṣayaka jñānam pratibandhaka ruj nivartakam bhavatu poṣaka dravya yoga artha śoṣaka dravya yoga karaṇam katham bhavet iti asvarasāt āha sārdram iti
sa ārdra dravyam tatra bheṣajam

original: sārdradravyaṃ nāma appayaśca mūtraṃ ca madhu ca tailaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ ca, idaṃ sārdradravyaṃ bhavati | etadyogakaraṇaṃ viśiṣya jñāpyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sārdra dravyam nāma ap payaḥ ca mūtram ca madhu ca tailam ca ghṛtam ca idam sārdra dravyam bhavati etat yoga karaṇam viśiṣya jñāpyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu poṣakadravyayuktālpaśoṣakakalpakadravyayogaṃ bheṣajaṃ nivartakaṃ bhavediti pratīyate | idānīṃ kevalaṃ sārdradravyayogakaraṇena kiṃ phalaṃ bhavedityasvarasādāha--sasnehamiti |
analyzed: nanu poṣaka dravya yukta alpa śoṣaka kalpaka dravya yogam bheṣajam nivartakam bhavet iti pratīyate idānīm kevalam sārdra dravya yoga karaṇena kim phalam bhavet iti asvarasa ādāha sa sneham iti
sa sneham ārdram kāryam

original: snehayuktadravyaṃ nivartakamiti yathocyate tathā poṣakadravyādhikyajātapārthivadravyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtyāvapet | tatpākakaraṇena nirdravaṃ yathā bhavati tathā agnau vipācya tatpānalepanābhyaṅgāvagāhanāttattajjanyapañcendriyaviṣayakapramāpratibandhakaṃ nivartayituṃ tadeva bheṣajaṃ bhavatīti na vaktavyam |
analyzed: sneha yukta dravyam nivartakam iti yathā ucyate tathā poṣaka dravya ādhikya jāta pārthiva dravyam cūrṇīkṛtya āvapet tad pāka karaṇena nirdravam yathā bhavati tathā agnau vipācya tad pāna lepana abhyaṅga avagāhanāt tat tad janya pañca indriya viṣayaka pramā pratibandhakam nivartayitum tat eva bheṣajam bhavati iti na vaktavyam

original: tatra pratyakṣapramāṇena saṃśayabhramayornivāraṇasya śakyatvāt, ityāśayaṃ manasi nidhāya pratyakṣapramāṇasvarūpaṃ vivicyate-- cākṣuṣeti |
analyzed: tatra pratyakṣa pramāṇena saṃśaya bhramayoḥ nivāraṇasya śakya tvāt iti āśayam manasi nidhāya pratyakṣa pramāṇa svarūpam vivicyate cākṣuṣa iti

original: cakṣurindriyaviṣayakajñānānubhave sati tadabhāvavati tatprakārakatvaṃ tajjñānasya yathā viṣayo bhavati tathā jākṣuṣapratītijanyetaratvaṃ tadbhinnaviṣayakajñānaṃ pramāṇamiti tāddaśapramāṇena bhramanivṛttyāṃ satyāṃ tannivartakabheṣajaṃ vinā tatpramāṇasya jñātuṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: cakṣuḥ indriya viṣayaka jñāna anubhave sati tad abhāvavati tad prakāraka tvam tad jñānasya yathā viṣayaḥ bhavati tathā jākṣuṣa pratīti janya itaratvam tad bhinna viṣayaka jñānam pramāṇam iti tāddaśa pramāṇena bhrama nivṛttyām satyām tad nivartaka bheṣajam vinā tad pramāṇasya jñātum śakya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kāmilārogagrastacakṣuṣaḥ asmin śaṅkhe pītaviṣayakajñāne jāte śaṅkhaḥ śvetaḥ śaṃkhatvāt ityanumānapramāṇena na pītatva bhramaḥ, nivartake purovartini pītatvānubhavasya balavattvāditi tattaddoṣarāhityameva bhramasaṃśayapratibandhakaṃ bhavedityata āha-- nirdoṣeti |
analyzed: nanu kāmilā roga grasta cakṣuṣaḥ asmin śaṅkhe pīta viṣayaka jñāne jāte śaṅkhaḥ śvetaḥ śaṃkha tvāt iti anumāna pramāṇena na pīta tva bhramaḥ nivartake purovartini pīta tva anubhavasya balavat tvāt iti tad tad doṣa rāhityam eva bhrama saṃśaya pratibandhakam bhavet iti atas āha nirdoṣa iti
nirdoṣa cakṣuḥ tatra janakam
tadvati tad prakāraka tvam doṣa rahita cakṣuṣā gṛhyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bhūyodarśanena dhūmāgnyorvyāptigrahe sati dhūlīpaṭalaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatra vahnibhramo jāyate tatra pūrvānubhavavyāptigrahasya adoṣaviṣayakatvāt bāhyajñānaviṣayakajñānagocarasāmagrīvirahādeva bhramo jāyate | tadbhramasya doṣajanyatvaṃ na vaktavyamityasvarasādāha-- cakṣuriti |
analyzed: nanu bhūyas darśanena dhūma agnyoḥ vyāpti grahe sati dhūlī paṭalam dṛṣṭvā yatra vahni bhramaḥ jāyate tatra pūrva anubhava vyāpti grahasya adoṣa viṣayaka tvāt bāhya jñāna viṣayaka jñāna gocara sāmagrī virahāt eva bhramaḥ jāyate tad bhramasya doṣa janya tvam na vaktavyam iti asvarasāt āha cakṣuḥ iti
cakṣuḥ gṛhīta laiṅgika jñānam pramāṇam

original: nirdoṣacakṣuṣā bhūyo bhūyaḥ dhūmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vahniṃ paśyati, yatra dhūmastatrāgniriti | tatra doṣajanakarasavaddravyādanaṃ na kāraṇam | tadabhāve'pi bhramadarśanāt | bāhyendriyaviṣayajñānagocarasāmagrīvaikalyādeva bhramo jāyate | tatra rogotpādakasāmagryā adṛṣṭatvāt | bhramasaṃśayau rogotpādakasāmagrījanyau bhramajanakasāmagrījanyatvāt |
analyzed: nirdoṣa cakṣuṣā bhūyas bhūyas dhūmam dṛṣṭvā vahnim paśyati yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti tatra doṣa janaka rasavat dravya adanam na kāraṇam tad abhāve pi bhrama darśanāt bāhya indriya viṣaya jñāna gocara sāmagrī vaikalyāt eva bhramaḥ jāyate tatra roga utpādaka sāmagryāḥ adṛṣṭa tvāt bhrama saṃśayau roga utpādaka sāmagrī janyau bhrama janaka sāmagrī janya tvāt

original: tatra virasajanyarogotpādakasāmagryā niyamena dṛṣṭatvāt | āgamapramāṇenāpi bhramanivṛtteḥ bhramo nivartya ityāha-- bhrameti |
analyzed: tatra virasa janya roga utpādaka sāmagryāḥ niyamena dṛṣṭa tvāt āgama pramāṇena api bhrama nivṛtteḥ bhramaḥ nivartyaḥ iti āha bhrama iti
bhrama abhāva janakam āpta vacanam āgamaḥ

original: āptavacanajanyā pramā svadoṣajanyapramāpratibandhikā na bhavati | āptavacanasya bhramābhāvapratītijanakatvāt | tasmādrasavirasajanyadoṣahetunā indriyagocarabhramaviṣayakajñānaṃ pratyakṣeṇa vā anumānena pramāṇena vā āgamapramāṇena vā doṣajanyabhramajñānaṃ nivartate | tatra doṣāṇāmeva kāraṇatvapratipādanādityarthaḥ ||

original: tadvirāmaḥ antarindriyeṇa manasā antarātmani abhyāsavaśāt niyamitaḥ, tasya pratyayena niyamena purovartini prāmāṇyaṃ gṛhyata evetyarthaḥ ||

original: nanu ayaṃ śuddharasavaddravyādanavān bhavati | so'prāmāṇyābhāvajñānavān bhavati | evamākāreṇa ubhayorvyāptigrahe sati apramājñānaṃ vaktumaśakyam | tathā hi-- pramāpratīkārakasāmagrīśuddharasavaddravyādanasāmagrīti vaktuṃ na śakyate | purovartini tadvati tatprakārakajñānānantaraṃ tasminviṣaye anyasya doṣavaśādbhramo jāyate |
analyzed: nanu ayam śuddha rasavat dravya adanavān bhavati soprāmāṇya abhāva jñānavān bhavati evam ākāreṇa ubhayoḥ vyāpti grahe sati apramā jñānam vaktum aśakyam tathā hi pramā pratīkāraka sāmagrī śuddha rasavat dravya adana sāmagrī iti vaktum na śakyate purovartini tadvati tad prakāraka jñāna anantaram tasmin viṣaye anyasya doṣa vaśāt bhramaḥ jāyate

original: tena hetunā vākyaprayogo jātaḥ | etadutpannajñānaṃ apramāṇaviṣayakamiti vākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ etasyāpi prāmāṇyaviṣayajñāne sati saṃśayo bhavati | virasādanamapi aprāmāṇyapratipādakasāmagrī bhavati, ityāśayaṃ manasi nidhāya bhramotpādakasāmagryantaraṃ pratipādayati-- yāvaditi |
analyzed: tena hetunā vākya prayogaḥ jātaḥ etat utpanna jñānam apramāṇa viṣayakam iti vākya śravaṇa anantaram etasya api prāmāṇya viṣaya jñāne sati saṃśayaḥ bhavati virasa adanam api aprāmāṇya pratipādaka sāmagrī bhavati iti āśayam manasi nidhāya bhrama utpādaka sāmagrī antaram pratipādayati yāvat iti
yāvat dhātu sirā ādi sañcarat prāṇa apāna vyāna udāna samāna anila nirodhanam bhrama hetukam

original: prāṇādipañcakānāṃ nirodhanaṃ yatra dṛśyate tatra rogotpattirbhavati | tatpavananirodhanena āśayā duṣṭā bhavanti | dhātavo'pi duṣṭā bhavanti | tajjanyakācakāmilādivaśāt saṃśayavibhramau bhavata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: prāṇa ādi pañcakānām nirodhanam yatra dṛśyate tatra roga utpattiḥ bhavati tad pavana nirodhanena āśayāḥ duṣṭāḥ bhavanti dhātavaḥ api duṣṭāḥ bhavanti tad janya kāca kāmilā ādi vaśāt saṃśaya vibhramau bhavataḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarvatrāpi saṃśayabhramajanakasāmagryāṃ prāmāṇyajñānocchedassyāt ityasvarasādāha-- āsanneti |
analyzed: nanu sarvatra api saṃśaya bhrama janaka sāmagryām prāmāṇya jñāna ucchedaḥ syāt iti asvarasāt āha āsanna iti
āsanna viṣayaka jñāna hetuka antarātma antaḥkaraṇa yoga abhyāsa vaśāt pavana nirodha nāda rogī sa cira āyūḥ bhavati

original: nanu ghaṭendriyasannikarṣānantaraṃ tajjñānagrāhakasāmagryāṃ satyāṃ bhramajñānānubhavo bhavet | tanniṣṭhaprāmāṇyamapi gṛhyatāṃ nāma, itarendriyaviṣayeṣu tajjñānaviṣayakaprāmāṇyaṃ kathaṃ gṛhyate ? pañcendriyaviṣayajñāneṣu virāgo nāma viśeṣeṇa rāgo virāga ityarthaḥ | tasmātpañcendriyaviṣayajñāneṣu viśeṣeṇa rāgo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ghaṭa indriya sannikarṣa anantaram tad jñāna grāhaka sāmagryām satyām bhrama jñāna anubhavaḥ bhavet tad niṣṭha prāmāṇyam api gṛhyatām nāma itara indriya viṣayeṣu tad jñāna viṣayaka prāmāṇyam katham gṛhyate pañca indriya viṣaya jñāneṣu virāgaḥ nāma viśeṣeṇa rāgaḥ virāgaḥ iti arthaḥ tasmāt pañca indriya viṣaya jñāneṣu viśeṣeṇa rāgaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: indriyārthasannikarṣānantaraṃ ātmamanassaṃyogasakalasāmagryāṃ satyāṃ yāvadviṣayakajñānamutpadyate, taddhetukaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ aprāmāṇyagrāhakasāmagrīvyatiriktasāmagrījanyatvāt, madutpannaghaṭajñānaviṣayakaprāmāṇyavat | ātmā jīvaḥ | antaḥkaraṇaṃ cittam | tasya jīvātmanā yogaḥ |
analyzed: indriya artha sannikarṣa anantaram ātma manaḥ saṃyoga sakala sāmagryām satyām yāvat viṣayaka jñānam utpadyate tad hetukam prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇya grāhaka sāmagrī vyatirikta sāmagrī janya tvāt mad utpanna ghaṭa jñāna viṣayaka prāmāṇya vat ātmā jīvaḥ antaḥkaraṇam cittam tasya jīvātmanā yogaḥ

original: tadvaśāt tatkāraṇavaśāt tadviṣayakajñānagocarajñānaniṣṭhaprāmāṇyapratibandhakaṃ bhramajanakasāmagrī pavananirodhanaṃ arogakāraṇaṃ, aprāmāṇyābhāvasāmagrījanyatvāt ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad vaśāt tad kāraṇa vaśāt tad viṣayaka jñāna gocara jñāna niṣṭha prāmāṇya pratibandhakam bhrama janaka sāmagrī pavana nirodhanam aroga kāraṇam aprāmāṇya abhāva sāmagrī janya tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu viṣayapañcakeṣu virāgo nāma viśeṣeṇa rāgo virāgaḥ | śāstrasya viṣayānubhavamātraphalaṃ labhyate | tena mokṣavirodho bhavati | pratyuta sa vyādhikārako bhavati | etena cirāyuṣṭvaṃ kathaṃ prāpyate ? ityasvarasādāha-- tasmāditi |
analyzed: nanu viṣaya pañcakeṣu virāgaḥ nāma viśeṣeṇa rāgaḥ virāgaḥ śāstrasya viṣaya anubhava mātra phalam labhyate tena mokṣa virodhaḥ bhavati pratyuta sa vyādhi kārakaḥ bhavati etena cira āyuḥ tvam katham prāpyate iti asvarasāt āha tasmāt iti
tasmāt prāṇa ādi pañcaka phalībhūtam kāryam

original: asyārthaḥ-- śarīraṃ doṣadhātumalāśayātmakam, prāṇādipañcakopajīvyaprakṛtyādhārakatvāt, yannaivaṃ tannaivaṃ, yathā ghaṭaḥ | ceṣṭāśrayaṃ śarīramiti ceṣṭāśrayatvaṃ śarīrāvacchedakam | ceṣṭā tu sā yaddhitāhitaprāptiparihārārthaṃ spandanarūpā | tasmāt śarīraṃ prāṇādipañcakaṃ phalībhūtaṃ bhavati | sā ceṣṭāśrayā prakṛtiriti |
analyzed: asya arthaḥ śarīram doṣa dhātu mala āśaya ātmakam prāṇa ādi pañcaka upajīvya prakṛti ādhāraka tvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā ghaṭaḥ ceṣṭā āśrayam śarīram iti ceṣṭā āśraya tvam śarīra avacchedakam ceṣṭā tu sā yat hita ahita prāpti parihāra artham spandana rūpā tasmāt śarīram prāṇa ādi pañcakam phalībhūtam bhavati sā ceṣṭā āśrayā prakṛtiḥ iti

original: idaṃ sarvaṃ śrutyā pratipāditam | sā śrutiḥ-- "prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānasaprāṇā śvetavarṇātmikā sā tripadā vyāhṛtitrayātmikā" | tatra śrutivacanaṃ pramāṇam-- "bhūriti vai prāṇaḥ | bhuva ityapānaḥ | suvariti vyānaḥ | etairmahacchiro bhavati | maha ityannam |
analyzed: idam sarvam śrutyā pratipāditam sā śrutiḥ prāṇa apāna vyāna udāna samāna saprāṇā śveta varṇa ātmikā sā tripadā vyāhṛti traya ātmikā tatra śruti vacanam pramāṇam bhūḥ iti vai prāṇaḥ bhuvaḥ iti apānaḥ suvar iti vyānaḥ etaiḥ mahat śiraḥ bhavati mahaḥ iti annam

original: annena vāva sarve prāṇā mahīyante |" iti tasmāt prāṇādipañcakaṃ saṃrakṣaṇīyaṃ rogābhāvakāryahetukaṃ mokṣahetuḥ kathaṃ bhavet | yasya prāṇādipañcakaṃ svavaśaṃ bhavati, tasya cirāyuṣṭvamapi labhyate | tasmātprāṇādipañcakaṃ phalībhūtaṃ kāryamityuktam |
analyzed: annena vāva sarve prāṇāḥ mahīyante iti tasmāt prāṇa ādi pañcakam saṃrakṣaṇīyam roga abhāva kārya hetukam mokṣa hetuḥ katham bhavet yasya prāṇa ādi pañcakam sva vaśam bhavati tasya cira āyuḥ tvam api labhyate tasmāt prāṇa ādi pañcakam phalībhūtam kāryam iti uktam

original: tasmācchuddharasavaddravyādanaṃ śarīrasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ karoti, virasavaddravyādanaṃ prāṇaghātaṃ karotīti paryavasitārthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt śuddha rasavat dravya adanam śarīra saṃrakṣaṇam karoti virasavat dravya adanam prāṇa ghātam karoti iti paryavasita arthaḥ

original: nanu prāṇādipañcakasya phalībhūtaṃ nāma-- prāṇavāyuḥ dehacalanakarma vidhatte | sa pavanaḥ avikṛtassan pādābhyāṃ gatāgatatvaṃ ca karma nimeṣonmeṣādikaṃ ca āpādamastakaṃ karma kurvan calanātmakaṃ karma kurute | apānavāyośca prayojanamasti-- meḍhragudapradeśeṣu sthitassan svayamavikṛtassan tathā vikriyate |
analyzed: nanu prāṇa ādi pañcakasya phalībhūtam nāma prāṇa vāyuḥ deha calana karma vidhatte sa pavanaḥ avikṛtaḥ san pādābhyām gata āgata tvam ca karma nimeṣa unmeṣa ādikam ca āpādamastakam karma kurvan calana ātmakam karma kurute apāna vāyoḥ ca prayojanam asti meḍhra guda pradeśeṣu sthitaḥ san svayam avikṛtaḥ san tathā vikriyate

original: vyānānilasya kāryaṃ ca–- pācakapittena svayamapi pañcadhā bhūtvā pācakapittamapi pañcadhā kurvan annaṃ gṛhṇāti, pacati, viveśayati | sārakiṭṭatayā bhuktānnaṃ vibhajya muñcati | āśayapraveśaṃ karoti | sa sarvaśarīraṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhati | udānavāyośca prayojanaṃ--nāsādiparyantaṃ sañcaran vākpravṛttiṃ karoti | balavarṇayośca vṛddhiṃ vidhatte |
analyzed: vyāna anilasya kāryam ca pācaka pittena svayam api pañcadhā bhūtvā pācaka pittam api pañcadhā kurvan annam gṛhṇāti pacati viveśayati sāra kiṭṭa tayā bhukta annam vibhajya muñcati āśaya praveśam karoti sa sarva śarīram vyāpya tiṣṭhati udāna vāyoḥ ca sañcaran vāc pravṛttim karoti bala varṇayoḥ ca vṛddhim vidhatte

original: samānavāyośca prayojanaṃ-- jaṭharānilasya samīpe sthitassan bhuktānnarasaṃ pakvānnaṃ kāyaṃ praveśayan pratimuñcati | evaṃ pañcavāyūnāṃ phalam | teṣāṃ mokṣaphalapradānasya anāvaśyakatvādityasvarasādāha-- adṛṣṭeti |
analyzed: samāna vāyoḥ ca prayojanam jaṭhara anilasya samīpe sthitaḥ san bhukta anna rasam pakva annam kāyam praveśayan pratimuñcati evam pañca vāyūnām phalam teṣām mokṣa phala pradānasya anāvaśyaka tvāt iti asvarasāt āha adṛṣṭa iti
adṛṣṭena indriyeṇa ātmā manasā saṃyujyate

original: adṛṣṭaḥ īśvaraḥ, tena preritassan arthasaṃsargagocarendriyeṇa tadviṣayakagocaraphalaṃ vijñāya aupādhikaheyopādeyavidhiphalaṃ vijñāya mana itarapadārthaviṣayakavijñānaṃ visṛjya ātmajñānagocarajñānaphalaṃ āmuṣmikaphalaṃ ca jīvātmano vidhatte | evaṃ manaḥ ātmasaṃyogajanyādhikaphalaṃ jīvasya prayacchatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: adṛṣṭaḥ īśvaraḥ tena preritaḥ san artha saṃsarga gocara indriyeṇa tad viṣayaka gocara phalam vijñāya aupādhika heya upādeya vidhi phalam vijñāya manaḥ itara padārtha viṣayaka vijñānam visṛjya ātma jñāna gocara jñāna phalam āmuṣmika phalam ca jīva ātmanaḥ vidhatte evam manaḥ ātma saṃyoga janya adhika phalam jīvasya prayacchati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu ātmā manasā saṃyujyate, mana indriyeṇa, indriyamarthena, indriyāṇāṃ prāpyakāritvaniyamāt | tata ātmā indriyaviṣayakajñānagocaraphalaṃ bhuṅkte | na tatphalamāmuṣmikaṃ viṣayasaṃyogajanyajñānaphalasya balavatvāt, ityasvarasādāha-- sarveti |
analyzed: nanu ātmā manasā saṃyujyate manaḥ indriyeṇa indriyam arthena indriyāṇām prāpya kāri tva niyamāt tatas ātmā indriya viṣayaka jñāna gocara phalam bhuṅkte na tad phalam āmuṣmikam viṣaya saṃyoga janya jñāna phalasya balavat tvāt iti asvarasāt āha sarva iti
sarva dhātavaḥ sattva vaśam gatāḥ

original: manonirodhanena śvāsocchvāsanirodhanena ca mukhamārgeṇa bahiḥ pavananirodhanena ca svodarapūraṇakarmakaraṇena ca pṛṣṭhamārgeṇāpi bahiḥ pavanāpahāraṇam | tatpavanaṃ nābhipradeśe'pi kṛtakarmakaraṇāntaram pavanena kukṣisthitasirāmārgasyānubandhanaṃ niśvāsocchvāsānāṃ kaṇṭhapradeśanirodhanaṃ āpādamastakaṃ sañcaratītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: manaḥ nirodhanena śvāsa ucchvāsa nirodhanena ca mukha mārgeṇa bahis pavana nirodhanena ca sva udara pūraṇa karma karaṇena ca pṛṣṭha mārgeṇa api bahis pavana apahāraṇam tat pavanam nābhi pradeśe pi kṛta karma karaṇa antaram pavanena kukṣi sthita sirā mārgasya anubandhanam niśvāsa ucchvāsānām kaṇṭha pradeśa nirodhanam āpādamastakam sañcarati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bāhyendriyaviṣayajñānagocarajñāne vairāgyaṃ manoviṣayakaṃ ātmaviṣayajñānahetukaṃ bhavatīti tatra bāhyendriyaviṣayajñānaniṣṭhabhramābhāvānubhavagrāhakasāmagryeva bhramotpādakasāmagrīvyatiriktasāmagrījanyeti vaktavyam | tathāhi rogābhāvakāryaṃ pañcendriyanirodhanajanyayogābhyāsapavanavaśāt bhavati |
analyzed: nanu bāhya indriya viṣaya jñāna gocara jñāne vairāgyam manaḥ viṣayakam ātma viṣaya jñāna hetukam bhavati iti tatra bāhya indriya viṣaya jñāna niṣṭha bhrama abhāva anubhava grāhaka sāmagrī eva bhrama utpādaka sāmagrī vyatirikta sāmagrī janyā iti vaktavyam tathā hi roga abhāva kāryam pañca indriya nirodhana janya yoga abhyāsa pavana vaśāt bhavati

original: tathā sati dhātavo dṛḍhatarāssantaḥ ? rogābhāvakāryakāraṇavaśāt śrutipratipāditaphalaṃ labhyata ityasvarasādāha-- yatkāleti |
analyzed: tathā sati dhātavaḥ dṛḍhatarāḥ santaḥ roga abhāva kārya kāraṇa vaśāt śruti pratipādita phalam labhyate iti asvarasāt āha yad kāla iti

original: yatkāle yadyoge yathāvidhi phalapradāḥ prajāḥ prajāyante || 67 ||
analyzed: yad kāle yad yoge yathāvidhi phala pradāḥ prajāḥ prajāyante
tad saṃyoga jāta dhātavaḥ pravartakāḥ
yām kāmayeta duhitaram priyā syāt iti
tām niṣṭhāya dadyāt priyā eva bhavati
sa na tu punar āgacchati

original: atra tu arogatvasampādanavaśāt śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyatvaṃ ca labhate |
analyzed: atra tu aroga tva sampādana vaśāt śata āyuḥ puruṣaḥ śata indriya tvam ca labhate

original: nanu mātāpitroḥ dauhitrajananaṃ mokṣakaram | tayordhātudārḍhyakaraṇasya āvaśyakatvena rogābhāvakāryakaraṇadvārā mokṣaprāptirbhavatīti duhitṛśiśussākṣātsāmagrī strīprayuktaraktādhikyasāmagryā bhavatītyasvarasādāha-- strīpuṃsāviti |
analyzed: nanu mātā pitroḥ dauhitra jananam mokṣa karam tayoḥ dhātu dārḍhya karaṇasya āvaśyaka tvena roga abhāva kārya karaṇa dvārā mokṣa prāptiḥ bhavati iti duhitṛ śiśuḥ sākṣāt sāmagrī strī prayukta rakta ādhikya sāmagryā bhavati iti asvarasāt āha strī puṃsau iti
strī puṃsau ātma bhāgau bhinna mūrteḥ sisṛkṣayā

original: strīpuṃsormadhye putrotpādakahetubhūtaretasa ādhikyaṃ putrajananahetukam | putrikotpādanahetubhūtaṃ raktādhikyaṃ putrikājananahetukam | svasmādbhinnamūrtereva putrādiriti smṛtau | mokṣārthinaḥ pravṛttiḥ putrikājananasāmagrīsaṃpādanapūrvikā dānayogyakanyājananasāmagryā eva hetutvāt | yannaivaṃ tannaivaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ |
analyzed: strī puṃsoḥ madhye putra utpādaka hetu bhūta retasaḥ ādhikyam putra janana hetukam putrikā utpādana hetu bhūtam rakta ādhikyam putrikā janana hetukam svasmāt bhinna mūrteḥ eva putra ādiḥ iti smṛtau mokṣa arthinaḥ pravṛttiḥ putrikā janana sāmagrī saṃpādana pūrvikā dāna yogya kanyā janana sāmagryāḥ eva hetu tvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā ghaṭaḥ

original: putrikā jananasāmagrī sampannaputrikājananasāmagrī svasukhahetukamithunānubhavakāryaupakāryakatvāt | prajājananasāmagrī laikikasāmagrīsaṃpādanaṃ vinā kathaṃ labhyata ityasvarasādāha-- prakṛtīti |
analyzed: putrikā janana sāmagrī sampanna putrikā janana sāmagrī sva sukha hetuka mithuna anubhava kārya aupakāryaka tvāt prajā janana sāmagrī laikika sāmagrī saṃpādanam vinā katham labhyate iti asvarasāt āha prakṛti iti
prakṛti puruṣau pitarau iti smṛtau

original: tathā sati guṇaviśiṣṭapuruṣatvāt māyāśabalita īśvaraḥ āmuṣmikaphalaṃ datta ityasvarasādāha-- vṛttīti |
analyzed: tathā sati guṇa viśiṣṭa puruṣa tvāt māyā śabalitaḥ īśvaraḥ āmuṣmika phalam datte iti asvarasāt āha vṛtti iti
vṛtti vyavahita sva rūpa niṣṭha manaḥ autsāhāt punar punar abhiniveśanam yoga abhyāsaḥ 71

original: vṛttivyavahitapuruṣaḥ aupādhikasaṃsargajātaḥ prajājanakasaṃsargahetubhūtatvāt | svabhāvataḥ tasya guṇaprotadravyatvādeva vṛtivyavahitatvaṃ bhavati | tadeva tatsvarūpam | tasmin nihitaṃ manaḥ | tasya manasa utsāhaḥ prītiḥ | prītereva hṛdaye'bhiniveśanam |
analyzed: vṛtti vyavahita puruṣaḥ aupādhika saṃsarga jātaḥ prajā janaka saṃsarga hetu bhūta tvāt svabhāvataḥ tasya guṇa prota dravya tvāt eva vṛti vyavahita tvam bhavati tat eva tad svarūpam tasmin nihitam manaḥ tasya manasaḥ utsāhaḥ prītiḥ prīteḥ eva hṛdaya ibhiniveśanam

original: itarapadārtheṣu virāgassan ya ātmānaṃ dhyāyati sa taṃ dhyātāraṃ saṃsārasāgaranimagnaṃ tārayati | tadevottamaphalam | tadarthamevāyurvedapravṛtteḥ prayojanam | idameva bahupuruṣārthapradānahetukaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | yasya manasa utsāho jāyate tasya manasaḥ punarabhiniveśanaṃ tṛptikārakam |
