original: asmin brahmaṇi deśataḥ kālataḥ vastutaśca paricchedarāhityaṃ tasminnāropitadharmamātraṃ idaṃ bhāsate | tatra itarapadārthaviṣayakajñānarāhityasya upasthitatvāt, tatretarapadārthavicārābhāvo nirvicāra ityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: asmin brahmaṇi deśataḥ kālataḥ vastutas ca pariccheda rāhityam tasmin āropita dharma mātram idam bhāsate tatra itara padārtha viṣayaka jñāna rāhityasya upasthita tvāt tatra itara padārtha vicāra abhāvaḥ nirvicāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarvaviṣayajñāne jāte sati ānando bhavati | etadabhāvo nirvicāraḥ, tarhyānandānubhavopalabdhiḥ kathaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- sukheti |
analyzed: nanu sarva viṣaya jñāne jāte sati ānandaḥ bhavati etad abhāvaḥ nirvicāraḥ tarhi ānanda anubhava upalabdhiḥ katham syāt iti asvarasāt āha sukha iti
sukha prakāśa udrekāt cicchakti viṣayakaḥ saḥ ānandaḥ

original: sukhānandānubhavārtho'pi yatsupte sati prakāśyate sa evānando bhavati | nirvicārabhāvyamanodrekasya heturbhavati | tasmāccicchaktiviṣayakaḥ citsvarūpajñānaśaktiviṣayakaḥ ānando bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sukha ānanda anubhava arthaḥ api yat supte sati prakāśyate saḥ eva ānandaḥ bhavati nirvicāra bhāvya manaḥ udrekasya hetuḥ bhavati tasmāt cicchakti viṣayakaḥ cit svarūpa jñānaśakti viṣayakaḥ ānandaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu parabrahmaṇaḥ nirguṇatve'pi sa eva guṇavānbhavati | nirguṇatvaṃ nāma niravayavatvasya avacchedakatvam | ātmano'pi nirguṇatvāt manasastadgocaratvaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate |
analyzed: nanu para brahmaṇaḥ nirguṇa tve pi saḥ eva guṇavān bhavati nirguṇa tvam nāma niravayava tvasya avacchedaka tvam ātmanaḥ api nirguṇa tvāt manasaḥ tad gocara tvam vaktum na śakyate

original: nirguṇatvasya niravayavadravyatvāt, manaso'pi nirguṇatvāt, indriyatvena ātmaviṣayakajñānagrāhakatvaṃ vaktumaśakyatvāt, iti ātmanaḥ agocaratvādeva indriyāṇāmapi tatprāpyatvāsaṃbhavena manaso'pyaprayojakatvāpattirityata āha--asminniti |
analyzed: nirguṇa tvasya niravayava dravya tvāt manasaḥ api nirguṇa tvāt indriya tvena ātma viṣayaka jñāna grāhaka tvam vaktum aśakya tvāt iti ātmanaḥ agocara tvāt eva indriyāṇām api tad prāpya tva asaṃbhavena manasā upi aprayojaka tva āpattiḥ iti atas āha asmin iti
asmin grāhya satya sattā mātra viṣayaka tvena samādhiḥ sā smṛtā

original: asminbrahmaṇi grahītuṃ yogyo jīvaḥ tasya paramātmaviṣayakatvena brahmasattā svayaṃ jagastvarūpakāraṇatvena prakāśyata iti satyaṃ brahma manaso'pyaviṣayo bhavati | guṇarahitabrahmaṇaḥ manogrāhyatvasya vaktumaśakyatvāt | satteti sattāmātraviṣayakaṃ jñānamupalabhyate | ātmanā saha manassamādhīyata iti samādhiḥ sā smṛtā |
analyzed: asmin brahmaṇi grahītum yogyaḥ jīvaḥ tasya paramātma viṣayaka tvena brahma sattā svayam jagastva rūpa kāraṇatvena prakāśyate iti satyam brahma manasā api aviṣayaḥ bhavati guṇa rahita brahmaṇaḥ manaḥ grāhya tvasya vaktum aśakya tvāt sattā iti sattā mātra viṣayakam jñānam upalabhyate ātmanā saha manaḥ samādhīyate iti samādhiḥ sā smṛtā

original: nanu nirguṇabrahmaṇaḥ jagatkārakatvaṃ vaktumayogyamiti cet, na, nirguṇabrahmaṇaḥ karacaraṇādyavayavābhāvāt na jagatsvarūpatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate | tathā śrutau tastvarūpaṃ pratipādyate--
analyzed: nanu nirguṇa brahmaṇaḥ jagat kāraka tvam vaktum ayogyam iti ced na nirguṇa brahmaṇaḥ kara caraṇa ādi avayava abhāvāt na jagat svarūpa tvam vaktum śakyate tathā śrutau tastva rūpam pratipādyate
etam manaḥ mayam ātmānam upasaṅkrāmati
etam vijñāna mayam ātmānam upasaṅkrāmati

original: etacchrutyanusāreṇa jagastvarūpatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyate, parabrahmaṇaḥ nirguṇatvaṃ pratipādyate | śuddhanirguṇapakṣe yogināmapyagocaratvena samādhireva na syāt | kiṃ ca manasaḥ ātmagocaratvānupapattiśca | jagato'nityatvena tasyāpyanityatvaprasaṅgāt, iti nāśaṅkanīyam, jīvātmano māyāśabalitatvena tathā pratīteḥ |
analyzed: etad śruti anusāreṇa brahmaṇaḥ pratipādyate para brahmaṇaḥ nirguṇa tvam pratipādyate śuddha nirguṇa pakṣe yoginām api agocara tvena samādhiḥ eva na syāt kim ca manasaḥ ātma gocara tva anupapattiḥ ca jagataḥ nitya tvena tasya api anitya tva prasaṅgāt iti na āśaṅkanīyam jīvātmanaḥ māyā śabalita tvena tathā pratīteḥ

original: atastu māyānivṛttiparyantaṃ vastubhedo'sti | sarvathā yasya samādhinā māyā na nivartate tāvatparyantaṃ vastubhedo nāsti, tatsamādhinā māyānivṛtteḥ | yadā manasa ātmasākṣātkāro'sti tadā ātmano manoviṣakatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ | yadā jīvātmani māyānivṛttirupalabhyate tasya parabrahma jagadākāreṇa pariṇamati |
analyzed: atas tu māyā nivṛtti paryantam vastu bhedaḥ asti sarvathā yasya samādhinā māyā na nivartate tāvat paryantam vastu bhedaḥ na asti tad samādhinā māyā nivṛtteḥ yadā manasaḥ ātma sākṣātkāraḥ usti tadā ātmanaḥ manaḥ viṣaka tvasya vaktum śakya tvāt iti arthaḥ yadā jīvātmani māyā nivṛttiḥ upalabhyate tasya para brahma jagat ākāreṇa pariṇamati

original: ayaṃ ghaṭa ityatra ghaṭajñānaviṣayakatvamiva nirguṇabrahma manoviṣayakaṃ bhavati | saiva pramā bhavati | ata evoktaṃ "sā smṛtā" iti | prakṛtireva smṛtetyarthaḥ | sarveṣāṃ mokṣahetussamādhiḥ | tasya sarveṣāmasambhāvitatvāt tatpramāphalakasāmagryā abhāvācca |
analyzed: ayam ghaṭaḥ iti atra ghaṭa jñāna viṣayaka tvam iva nirguṇa brahma manaḥ viṣayakam bhavati sā eva pramā bhavati atas eva uktam sā smṛtā iti prakṛtiḥ eva smṛtā iti arthaḥ sarveṣām mokṣa hetuḥ samādhiḥ tasya sarveṣām asambhāvita tvāt tad pramā phalaka sāmagryāḥ abhāvāt ca

original: teṣāṃ madhurarasavaddravyādanasya sātvikaguṇapradāyakatvāt sātvikaguṇassamādhihetuḥ, rājasatāmasaguṇajanakāmloṣaṇarasavyatiriktasātvikaguṇahetumadhurarasajanyatvāt | tasmānmadhurarasa eva samādhiheturityata āha-- madhureti |
analyzed: teṣām madhura rasa vat dravya adanasya sātvika guṇa pradāyaka tvāt sātvika guṇaḥ samādhi hetuḥ rājasa tāmasa guṇa janaka amloṣaṇa rasa vyatirikta sātvika guṇa hetu madhura rasa janya tvāt tasmāt madhura rasaḥ eva samādhi hetuḥ iti atas āha madhura iti
madhura rasaḥ pūrayan aṅguṣṭham ca samāśritaḥ

original: madhurarasastu rasāsṛgdhātucarapavanasya avikāraṃ kurvan kuṇḍalīsthitaḥ śvāsocchvāsābhyāṃ śiraḥkamalasthāmṛtamāhṛtya āpādamastakaṃ tarpayan iḍāmārgagamanena pavanena kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhaparyantaṃ sañcārya tattadaṅgaṃ prasiñcedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: madhura rasaḥ tu rasa asṛj dhātu cara pavanasya avikāram kurvan kuṇḍalī sthitaḥ śvāsa ucchvāsābhyām śiraḥ kamala stha amṛtam āhṛtya āpādamastakam tarpayan iḍā mārga gamanena pavanena kumbhakam kṛtvā aṅguṣṭha paryantam sañcārya tat tat aṅgam prasiñcet iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kalā prabalā satī madhurasajanyapavanasya śvāsocchvāsānilābhyāṃ śirassthitāmṛtamāhṛtya śirassantarpaṇaṃ vidhatta iti vaktavyam | kalā abalā satī tena āpādamastakasantarpaṇena dhātupoṣaṇaṃ kathaṃ vidhatta ityasvarasādāha-- tatreti |
analyzed: nanu kalā prabalā satī madhu rasa janya pavanasya śvāsa ucchvāsa anilābhyām śiraḥ sthita amṛtam āhṛtya śiraḥ santarpaṇam vidhatte iti vaktavyam kalā abalā satī tena āpāda mastaka santarpaṇena dhātu poṣaṇam katham vidhatte iti asvarasāt āha tatra iti
tatra sthita kalā daśa dala kamalam vikāsayantī pracalati
kuṇḍalī udbhava pitta kalā ādhāra daśa dala padmam vikāsayantī amṛtam visṛjati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu pavanastu śiraḥkamalasthāmṛtamāhṛtya dhātusantarpaṇaṃ karotītyuktam | idaṃ tu samādhisāmagrīsampādanaprakaraṇam | samādhiphalaṃ tu ātmasākṣātkārānubhavarūpam | tatsāmagrī śarīravikārābhāvakāryaṃ sampādayati | tena ātmasākṣātkāro labhyata ityasvarasaṃ jñāpayan avatārāntaramāha--aṅguṣṭheti |
analyzed: nanu pavanaḥ tu śiraḥ kamala stha amṛtam āhṛtya dhātu santarpaṇam karoti iti uktam idam tu samādhi sāmagrī sampādana prakaraṇam samādhi phalam tu ātma sākṣātkāra anubhava rūpam tad sāmagrī śarīra vikāra abhāva kāryam sampādayati tena ātma sākṣātkāraḥ labhyate iti asvarasam jñāpayan avatāra antaram āha aṅguṣṭha iti
aṅguṣṭha mātraḥ puruṣa uṅguṣṭham ca samāśritaḥ
īśvaraḥ sarvasya jagataḥ śarīram vahati

original: amṛtenāpādamastakaṃ santarpaṇaṃ rogābhāvakāryasampādakasāmagrīpratipāditaśarīradārḍhyajanyaṃ samādhikāryahetukatvāt, yannaivaṃ tannaivaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, ityanumānavidhayā śarīradārḍhyaprayuktayogasampādanena mokṣaprāptirbhavati | "aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣaḥ" ityatra liṅgaśarīraṃ pādamātram | tatra śrutiḥ--
analyzed: amṛtena āpādamastakam santarpaṇam roga abhāva kārya sampādaka sāmagrī pratipādita śarīra dārḍhya janyam samādhi kārya hetuka tvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā ghaṭaḥ iti anumāna vidhayā śarīra dārḍhya prayukta yoga sampādanena mokṣa prāptiḥ bhavati aṅguṣṭha mātraḥ puruṣaḥ iti atra liṅga śarīram pāda mātram tatra śrutiḥ
pādaḥ usya viśvā bhūtāni tri pāda
sya amṛtam divi tripād ūrdhvaḥ udait puruṣaḥ

original: iti | eṣā śrutiḥ aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ pratipādya tiṣṭhati | sa eveśvaro bhavati | so'pīśvaraḥ tripādena divi sthitāmṛtamāhṛtya svaśarīraṃ santarpya jagaccharīramapi vahati | virāḍrūpeśvaragocarajñānasādhaka antarindriyātmagocarajñānasāmagrīsampādanāpekṣayā jagaccharīrātmaviṣayakajñānagocarajñānagrāhakasāmagryā ātmasākṣātkāro bhavedityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: iti eṣā śrutiḥ aṅguṣṭha mātram pratipādya tiṣṭhati saḥ eva īśvaraḥ bhavati saḥ upi īśvaraḥ tripādena divi sthita amṛtam āhṛtya sva śarīram santarpya jagat śarīram api vahati virāj rūpa īśvara gocara jñāna sādhaka antar indriya ātma gocara jñāna sāmagrī sampādana apekṣayā jagat śarīra ātma viṣayaka jñāna gocara jñāna grāhaka sāmagryāḥ ātma sākṣātkāraḥ bhavet iti arthaḥ

original: nanu yogināmapi mūlādhāramādibhūtaṃ sakaladhātupoṣakaṃ śvāsocchvāsābhyāṃ śirassthitamamṛtamāhṛtya śarīrasantarpaṇaṃ vidhatte tasya sarvadhāraṇatvāt | yogaṃ vināpi tatkarma kartuṃ śakyata evetya, svarasāntaramāha-- mūleti |
analyzed: nanu yoginām api mūlādhāram ādi bhūtam sakala dhātu poṣakam śvāsa ucchvāsābhyām śiraḥ sthitam amṛtam āhṛtya śarīra santarpaṇam vidhatte tasya sarva dhāraṇa tvāt yogam vinā api tat karma kartum śakyate eva iti svarasa antaram āha mūla iti
mūlādhāram ādi bhūtam sakala dhātu poṣakam

original: mūlādhārasya kuṇḍalinīrūpasya anilānalacakrātmakasya tanniṣṭhaśvāsocchvāsābhyāṃ dhātūnāmṛtādanam | yogābhyāsajanyapavanena mūlādhāramādibhūtaṃ yāvatkālaṃ dhātudārḍhyakaraṇaṃ jaṭharānilapradaṃ cirāyuḥprāpakaṃ yāvadindriyāṇāṃ arthaviṣayakajñānānubhavasārthakaraṇaṃ ca labhyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: mūlādhārasya kuṇḍalinī rūpasya anila anala cakra ātmakasya tad niṣṭha śvāsa ucchvāsābhyām dhātūnām amṛta adanam yoga abhyāsa janya pavanena mūlādhāram ādi bhūtam yāvatkālam dhātu dārḍhya karaṇam jaṭhara anila pradam cira āyuḥ prāpakam yāvat indriyāṇām artha viṣayaka jñāna anubhava sārtha karaṇam ca labhyate iti arthaḥ

original: nanu śarīrapādapaḥ amṛtajalapoṣyopakārakaḥ | amṛtātiviriktavyānapavanasya śarīravyāpakatāvacchedakatvāt | nanu mūlādhārapadmasya sakaladhātupoṣakasakalaśarīravyāpyapavanasaṃyoge sati tatpoṣakatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate, tasya kuṇḍalyādhāramātropayogikatvāt, sarvaśarīravyāpakatvābhāvena tatpoṣakatvamapi na rocata ityasvarasādāha-- sireti |
analyzed: nanu śarīra pādapaḥ amṛta jala poṣya upakārakaḥ amṛta ati virikta vyāna pavanasya śarīra vyāpaka tā avacchedaka tvāt nanu mūlādhāra padmasya sakala dhātu poṣaka sakala śarīra vyāpya pavana saṃyoge sati tad poṣaka tvam vaktum śakyate tasya kuṇḍalī ādhāra mātra upayogika tvāt sarva śarīra vyāpaka tva abhāvena tad poṣaka tvam api na rocate iti asvarasāt āha sirā iti
sirā patha gata pavanaḥ śiraḥ kamala stha amṛtam āharān siñcati

original: sirāmārgeṣu sarvadā sañcārabhūḥ pavano vyānapavanasya mūlādhārasthitatvena tatra sthitāmṛtamāharan śarīraśākhibījotpādakapādapadmamūle pūrvarasāsṛgdhātuṣu caran pavanaḥ prabhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sirā mārgeṣu sarvadā sañcāra bhūḥ pavanaḥ vyāna pavanasya mūlādhāra sthita tvena tatra sthita amṛtam āharan śarīra śākhi bīja utpādaka pāda padma mūle pūrva rasa asṛj dhātuṣu caran pavanaḥ prabhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sakalāmṛtātmakānalānilacakrātmakakuṇḍalyudbhavaprakāśamānaprathamaprayāṇādhigataśvāsāniloṣmaṇo jātāmṛtamāhṛtya ucchvāsānilena tatsarvaṃ saṅgrāhya dhātusantarpaṇaṃ karotīti yattadeva śarīradārḍhyopakārakaṃ bhavatīti vyānavāyunā pādapadmapūrakena kiṃ phalaṃ bhavedityasvarasādāha-- śarīreti |
analyzed: nanu sakala amṛta ātmaka anala anila cakra ātmaka kuṇḍalī udbhava prakāśamāna prathama prayāṇa adhigata śvāsa anila ūṣmaṇaḥ jāta amṛtam āhṛtya ucchvāsa anilena tat sarvam saṅgrāhya dhātu santarpaṇam karoti iti yat tat eva śarīra dārḍhya upakārakam bhavati iti vyāna vāyunā pāda padma pūrakena kim phalam bhavet iti asvarasāt āha śarīra iti
śarīra aṅkura śākhānām ādi bhūtam tathā

original: pañcaśākhaṃ śarīramiti śarīrameva aṅkuraṃ pañcaśākhānvitaṃ mūlādhiṣṭhānapadmādhārabhūtam | tasya śākhā eva avayavā ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pañca śākham śarīram iti śarīram eva aṅkuram pañca śākhā anvitam mūla adhiṣṭhāna padma ādhāra bhūtam tasya śākhāḥ eva avayavāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu mūlādhārapadmameva śarīrāṅkurasya ālavālamityuktam | tat tadaṅgasthitavarṇānāṃ tattadadhiṣṭhānadaivatānāṃ amṛtapoṣakatvabhāvanacalanātmakakarmopakārakaṃ nopapadyata ityata āha-- tattaditi |
analyzed: nanu mūlādhāra padmam eva śarīra aṅkurasya ālavālam iti uktam tat tad aṅga sthita varṇānām tad tad adhiṣṭhāna daivatānām amṛta poṣaka tva bhāvana calana ātmaka karma upakārakam na upapadyate iti atas āha tat tat iti
tad tad adhiṣṭhāna varṇa devatānām sirā mārga gata amṛtam poṣakam

original: tattaddevatātmakaṃ akārādikṣakārāntaṃ tattadaṅgādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhitam | tasya tattatsirāmārgagatāmṛtaṃ poṣakaṃ bhavati | tasya āpādamastakaṃ sañcāritavyānapavano'pi poṣako bhavati | avarṇotpādakapādapadmaṃ śākhāvelārūpam | tāvatparyantaṃ sahasrārapadmagatāmṛtaṃ rakṣakaṃ bhavatītyāha-- taditi |
analyzed: tat tat devatā ātmakam akāra ādi kṣakāra antam tat tat aṅga adhiṣṭhāna dhiṣṭhitam tasya tat tat sirā mārga gata amṛtam poṣakam bhavati tasya āpādamastakam sañcārita vyāna pavanaḥ api poṣakaḥ bhavati avarṇa utpādaka pāda padmam śākhā velā rūpam tāvat paryantam sahasrāra padma gata amṛtam rakṣakam bhavati iti āha tat iti
tad pāda padma ādhāre sarit pravahati
pāda padma paryantam sirā sandhānam anusṛtya amṛta pravāhaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu kuṇḍalinīgataśvāsocchvāsamahimnā āgatāmṛtasya ādhārapadmālavālaparyantaṃ pravāhakaraṇasyocitatvāt kathaṃ hyādhārapadmaparyantaṃ pravāhakaraṇaṃ nopapadyata ityata āha-- māṃseti |
analyzed: nanu kuṇḍalinī gata śvāsa ucchvāsa mahimnā āgata amṛtasya ādhāra padma ālavāla paryantam pravāha karaṇasya ucita tvāt katham hi ādhāra padma paryantam pravāha karaṇam na upapadyate iti atas āha māṃsa iti
māṃsa anusṛta sirā mārga gata pavanena kalāḥ pūrayan amṛtam secayet

original: tanmārgamanusṛtya iḍāpavanena pādapadmaparyantaṃ secayedityarthaḥ | tena tadadhiṣṭhānasthitavarṇadevatāḥ santoṣya pālayedityarthaḥ | nanu rasāsṛgdhātupavanena amṛtapoṣakatvaṃ taddhātūnāmeveti vaktavyam | taditararaktadhātoramṛtapoṣakatvābhāvena jīvanaṃ nopapadyata ityasvarasādāha-- māṃseti |
analyzed: tad mārgam anusṛtya iḍā pavanena pāda padma paryantam secayet iti arthaḥ tena tad adhiṣṭhāna sthita varṇa devatāḥ santoṣya pālayet iti arthaḥ nanu rasa asṛj dhātu pavanena amṛta poṣaka tvam tad dhātūnām eva iti vaktavyam tad itara rakta dhātoḥ amṛta poṣaka tva abhāvena jīvanam na upapadyate iti asvarasāt āha māṃsa iti
māṃsa anusṛta sirā bhāvāḥ santi

original: iḍāmārgagataśvāsapavanaḥ sahasrārakamalasthāmṛtamāharan māṃsadhātuṃ santarpya śarīrapoṣako bhavatītyarthaḥ | rasāsṛgdhātupavanasya śarīrāṅgavibhāgakāryakārakaniyamasthāpakatvāt māṃsadhātugatasirāṇāṃ aprayojakatvena raktadhātupoṣakatvaṃ pavanasya kathaṃ saṅgacchate |
analyzed: iḍā mārga gata śvāsa pavanaḥ sahasrāra kamala stha amṛtam āharan māṃsa dhātum santarpya śarīra poṣakaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ rasa asṛj dhātu pavanasya śarīra aṅga vibhāga kārya kāraka niyama sthāpaka tvāt māṃsa dhātu gata sirāṇām aprayojaka tvena raktadhātu poṣaka tvam pavanasya katham saṅgacchate

original: pavanasirāsṛgdhātumātrapradānaṃ caran tatpoṣakatvamātrasyaivocitatvāt na raktadhātupoṣako bhavatītyasvarasādāha-- dvīti |
analyzed: pavana sirā asṛj dhātu mātra pradānam caran tad poṣaka tva mātrasya eva ucita tvāt na rakta dhātu poṣakaḥ bhavati iti asvarasāt āha dvi iti
dvi sahasra sirā śākhā vat pāda padma mūlakam

original: dvisahasrasirāśākhinaḥ pādapadmālavālaṃ sirāṅkurāṇāmādhārakaṃ pādapadmaprarohāṅkurāṇāmeva amṛtamāharat dhātupoṣakaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | dvisahasrasirodbhavāṅkurāṇāṃ saptadhātupoṣakatvena śarīrādhārakatvaṃ kathaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- sapteti |
analyzed: dvi sahasra sirā śākhinaḥ pāda padma ālavālam sirā aṅkurāṇām ādhārakam pāda padma praroha aṅkurāṇām eva amṛtam āharat dhātu poṣakam bhavati iti arthaḥ dvi sahasra sirā udbhava aṅkurāṇām sapta dhātu poṣaka tvena śarīra ādhāraka tvam katham syāt iti asvarasāt āha sapta iti
sapta dhātu mayam śarīram

original: ṣaḍrasā ityatra svādvamlalavaṇatiktoṣaṇakaṣāyakāḥ | tataḥ ṣaṭsaṅkhyādravyamāśritya tiṣṭhato guṇavatpoṣakatvasya suprasiddhatvāt | dhāturnāma ‘rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjāśuklāni dhātavaḥ' iti | tato dhātumayaṃ śarīramityuktam ||
analyzed: ṣaṭ rasāḥ iti atra svādu amla lavaṇa tikta ūṣaṇa kaṣāyakāḥ tatas ṣaṣ saṅkhyā dravyam āśritya tiṣṭhataḥ guṇavat poṣaka tvasya su prasiddha tvāt dhātuḥ nāma rasa asṛk māṃsa medaḥ sthi majjā śuklāni dhātavaḥ iti tatas dhātu mayam śarīram iti uktam

original: idānīṃ pratipāditapraśno yogaśāstraṃ bhavati | tanmadhye saptadhātumayaṃ śarīramiti pratipādanaṃ yogābhyāsasyāpi dhātupoṣakatvameva phalamiti dyotanārthaṃ tathā pratipāditam-– āyurbhavatītyarthaḥ | dhātavaḥ rasādipoṣitāḥ śuddharasadravyopajīvakatvāt | tasmāddhātūnāṃ rasādipoṣitatvaṃ suprasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: idānīm pratipādita praśnaḥ yoga śāstram bhavati tad madhye sapta dhātu mayam śarīram iti pratipādanam yoga abhyāsasya api dhātu poṣaka tvam eva phalam iti dyotana artham tathā pratipāditam āyuḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ dhātavaḥ rasa ādi poṣitāḥ śuddha rasa dravya upajīvaka tvāt tasmāt dhātūnām rasa ādi poṣita tvam su prasiddham iti bhāvaḥ
iti āyurvedasya tṛtīya praśnasya bhāṣyam yoga ānanda nātha kṛtam
su prasiddham mahā jana sammatam prati sūtra vyākhyā
na pūrvakam āyurveda bhāṣyam loka upakārakam
saṃpūrṇam
āyurvede caturtha praśnaḥ

original: nanu rasādīnāṃ dhātupoṣakatvaṃ vaktumaśakyam kuṇḍalinīsthitaśvāsochvāsapavanasyaiva amṛtapradatvena pratipāditatvāt | rasādīnāṃ dhātupoṣakatvaṃ kathaṃ syādityasvarasādāha-- gateti |
analyzed: nanu rasa ādīnām dhātu poṣaka tvam vaktum aśakyam kuṇḍalinī sthita śvāsa uchvāsa pavanasya eva amṛta prada tvena pratipādita tvāt rasa ādīnām dhātu poṣaka tvam katham syāt iti asvarasāt āha gata iti
gata āgata amṛta vaśāt āgata samādhi kriyayā yoga sānnidhyam

original: kuṇḍalinyāḥ anilānalacakrātmakatvādeva śvāsapavanasya anilacakrātmakasya prathamaprayāṇagatasya ūṣmarūpatvādeva śiraḥkamalasthāmṛtamāhartuṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ | tasmādamṛtavaśāddhātupoṣakatvaṃ samādhihetukamiti kṛtvā tatkriyayā yogānāṃ sānnidhyaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | tasmādyogasya dhātupoṣakatvaṃ paramparayā pratipāditamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kuṇḍalinyāḥ anila anala cakra ātmaka tvāt eva śvāsa pavanasya anila cakra ātmakasya prathama prayāṇa gatasya ūṣma rūpa tvāt eva śiraḥ kamala stha amṛtam āhartum śakya tvāt iti arthaḥ tasmāt amṛta vaśāt dhātu poṣaka tvam samādhi hetukam iti kṛtvā tad kriyayā yogānām sānnidhyam bhavati iti arthaḥ tasmāt yogasya dhātu poṣaka tvam paramparayā pratipāditam iti bhāvaḥ

original: dhātūnāṃ poṣaṇaṃprati rasādi heturbhavatīti rasādīnāṃ hetutvapratipādanaṃ rasavaddravyādanena bhāvyam, tadannādyadanasya anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dhātupoṣaṇaṃprati hetutvapratipādanāt | samādhayo dhātupoṣakā iti kathaṃ pratipadyata ityasvarasādāha-- tīvreti |
analyzed: dhātūnām poṣaṇam prati rasa ādi hetuḥ bhavati iti rasa ādīnām hetu tva pratipādanam rasavat dravya adanena bhāvyam tat annādyadanasya anvaya vyatirekābhyām dhātu poṣaṇam prati hetu tva pratipādanāt samādhayaḥ dhātu poṣakāḥ iti katham pratipadyate iti asvarasāt āha tīvra iti
tīvra saṃyoga ākhyām āsannaḥ samādhiḥ

original: manasa ātmanididhyāsanasya tīvrasaṃyogatvaṃ nāma itarārthajñānajñāpakasāmagryasamarthitatve sati ātmasamavetatvam | teṣāmātmavi ṣayakaviṣayetarajñānaṃprati hetureva samādhirityarthaḥ | nanu paramātmano vibhutvena manasa ātmanā sākaṃ dhṛḍhatarasaṃskārasya svata eva siddhatvādityasvarasādāha-- saṃvega iti |
analyzed: manasaḥ ātma nididhyāsanasya tīvra saṃyoga tvam nāma itara artha jñāna jñāpaka sāmagrya samarthita tve sati ātma samaveta tvam teṣām ātma viṣayaka viṣaya itara jñānam prati hetuḥ eva samādhiḥ iti arthaḥ nanu paramātmanaḥ vibhu tvena manasaḥ ātmanā sākam dhṛḍhatara saṃskārasya svatas eva siddhatvāt iti asvarasāt āha saṃvegaḥ iti
saṃvegaḥ kriyā hetuḥ dṛḍhatara saṃskāraḥ

original: saṃvego nāma kāraṇam | tasya lakṣaṇaṃ kriyāviśeṣamātravailakṣaṇyaṃ tadavacchedakam | sa eva kriyāheturbhavati dṛḍhatarasaṃskāro'pi bhavatītyarthaḥ | taraśabdena sutarāṃ heturiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: saṃvegaḥ nāma kāraṇam tasya lakṣaṇam kriyā viśeṣa mātra vailakṣaṇyam tad avacchedakam saḥ eva kriyā hetuḥ bhavati dṛḍhatara saṃskāraḥ api bhavati iti arthaḥ tara śabdena sutarām hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ
nanu etat samādhānam anupapannam tathā ca śrutiḥ

original: "annādbhūtāni jāyante jātānyannena vardhante | adyate'tti ca bhūtāni tasmādannaṃ taducyata iti | annamamṛtaṃ tamu jīvātumāhuḥ" iti śruteḥ vidyamānatvāt | etatpramāṇapratipāditasamādheradṛṣṭatvādityasvarasādāha-- gateti |
analyzed: annāt bhūtāni jāyante jātāni annena vardhante ca bhūtāni tasmāt annam tat ucyate iti annam amṛtam tam u jīvātum āhuḥ iti śruteḥ vidyamāna tvāt etad pramāṇa pratipādita samādheḥ adṛṣṭa tvāt iti asvarasāt āha gata iti
gata āgata upāya bhedavatām samādhi phalam ca āsannam

original: atra gatāgataviṣayakajñānamātraṃ na vivakṣitam | annādanābhāve sati dhātupoṣakaśarīrapuṣṭiryasyāsti tasyedaṃ vivakṣitam | te tu paramayogino bhavanti | teṣāmavacchedakaṃ gatāgatopāyabhedajñānavattvam | gatāgatarūpaśvāsochvāsābhyāṃ śarīradārḍhyopāyaṃ, bhidyata iti bhedaḥ annādanājjātajanakayogajanyabheda ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atra gata āgata viṣayaka jñāna mātram na vivakṣitam anna adana abhāve sati dhātu poṣaka śarīra puṣṭiḥ yasya asti tasya idam vivakṣitam te tu parama yoginaḥ bhavanti teṣām avacchedakam gata āgata upāya bheda jñānavattvam gata āgata rūpa śvāsa uchvāsābhyām śarīra dārḍhya upāyam bhidyate iti bhedaḥ anna adanāt jāta janaka yoga janya bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: samādheḥ phalaṃ śarīradārḍhyakaraṇam | śarīreṇa sarvakarmādhikārī bhavati | śarīraṃ satkarmādimokṣahetukaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: samādheḥ phalam śarīra dārḍhya karaṇam śarīreṇa sarva karma adhikārī bhavati śarīram sat karma ādi mokṣa hetukam bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu śvāsochvāsānilayorgatāgatatvasya śarīriṇāṃ svata eva siddhatvāt svatassiddhakarmaṇaḥ viśeṣavidhiṃ vinā kathaṃ śarīradārḍhyakārakatvaṃ kathaṃ vā mokṣopayogikatvaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkyāha--mṛdviti |
analyzed: nanu śvāsa uchvāsa anilayoḥ gata āgata tvasya śarīriṇām svatas eva siddhatvāt svatas siddha karmaṇaḥ viśeṣa vidhim vinā katham śarīra dārḍhya kārakatvam katham vā mokṣa upayogikatvam bhavati iti āśaṅkya āha mṛdu iti
mṛdu madhya atimātra tvāt tatas viśeṣaḥ 5

original: śvāsānilaḥ iḍāmārgaṃ gatvā mandaṃmandaṃ sañcaran śarīraṃ nīrogaṃ karoti | sa eva mokṣahetuko bhavati | tadanantaraṃ madhyamārgaṃ gatvā nābhipradeśaparyantaṃ mandaṃmandaṃ sañcaran śarīradārḍhyakārako mokṣahetukaśca bhavati |
analyzed: śvāsa anilaḥ iḍā mārgam gatvā mandam mandam sañcaran śarīram nīrogam karoti saḥ eva mokṣa hetukaḥ bhavati tad anantaram madhya mārgam gatvā nābhi pradeśa paryantam mandam mandam sañcaran śarīra dārḍhya kārakaḥ mokṣa hetukaḥ ca bhavati

original: atimātragamanena suṣumnāmārgaṃ gatvā atyantamudaramāpūryate cet tasya śarīrapiṅgalāmārgaṃ gatvā śarīrasya niratiśayamokṣahetuko bhavati | tebhyo viśeṣādabhyāsavaśāt prayatnābhāve'pi sarvadā yaḥ kuṃbhakaṃ karoti saḥ arogī bhūtvā rājayogamārgasampādanena sarvakarmaparityāgavān bhavati | tenaiva mokṣaphalamaśnute | tatra śrutiḥ--
analyzed: atimātra gamanena suṣumnā mārgam gatvā atyantam udaram āpūryate ced tasya śarīrapiṅgalā mārgam gatvā śarīrasya niratiśaya mokṣa hetukaḥ bhavati tebhyaḥ viśeṣāt abhyāsa vaśāt prayatna abhāve pi sarvadā yaḥ kuṃbhakam karoti saḥ arogī bhūtvā rājayoga mārga sampādanena sarva karma parityāgavān bhavati tena eva mokṣa phalam aśnute tatra śrutiḥ

original: "saṃnyāsayogādyatayaḥ śuddhasatvāḥ te brahmaloke tu parāntakāle parāmṛtātparimucyanti sarve" iti śrutipramāṇena asaṃśayajñānagocaravānbhūtvā śarīradārḍhyakarmakaraṇadvāreṇa sarvaviṣayabhogānupabhujya tadbhogaviṣayakapadārthānnaśvarāniti vijñāya sarvadā ātmaviṣayakajñānaṃ ihaloke'pi sarvadā paramānandānubhavahetukam | sa eva tato viśeṣa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃnyāsa yoga ādi yatayaḥ śuddha satvāḥ te brahma loke tu parāntakāle para amṛtāt parimucyanti sarve iti śruti pramāṇena asaṃśaya jñāna gocaravān bhūtvā śarīra dārḍhya karma karaṇa dvāreṇa sarva viṣaya bhogān upabhujya tad bhoga viṣayaka padārthān naśvarān iti vijñāya sarvadā ātma viṣayaka jñānam iha loke pi sarvadā paramānanda anubhava hetukam saḥ eva tatas viśeṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: rājayogo'pi bhavati | tasya upāyebhyo mṛdvādibhedabhinnasya upāyavatāṃ viśeṣo bhavatītyāha-- mṛdviti |
analyzed: rājayogaḥ upi bhavati tasya upāyebhyaḥ mṛdu ādi bheda bhinnasya upāyavatām viśeṣaḥ bhavati iti āha mṛdu iti
mṛdu madhya atimātrāḥ iti upāya bhedāḥ 6

original: pūrvoktarītyā mṛdumadhyātimātragamanaṃ roganivartakadravyānivṛttaroganivṛttyartham | ayamevopāyaḥ śarīradārḍhyakarmakaraṇadvārā mokṣaphalaprāpako bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pūrva ukta rītyā mṛdu madhya atimātra gamanam roga nivartaka dravya anivṛtta roga nivṛtti artham ayam eva upāyaḥ śarīra dārḍhya karma karaṇa dvārā mokṣa phala prāpakaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu yattu trayāṇāṃ mārgāṇāṃ śarīradārḍhyakarmakaraṇaparyantamapi upāyo bhavatītyuktaṃ tato'dhikamārgaparyantagamanamapi upāyo bhavatītyāha-- mṛdviti |
analyzed: nanu yat tu trayāṇām mārgāṇām śarīra dārḍhya karma karaṇa paryantam api upāyaḥ bhavati iti uktam tatas adhika mārga paryanta gamanam api upāyaḥ bhavati iti āha mṛdu iti
mṛdu saṃyāgaḥ madhyama saṃyogaḥ tīvra saṃyogaḥ ca

original: iḍāmārgagamanamandānilenāpi kuṇḍalyudbodhakaraṇaṃ upāyo bhavati | evaṃ suṣumnāmārgagamanapavanena kuṇḍalīsaṃsargajātakuṇḍalyudbodhakarmaṇā ca mākṣopāyo bhavati | taccharīradārḍhyasampādanasāmagrī upāyo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: iḍā mārga gamana manda anilena api kuṇḍalī udbodha karaṇam upāyaḥ bhavati evam suṣumnā mārga gamana pavanena kuṇḍalī saṃsarga jāta kuṇḍalī udbodha karmaṇā ca mākṣā upāyaḥ bhavati tad śarīra dārḍhya sampādana sāmagrī upāyaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: tattriguṇahetukānilānāṃ śarīradārḍhyakaraṇamātrasyāprayojakatvāt tadguṇopāyavyatiriktakarmaṇā yogāgnisandhukṣaṇena bahujanmārjitapāpasaṅghātaṃ bhasmīkṛtya mokṣaheturbhavatītyāha-- tridheti |
analyzed: tad triguṇa hetuka anilānām śarīra dārḍhya karaṇa mātrasya aprayojaka tvāt tad guṇa upāya vyatirikta karmaṇā yoga agni sandhukṣaṇena bahu janma arjita pāpa saṅghātam bhasmīkṛtya mokṣa hetuḥ bhavati iti āha tridhā iti
tridhā bhedanena vāyoḥ nava yoginaḥ bhavanti

original: pavanasya trividhavikāratvaphalaṃ kriyate | mṛdupavanasya saṃyogaḥ mṛdupavanakuṇḍalīsaṃyogaḥ | madhyamavegapavanasya kuṇḍalīsaṃyogaḥ | tīvragatimārgānilasya kuṇḍalīsaṃyogaḥ tīvrasaṃyogaḥ |
analyzed: pavanasya trividha vikāra tva phalam kriyate mṛdu pavanasya saṃyogaḥ mṛdu pavana kuṇḍalī saṃyogaḥ madhyama vega pavanasya kuṇḍalī saṃyogaḥ tīvra gati mārga anilasya kuṇḍalī saṃyogaḥ tīvra saṃyogaḥ

original: madhyamānilasya saṃyogaḥ nābherūrdhvapradeśasthaṃ hṛtkamalaparyantaṃ āgatya tatrasthasya niruddhapavanasya antaḥpadamārgamavalambya gacchataḥ ātmani samavasthānam | sa eva samādhiḥ | ātmajñānasambhavāllabhyate | sa eva madhyamasaṃyogaḥ | tīvrasaṃyogaḥ tadupari śiraḥkamalaparyantam |
analyzed: madhyama anilasya saṃyogaḥ nābheḥ ūrdhva pradeśa stham hṛd kamala paryantam āgatya tatrasthasya niruddhapavanasya antar pada mārgam avalambya gacchataḥ ātmani samavasthānam saḥ eva samādhiḥ ātma jñāna sambhavāt labhyate saḥ eva madhyama saṃyogaḥ tīvra saṃyogaḥ tad upari śiraḥ kamala paryantam

original: tadupari suṣumnāmārgādāgatapavanagatihetukaṃ sirāmārgapūraṇaṃ sakalaśarīrāṇāmāyuṣkārakam , tatkarmaṇaḥ sakalaśarīropakārakatvāt | śarīrārogyakaraṇārthaṃ navaprakāro bhūtvā śarīraṃ saṃrakṣatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad upari suṣumnā mārgāt āgata pavana gati hetukam sirāmārga pūraṇam sakala śarīrāṇām āyuṣkārakam tad karmaṇaḥ sakala śarīra upakāraka tvāt śarīra ārogya karaṇa artham nava prakāraḥ bhūtvā śarīram saṃrakṣati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bahiḥpavanaṃ iḍāpiṅgalāsuṣumnāmārgamāvṛtya udaramāpūrya śarīrārogyamātropakārakaḥ samādhiḥ tasya calanasya pradhānāṅgopakārakatvābhāvāt | calanātmakapavanasya sirāpūraṇamātraprayojakatvena "ete jaṅgamāḥ" iti kathaṃ vaktuṃ śakyata ityasvarasādāha-- pañceti |

analyzed: kaṭu amla lavaṇa rasāḥ tad virasāḥ ca pitta prakopa kārakāḥ tad virasāḥ tad janya pāṇḍu śopha visarpa kārakāḥ tad virasa adana janya āma doṣaḥ pāṇḍu śobhā visarpa roga kārakaḥ tad vikāraḥ āmāśayam prāpya sirā randhrāt ūrdhva mārgam avagamya hṛd gataḥ pavana gati vikāra kāraka tvāt tad vyāpya sirā vikāra kāraka tvāt tad gata rakta pradūṣaṇāt tat vyāpya sthitaḥ ssan pāṇḍu rūpam labhate

original: tadāmarūpatvātpittaṃ hṛdayasthitāmapittasāraṃ sirārandhrabhāgamāpūrya pakvāśaye srāvitatvāt tatpakvasārasyaiva mūtratvāt hṛtkamalaṃ praviśya tatraiva sthitaṃ hṛdi spandanaṃ karoti | dvisirāvṛtapadmādhārajihvāpraveśanātpittasya tatsirārandhrapraveśanāt jihvāyāmarucirdṛśyate |
analyzed: tad āma rūpa tvāt pittam hṛdaya sthita āma pitta sāram sirā randhra bhāgam āpūrya pakvāśaye srāvita tvāt tad pakva sārasya eva mūtra tvāt hṛd kamalam praviśya tatra eva sthitam hṛdi spandanam karoti dvi sirā āvṛta padma ādhāra jihvā praveśanāt pittasya tad sirā randhra praveśanāt jihvāyām aruciḥ dṛśyate

original: hṛdayasthitāmapittasāraṃ sirārandhrabhāgamāpūrya pakvāśaye srāvitatvāt tatpakvasārasyaiva mūtratvāt pācakapittābhāvo bhāsate | taddhātupraveśanamapi tadātmatvena tatpūrvavarṇe vihāya pītavarṇaṃ bhāsate| tatpañcāśatsirārandhradhamanīṃ sampūrya akṣipadmaṃ praviśati | tatra pītatvaṃ pratīyate |
analyzed: hṛdaya sthita āma pitta sāram sirā randhra bhāgam āpūrya pakvāśaye srāvita tvāt tad pakva sārasya eva mūtra tvāt pācaka pitta abhāvaḥ bhāsate tad dhātu praveśanam api tad ātma tvena tad pūrva varṇe vihāya pīta varṇam bhāsate tat pañcāśat sirā randhra dhamanīm sampūrya akṣi padmam praviśati tatra pīta tvam pratīyate

original: śatasirārandhradhamanīṣu pittasārapraveśanāt tacchākhāṅgulīṣu kṛṣṇāruṇakanakapītadatvena tatpūrvavarṇaṃ vihāya pītavarṇaṃ bhāsate | tatrastharaktaṃ bahuvarṇaṃ bhāsate | nābhyāvṛttacakrādhārakuṇḍalyādhārabhūtānīlātmakanābhyāvṛttapadmahṛdgatāmapittasāraḥ nābhyāvṛttacakrādhāratriṃśatsirābhyantaramārgeṣu praviśan tāvadvikārān janayatītyāha--bhrameti |
analyzed: śata sirā randhra dhamanīṣu pitta sāra praveśanāt tad śākhā aṅgulīṣu kṛṣṇa aruṇa kanaka pīta da tvena tad pūrva varṇam vihāya pīta varṇam bhāsate tatrastha raktam bahu varṇam bhāsate nābhi āvṛtta cakra ādhāra kuṇḍalī ādhāra bhūta ānīla ātmaka nābhi āvṛtta padma hṛd gata āma pitta sāraḥ nābhi āvṛtta cakra ādhāra triṃśat sirā abhyantara mārgeṣu praviśan tāvat vikārān janayati iti āha bhrama iti

original: avarṇādibhūtapādapadmasya catustriṃśatsirāvṛtālavālaṃ tadāmapittātisāraṃ śiraḥkamalādāgatāmṛtanirodhanādāmapittātisārapradarśanāt śobhapāṇḍuvisarpāmayacihnajñāpakaṃ bhavati | virasādanavikāravitpavano rasāsṛgdhātugataścet pāṇḍurūpavikāraṃ bhajate | sa eva pavano māṃsadhātugataścet śvayathurbhavati | sa eva dhātugataścet visarpāmayo jāyate |
analyzed: avarṇa ādi bhūta pāda padmasya catustriṃśat sirā āvṛta ālavālam tat āmapitta atisāram śiraḥ kamalāt āgata amṛta nirodhanāt āmapitta atisāra pradarśanāt śobha pāṇḍu visarpa āmaya cihna jñāpakam bhavati virasa adana vikāra vid pavanaḥ rasa asṛj dhātu gataḥ ced pāṇḍu rūpa vikāram bhajate saḥ eva pavanaḥ māṃsa dhātu gataḥ ced śvayathuḥ bhavati saḥ eva dhātu gataḥ ced visarpa āmayaḥ jāyate

original: yasya pāde vikāro jāyate tatpradeśasthāvarṇoccāraṇaṃ spaṣṭoccāraṇavadaśrāvyam | tatpradeśe śvayathudarśanaṃ vā pāṇḍuśobhavisarpāmayā vā jñātavyāḥ |

original: avarṇasthānabhūtajānupadmādhārakaṃ catustriṃśatsirāvṛtajānupadmālavālaṃ śvāsocchāsābhyāṃ śiraḥkamalasthāmṛtopaharaṇamārgaṃ rasavirasajanyāmapittasārasaṃskāraṃ tatsirāmārgagatapavanavivṛtyā pūrvavatpāṇḍuśobhavisarpāmayāḥ | rasāsṛgdhātudūṣaṇātpāṇḍutvam | māṃsadhātudūṣaṇācchvyathudarśanam | medodhātudūṣaṇādvisarparogāḥ prādurbhavantītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: avarṇa sthāna bhūta jānu padma ādhārakam catustriṃśat sirā āvṛta jānu padma ālavālam śvāsa ucchāsābhyām śiraḥ kamala stha amṛta upaharaṇa mārgam rasa virasa janya āma pitta sāra saṃskāram tad sirāmārga gata pavana vivṛtyā pūrvavat pāṇḍu śobha visarpa āmayāḥ rasa asṛj dhātu dūṣaṇāt pāṇḍu tvam māṃsa dhātu dūṣaṇāt śvyathu darśanam medaḥ dhātu dūṣaṇāt visarpa rogāḥ prādurbhavanti iti arthaḥ

original: tattadvarṇādhārakapadmamāplāvya tattadvarṇānubhavajñānadvārā aikārajñāpakapavanaḥ tasya poṣako bhavati | tikterasābhivardhitapittadoṣaḥ nābheradhassthitadaśadalapadmaṃ svādhāraṃ kṛtvā pavanahṛtāmṛtaṃ svādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ daśadalapadmamāplāvya halādivarṇānāṃ śrotrapradeśaṃ prāpayan tiktarasaḥ māṃsamedodhātupoṣako bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad tad varṇa ādhāraka padmam āplāvya tad tad varṇa anubhava jñāna dvārā aikāra jñāpaka pavanaḥ tasya poṣakaḥ bhavati tikte rasa abhivardhita pitta doṣaḥ nābheḥ adhas sthita daśa dala padmam svādhāram kṛtvā pavana hṛta amṛtam svādhiṣṭhāna bhūtam daśa dala padmam āplāvya hala ādi varṇānām śrotra pradeśam prāpayan tikta rasaḥ māṃsa medaḥ dhātu poṣakaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu acassapta svarāḥ santaḥ sarandhrakābhyantaradharasirāmārgebhyaḥ śrotrapradeśaṃ prasarantaḥ svarāśśrūyante | pādapadmamārabhya bījapārśvapadmaparyantaṃ pavanasthānamiti | ata eva calanātmakaṃ karma kurute | jaṅghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo'smīti śarīrāpagamāgamau bhavataḥ | tadevaṃ calanātmakagatāgatabhedaṃ pavana eva kurute |
analyzed: nanu a caḥ sapta svarāḥ santaḥ sarandhraka abhyantara dhara sirā mārgebhyaḥ śrotra pradeśam prasarantaḥ svarāḥ śrūyante pāda padmam ārabhya bīja pārśva padma paryantam pavana sthānam iti atas eva calana ātmakam karma kurute jaṅghābhyām padbhyām dharmaḥ asmi iti śarīra apagama āgamau bhavataḥ tat evam calana ātmaka gata āgata bhedam pavanaḥ eva kurute

original: tenaiva sa pracarati | bījapārśvapadmamārabhya hastapadmaparyantaṃ kacaṭatapavargapañcakasya tattatpadmādhiṣṭhitatvāt |
analyzed: tena eva sa pracarati bīja pārśva padmam ārabhya hasta padma paryantam ka ca ṭa ta pa varga pañcakasya tad tad padma adhiṣṭhita tvāt

original: sarandhrakābhyantaragatapavanastu svābhimānapadmeṣu sthitvā acāṃ varṇānāṃ tattadvarṇasandhyuccāraṇārthaṃ supadaprayogoccāraṇārthaṃ tatpadasamūhavākyoccāraṇārthaṃ svābhipretārthabodhanārthaṃ padavākyaprayogavyatirekeṇa svasyāparasya bodhayitumaśakyatvāt | tasmādajbhiḥ sākaṃ halādayaḥ svābhipretārthaṃ pareṣāṃ vibodhayituṃ śaknuvanti |
analyzed: sarandhraka abhyantara gata pavanaḥ tu sva abhimāna padmeṣu sthitvā a cām varṇānām tad tad varṇa sandhi uccāraṇa artham su pada prayoga uccāraṇa artham tad pada samūha vākya uccāraṇa artham sva abhipreta artha bodhana artham pada vākya prayoga vyatirekeṇa svasya aparasya bodhayitum aśakya tvāt tasmāt ajbhiḥ sākam ha l ādayaḥ sva abhipreta artham pareṣām vibodhayitum śaknuvanti

original: ata eva śabdaśāstre vaiyākaraṇaiḥ prathamata eva pratipāditaṃ--
analyzed: atas eva śabda śāstre vaiyākaraṇaiḥ prathamatas eva pratipāditam

original: "vṛddhirādaic, adeṅ guṇaḥ, iko guṇavṛddhī" etatsūtratrayasyārthe mahābhāṣye sarvaṃ prapañcitam | tatra yatpratipāditārthaṃ ajbhiḥ sākaṃ halādayaḥ kāryakārakā bhavanti |
analyzed: vṛddhiḥ ā t ai c a t e ṅ guṇaḥ i kaḥ guṇa vṛddhī etad sūtra trayasya arthe mahābhāṣye sarvam prapañcitam tatra yat pratipādita artham a cbhiḥ sākam ha l ādayaḥ kārya kārakāḥ bhavanti

original: pittadoṣābhimānakukṣisthitatattatpadmasthitavargapañcakavarṇānāṃ tattatsirāgatapavanaḥ svābhimānabhūtājyavarṇān yathāvidhi śāstrapratipāditārthān bodhayituṃ svarasahitahalādīn sirāsyadoṣagatijātaśabdaḥ karṇayoḥ prapadyata iti | pittapradeśapadmasthitavarṇān pavana eva prāpayatītyāha--tikteti |
analyzed: pitta doṣa abhimāna kukṣi sthita tad tad padma sthita varga pañcaka varṇānām tad tad sirā gata pavanaḥ sva abhimāna bhūta ājya varṇān yathāvidhi śāstra pratipādita arthān bodhayitum svara sahita hala ādīn sirā āsya doṣa gati jāta śabdaḥ karṇayoḥ prapadyate iti pitta pradeśa padma sthita varṇān pavanaḥ eva prāpayati iti āha tikta iti

original: tiktarasābhivardhitaṃ medodhātusthitadaśadalapadmaṃ kaṭipradeśagatam | sahasrasirādāgatāmṛtaṃ tasya tatpoṣakam | tiktarasādhikakaphapradeśāmṛtaṃ tatra doṣajanyam | piṅgalāmārgādāgatapavananirodhanaṃ subheṣajaṃ supoṣakam || 44 ||
analyzed: tikta rasa abhivardhitam medaḥ dhātu sthita daśa dala padmam kaṭi pradeśa gatam sahasra sirā dāgata amṛtam tasya tat poṣakam tikta rasa adhika kapha pradeśa amṛtam tatra doṣa janyam piṅgalā mārgāt āgata pavana nirodhanam su bheṣajam su poṣakam

tikta rasa dravya adana saṃskāra janya guṇāḥ tad tad viruddha adana rasa janya roga vaśāt svastha uccāraṇa adhīna varṇa ātmaka pada samūha vākya śravaṇam tad tad padma adhiṣṭhita roga vijñāna hetukam bhavati

tālu oṣṭha vyāpāra adhīna varṇa uccāraṇa hetu bhūta tad tad padma sthita roga janaka sāmagryā yāvat hīna varṇa uccāraṇa janya varṇa ākāram vijñāya kapha vikāra hetuka svādu amla rasavat dravya ādhikya adana janya kapha rogasya tad nivartaka amṛtam piṅgalā mārgāt āgata pavana nirodhana janya amṛtam su bheṣajam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: hīnavarṇoccāraṇahetukatadrogasya tannivartakadravyābhāve'pi bahiḥ pavanarecanaṃ tatpūraṇaṃ ca nivartakaṃ bhavatītyāha--bahiriti |
analyzed: hīna varṇa uccāraṇa hetuka tad rogasya tad nivartaka dravya abhāve pi bahis pavana recanam tad pūraṇam ca nivartakam bhavati iti āha bahis iti
bahis pavanam recayet tam eva pūrayet
asya phalam āha tasmāt iti
tasmāt cira āyuḥ bhavati 46

original: nanu etatsarvaṃ na saṃsṛjya ghaṭate | talvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpārasāmagryāṃ satyāṃ vāñchitārthaḥ śrotrapradeśagataśabdajanitavākyaśravaṇena tatpadārthaḥ vākyaviṣayo bhavati | na tatpadmādhiṣṭhitavarṇasirābhireva jñāpyate, gauravāt | "yaddhi manasā dhyāyati tadvācā vadati, tatkarmaṇā karoti" iti śrutirevātra pramājñāpikā |
analyzed: nanu etat sarvam na saṃsṛjya ghaṭate talva oṣṭha puṭa vyāpāra sāmagryām satyām vāñchita arthaḥ śrotra pradeśa gata śabda janita vākya śravaṇena tad padārthaḥ vākya viṣayaḥ bhavati na tat padma adhiṣṭhita varṇa sirābhiḥ eva jñāpyate gauravāt yat hi manasā dhyāyati tat vācā vadati tat karmaṇā karoti iti śrutiḥ eva atra pramā jñāpikā

original: kiṃca ‘akuhavisarjanīyānāṃ kaṇṭhaḥ |icuyaśānāṃ tālu | upūpadhmānīyānāmoṣṭhau | ṛṭuraṣāṇāṃ mūrdhā | lṛtulasānāṃ dantāḥ" ityādivārtikavacanānāṃ vidyamānatvāt tattatpadmādhiṣṭhitavarṇān śrotrapradeśaṃ prāpayituṃ tattatsirāṇāṃ tatsāmāgryabhāvādityasvarasādāha--candreti |
analyzed: kiṃca a kuha visarjanīyānām kaṇṭhaḥ tālu up upadhmānīyānām oṣṭhau ṛ ṭu ra ṣāṇām mūrdhā lṛ tu lasānām dantāḥ ityādi vārtika vacanānām vidyamāna tvāt tad tad padma adhiṣṭhita varṇān śrotra pradeśam prāpayitum tad tad sirāṇām tad sāmāgrya bhāvāt iti asvarasāt āha candra iti
candra kalā āyata marut pracodita padmam mukulībhavati sūrya kalā gata pavanāt vikasati

original: candrakalā tālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpārasāmagryāṃ satyāṃ candrasvarādāgatapavanena mukulībhavati | etadvarṇotpādakatālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpārasāmagrījanyapavanātsarandhrakābhyantaradharasirāmārgaṃ praviśya tattatpadmādhiṣṭhitavarṇāngṛhītuṃ tatpadmamukulībhāva eva kāraṇaṃ bhavatīti tatsarvaṃ manasi nidhāya tattadvyādhinidānaṃ pūrvasvarādvikṛtasvarāḥ,
analyzed: candra kalā tālu oṣṭha puṭa vyāpāra sāmagryām satyām candra svarāt āgata pavanena mukulībhavati etad varṇa utpādaka tālu oṣṭha puṭa vyāpāra sāmagrī janya pavanāt sarandhraka abhyantara dhara sirā mārgam praviśya tat tat padma adhiṣṭhita varṇān gṛhītum tat padma mukulībhāvaḥ eva kāraṇam bhavati iti tat sarvam manasi nidhāya tat tat vyādhi nidānam pūrva svarāt vikṛta svarāḥ

original: tatpadmādhiṣṭhitarogavijñānahetutvāt ityatra pramāṇaṃ varṇoccāraṇaśravaṇajñānānubhava eva | tadjñānaṃ kīdṛśamityukte anubhavaṃ pṛcchet na tadbodhayituṃ śakyam | kliṣṭoccāraṇaṃ yadā kriyate tasya bījapārśvasthānatvāt tadvyāpārajanakapavanastatsirāmārge sañcaran kava rṇaṃ gṛhītvā śrotrapradeśaṃ gamayati | tadā'tra 'kaḥ' śabdo jāyate |
analyzed: tad padma adhiṣṭhita roga vijñāna hetu tvāt iti atra pramāṇam varṇa uccāraṇa śravaṇa jñāna anubhavaḥ eva tat jñānam kīdṛśam iti ukte anubhavam pṛcchet na tat bodhayitum śakyam kliṣṭa uccāraṇam yadā kriyate tasya bīja pārśva sthāna tvāt tad vyāpāra janaka pavanaḥ tad sirā mārge sañcaran gṛhītvā śrotra pradeśam gamayati tadā atra kaḥ śabdaḥ jāyate

original: tatkarṇavivaraṃ gatvā āvirbhavati | teṣāṃ varṇānāṃ kaṇṭha eva sthānaṃ bhavati | icuyaśādivarṇā api tālupradeśaṃ gatvā āvirbhavanti | lṛtulasā api dantadeśaṃ gatvā āvirbhavantīti paraṃparayā tattatsajātīyā apyāvirbhūtā ityarthaḥ | evaṃ sūryakalā sahāyaṃ kṛtvā tattatpadmaṃ vikāsayantī varṇān janayati |
analyzed: tat karṇa vivaram gatvā āvirbhavati teṣām varṇānām kaṇṭhaḥ eva sthānam bhavati i cu yaśa ādi varṇāḥ api tālu pradeśam gatvā āvirbhavanti lṛ tulasāḥ api danta deśam gatvā āvirbhavanti iti paraṃparayā tad tad sajātīyāḥ api āvirbhūtāḥ iti arthaḥ evam sūrya kalā sahāyam kṛtvā tat tat padmam vikāsayantī varṇān janayati

original: evaṃ candrakalā ca sūryakalā ca tattatpadmānāṃ nimīlanonmīlanaṃ ca karoti | yāvadarthaṃ jānāti tadarthamicchati tāvadarthavaduccāritaśabdo viṣayo bhavatītyevaṃ manasi nidhāya tālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpāraṃ karoti |
analyzed: evam candra kalā ca sūrya kalā ca tad tad padmānām nimīlana unmīlanam ca karoti yāvat artham jānāti tad artham icchati tāvat arthavat uccārita śabdaḥ viṣayaḥ bhavati iti evam manasi nidhāya tālu oṣṭha puṭa vyāpāram karoti

original: tena vāyurutpannassan tajjātīyasirāgatapavanaṃ samprāpya tadvāñchitārthapratipādakavarṇasamūhaṃ padamuddiśya tālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpārasāmagryā ca śabda utpadyata evetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tena vāyuḥ utpannaḥ san tad jātīya sirā gata pavanam samprāpya tad vāñchita artha pratipādaka varṇa samūham padam uddiśya tālu oṣṭha puṭa vyāpāra sāmagryā ca śabdaḥ utpadyate eva iti arthaḥ

original: nanu bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogena yāvatpavanānugataśabdaśśrūyate | tatra vāyossirādivyāpāraṃ vinā sa vāyuśśabdabodhako bhavati | tadvadevātrāpi syāditi cet na | tasyāpi śarīramasti carmapuṭamāvṛtya ākāśābhyantarassan bherīśarīramiti vyapadiśyate | tatra sirāgatapavanabyāpāraṃ vinā śabdotpattiḥ kathaṃ syāt | tadvadeva varṇātmakapadaṃ śrūyate |
analyzed: nanu bherī daṇḍa saṃyogena yāvat pavana anugata śabdaḥ śrūyate tatra vāyoḥ sirā ādi vyāpāram vinā sa vāyuḥ śabda bodhakaḥ bhavati tadvat eva atra api syāt iti ced na tasya api śarīram asti carma puṭam āvṛtya ākāśa abhyantaraḥ san bherī śarīram iti vyapadiśyate tatra sirā gata pavana byāpāram vinā śabda utpattiḥ katham syāt tadvat eva varṇa ātmaka padam śrūyate

original: tatra bherīśabdo jāta iti kathamanubhūyata iti tādṛśārthadhvanyātmakaśabdamātrameva śrūyate | sa varṇātmakaḥ caitanyādhiṣṭhitasirādivyāpāraṃ vinā tasya asaṃbhāvitatvāt | dhvanyātmakaśabdatvāt asyāssāmagryā na tatra tātparyam |
analyzed: tatra bherī śabdaḥ jātaḥ iti katham anubhūyate iti tādṛśa artha dhvanya ātmaka śabda mātram eva śrūyate sa varṇa ātmakaḥ caitanya adhiṣṭhita sirā ādi vyāpāram vinā tasya asaṃbhāvita tvāt dhvanya ātmaka śabda tvāt asyāḥ sāmagryāḥ na tatra tātparyam

original: nanu varṇānāṃ caitanyādhiṣṭhitaśrutiravatvāt tālvoṣṭhapuṭavyāpārasya samānatvāt varṇātmakaśabdaḥ kathaṃ sa syāditi cet manuṣyāṇāmiva paśvādīnāṃ aviralakaṇṭhābhāvatvena varṇātmakaśabdo na śrūyate nārthabodho'pyasti, hitārthamiyaṃ pravṛttirasyāstīti | aviralakaṇṭhatvamevātra prayojakam | tasmāttṛṇādikamāhāro bhavati |
analyzed: nanu varṇānām caitanya adhiṣṭhita śruti rava tvāt tālu oṣṭha puṭa vyāpārasya samāna tvāt varṇa ātmaka śabdaḥ katham sa syāt iti ced manuṣyāṇām iva paśu ādīnām avirala kaṇṭha abhāva tvena varṇa ātmaka śabdaḥ na śrūyate na artha bodhaḥ upi asti hita artham iyam pravṛttiḥ asya asti iti avirala kaṇṭha tvam eva atra prayojakam tasmāt tṛṇa ādikam āhāraḥ bhavati

original: nanu aviralakaṇṭhatvameva varṇātmakaśabdaniṣpattau prayojakam, tarhi aviralakaṇṭhatvaṃ khecarāṇāmapyasti tatra varṇātmakaśabdaniṣpattiḥ kathaṃ na syāt ? manuṣyāṇāmiva aviralakaṇṭhatvasya khecaraṇāmapi samānadharmatvāt | varṇātmakaśabdaḥ kathaṃ nopalabhyate teṣāṃ ? yatkiṃcicchabdāḥ śrūyante |
analyzed: nanu avirala kaṇṭha tvam eva varṇa ātmaka śabda niṣpattau prayojakam tarhi avirala kaṇṭha tvam khecarāṇām api asti tatra varṇa ātmaka śabda niṣpattiḥ katham na syāt manuṣyāṇām iva avirala kaṇṭha tvasya khecaraṇām api samāna dharma tvāt varṇa ātmaka śabdaḥ katham na upalabhyate teṣām yat kiṃcid śabdāḥ śrūyante

original: manuṣyāṇāṃ tadviṣayakajñānābhāve'pi tattajjātīyānāṃ taduccāritaśabdaviṣayakajñānamasti | anyathā teṣāṃ pravṛttireva na syāt | tadanyathānupapattyā śabdaviṣayakajñānaṃ kalpyate |
analyzed: manuṣyāṇām tad viṣayaka jñāna abhāve pi tad tad jātīyānām tad uccārita śabda viṣayaka jñānam asti anyathā teṣām pravṛttiḥ eva na syāt tad anyathā anupapattyā śabda viṣayaka jñānam kalpyate

original: aviralakaṇṭhavajjātimajjantūccāritaśabdā varṇātmakāḥ, tattajjātiviṣayakajantūccāritaśabdajñānapravṛtterupalabhyamānatvāt maduccāritaśabdaviṣayakajñānānusaritapravṛttiviṣayavat | tasmādaviralakaṇṭhavajjātiviśiṣṭajantūnāṃ tattajjātividhivihitaviṣayakajñānānubhavānusaritapravṛtterdṛṣṭatvāt ityāśayaṃ manasi nidhāyāha-- iḍeti |
analyzed: avirala kaṇṭhavat jātimat jantu uccārita śabdāḥ varṇa ātmakāḥ tad tad jāti viṣayaka jantu uccārita śabda jñāna pravṛtteḥ upalabhyamāna tvāt mad uccārita śabda viṣayaka jñāna anusarita pravṛtti viṣaya vat tasmāt avirala kaṇṭhavat jāti viśiṣṭa jantūnām tad tad jāti vidhi vihita viṣayaka jñāna anubhava anusarita pravṛtteḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt iti āśayam manasi nidhāya āha iḍā iti
iḍā piṅgalābhyām pravahati

original: iḍāpiṅgalāpavanavajjātiviśiṣṭajantūccāritaśabdāḥ varṇātmakāḥ, candrasūryakalāgrastatattatpadmādhiṣṭhitavarṇānāṃ nimīlanonmīlanasaṃskārajātaśabdātmakatvāt | paśvādīnāṃ na tathā, ekadā ubhayasvarātmakatvāt | ata eva tṛṇādidravyamapācitamannamatti paśuḥ, ubhayānilānalātmakatvāt | khecarāṇāmapi tathaiva |

original: tiktarasavadviṣataruphalasāraṃ pavanaprakopanivartakam | yatra jalavaddravyādhikyaṃ tatpavanaprakopanivartakaṃ svādurasam | tasyāvacchedakaṃ tiktarasam, jalavaddravyasyāvacchedakatvābhāvāt | jaladravyāvacchedakasvādurasaḥ pavanaprakopakārako bhavati | jalavaddravyādhikarūpekṣukāṇḍasvāduraso'pi pavanaprakopanivartako bhavati |
analyzed: tikta rasa vat viṣa taru phala sāram pavana prakopa nivartakam yatra jalavat dravya ādhikyam tat pavana prakopa nivartakam svādu rasam tasya avacchedakam tikta rasam jalavat dravyasya avacchedaka tva abhāvāt jala dravya avacchedaka svādu rasaḥ pavana prakopa kārakaḥ bhavati jalavat dravya adhika rūpa ikṣu kāṇḍa svādu rasaḥ api pavana prakopa nivartakaḥ bhavati

original: iti tātparye guṇābhāvāt, kiṃ tu pittaprakopanivartakaḥ | tasmājjaladravyaniṣṭhasvādurasaḥ pavanaprakopanivartako bhavati ityāśayavān | samādhatte-- ya iti | ye ye śarīrāssamadravyātmakāḥ tatra tatra kiṃciducitasvādurasaḥ || 57 ||

analyzed: jala dravya āvaya ādhikya abhāva janya śarīra jāta svādu rasaḥ pavana prakopa nivartakaḥ bhavati iti na tātparyam ikṣu kāṇḍa niṣṭha svādu rasasya adhika jala avayava āvṛta śarīra tvena ati śītala dravya tvena tad niṣṭha svādu rasasya madhura tvāt tat pavana prakopa nivartakam na bhavati iti tādṛśa svādu rasaḥ pitta prakopa nivartakaḥ iti tātparyam

original: nanu yatrābdravyāvayavādhikyaṃ taccharīraniṣṭhasvādurasasya atimādhuryāt tatrādhikasvādurasavaddravyasya jalatvasya avacchedakatvāt tadvacchītasparśavattvamapi tasyāvacchedakaṃ bhavati | yatra śītasparśavattvaṃ tatra jalatvaṃ, iti vyāptergṛhītuṃ śakyatvāt |

original: tanniṣṭhapavanaprakopanivṛttyarthaṃ analasaṃyogajanyakāryasaṃskāraviśiṣṭajalaṃ pavanaprakopanivartakamiti tajjalānalasaṃparkavaśāt pavanajanakaśītalaguṇaṃ vihāya tasya analasaṃyogavaśāt tajjalaṃ pavananivartakaṃ kathaṃ bhavet ? tasmādyatrayatrābdravyāvayavādhikyaṃ tatratatra tathā atiśītalasparśavattva mapi saṃbhavati |

original: nanu uṣaḥpānavidhau śuddhajalasevanaṃ sakaladoṣanivartakamiti śāstre pratipāditam, anyathā tatpratipādakaśāstravirodhaḥ syāt | sarvaṃ jagat jalena vinā jīvituṃ na bhavati samartham | tasya svabhāvena "jīvanam" iti naighaṇṭukaiḥ nāma pratipāditam |
analyzed: nanu uṣaḥpānavidhau śuddha jala sevanam sakala doṣa nivartakam iti śāstre pratipāditam anyathā tad pratipādaka śāstra virodhaḥ syāt sarvam jagat jalena vinā jīvitum na bhavati samartham tasya svabhāvena jīvanam iti naighaṇṭukaiḥ nāma pratipāditam

original: tasmājjalaniṣṭhasvādurasaḥ pavanaprakopanivartako bhavatīti yaduktaṃ tanna rocata iti cet na, sthāvarāṇāṃ ca jīvanopakārakatvasya jaladravyasyocitatvāt jaladravyaṃ jīvanaṃ bhavet | jaṅgamānāṃ tu na tathā | teṣāmapi analasaṃyogajanyasaṃskārāt jātajalaniṣṭhasvādurasasya pavanaprakopanivartakatvamityuktatvāt |
analyzed: tasmāt jala niṣṭha svādu rasaḥ pavana prakopa nivartakaḥ bhavati iti yat uktam tat na rocate iti ced na sthāvarāṇām ca jīvana upakāraka tvasya jala dravyasya ucitatvāt jala dravyam jīvanam bhavet jaṅgamānām tu na tathā teṣām api anala saṃyoga janya saṃskārāt jāta jala niṣṭha svādu rasasya pavana prakopa nivartaka tvam iti ukta tvāt

original: tatra uṣaḥpānavidhāvapi haṃsodakakarmakaraṇaviśiṣṭajalaṃ uṣaḥpānāvidhau praśastamityuktatvāt | itaratrāpi analasaṃyogajasaṃskārābiśaṣṭasya jalasya pavananivartakatve analasaṃyotvamupādhiḥ | yatrayatra analasaṃyogajasaṃskāraviśiṣṭajalatvaṃ bhāsate, tatratatra pavananivartakatvamapi saṃbhavati |

original: śuddhaśītalaguṇaviśiṣṭajalasya pavanaprakopakārakatvaniyamāt | śaityaguṇaviśiṣṭajalaniṣṭhasvādurasaḥ na pavanaprakopanivartakaḥ | tatra śrutivacanaṃ pramāṇaṃ-- agnirhimasya bheṣajam" iti | tannivartakavidhau analasaṃyoga evopādhirityarthaḥ
analyzed: śuddha śītala guṇa viśiṣṭa jalasya pavana prakopa kāraka tva niyamāt śaitya guṇa viśiṣṭa jala niṣṭha svādu rasaḥ na pavana prakopa nivartakaḥ tatra śruti vacanam pramāṇam agniḥ himasya bheṣajam iti tad nivartaka vidhau anala saṃyogaḥ eva upādhiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu eva lavaṇarasaḥ abdravyajanyaḥ abvikāradravyatvāt, lavaṇasamudrasyaiva sāgaratvāt | lavaṇaṃ tajjanyaṃ tatpākajanyaṃ sumanoharaṃ sugandhaviśiṣṭāmlarasavaddravyaṃ pavanaprakopanivartakaṃ, apakvaṃ tu na tathā |

original: sugandhaviśiṣṭaguṇābhāvadravyatvāt lavaṇarasasya śoṣakadravyasya kathaṃ pavananivartakatvaṃ kaphanivartakadravyatvāt kaṭurasavat, lavaṇarasasya kaṭurasāntaḥpātitvāt | tatkālaviśiṣṭalavaṇarasaḥ pavanavikāro na bhavati kaṭurasasya analadravyaguṇavattvāt |
analyzed: su gandha viśiṣṭa guṇa abhāva dravya tvāt lavaṇa rasasya śoṣaka dravyasya katham pavana nivartaka tvam kapha nivartaka dravya tvāt kaṭu rasa vat lavaṇa rasasya kaṭu rasa antaḥpāti tvāt tad kāla viśiṣṭa lavaṇa rasaḥ pavana vikāraḥ na bhavati kaṭu rasasya anala dravya guṇavat tvāt

original: svādvamlalavaṇaviśiṣṭadravyāṇi pavanaprakopanivartakāni abdravyaniṣṭhaguṇavaddravyatvāt jambīraphalavat | lavaṇarasaḥ pavanaprakopanivartakaḥ abdravyaguṇavattvāt | na sarvajalaṃ svādurasavattvādeva, svādurasavaddravyebhyaḥ lavaṇadravyotpatterabhāvāt | lavaṇasamudrasya pārthivaśarīrasya saptadhātvātmakatvāt maccharīravat ||

original: nanu kecittaravo'nekasāravanto bhavanti | ekajātīyataruṣu anekabhūtāvayavādhikyasya vaktavyatvāt | tadyathā--śigrujātīyataruṣu bījasāravattvaṃ, patrasāravattvaṃ puṣpasāravattvaṃ mūlatvaksāravattvaṃ mūlasāravattvaṃ, etādṛśasāravantaḥ ete śigrutaravaḥ | yaddravyādhikyāpekṣayā ekasya anekasāravattvaṃ bhāsata ityāha--analeti |

original: analabhūtāvayavādhikyadravyatvāt tadvattvaṃ yatra pratīyate tadvastu analādhikyadravyamiti | yatrayatrādhikarūpopalambhakayāvadyogadravyaṃ yāvadrūpavattvena nayanānandahetukaṃ bhavati tādṛśacākṣuṣadravyaṃ tattsārakam |

original: yāvadudbhūtabhūruhajātarasāt taditaraśarīrabhūtādhīnadhātuśoṣakaruṅnivartakaṃ bheṣajaṃ, ityanumānaracanā kāryahetukavyāptigrahavaśāt tannivartakanivartyayoḥ vyāptigrahe sati sarvatrāpyuttaratrāpi tathā vaktuṃ śakyatvādityarthaḥ |

original: nanu doṣaprakopanivṛttidvārā rasādīnāṃ dhātupoṣakatvaṃ vaktavyam | yāvadbhūtaniṣṭharasāḥ yāvadbhūtāvayavajanyaroganivartakā iti pūrvasūtre pratipāditam | taccintyam | kecidrasāḥ dhātupoṣakāḥ, kecidrasāḥ dhātudūṣakā iti vaktuṃ śakyate | viruddharasādajīrṇe jāte sati tattadvidhicoditarogā āvirbhavanti |
analyzed: nanu doṣa prakopa nivṛtti dvārā rasa ādīnām dhātu poṣaka tvam vaktavyam yāvat bhūta niṣṭha rasāḥ yāvat bhūta avayava janya roga nivartakāḥ iti pūrva sūtre pratipāditam tat cintyam kecid rasāḥ dhātu poṣakāḥ kecid rasāḥ dhātu dūṣakāḥ iti vaktum śakyate viruddha rasāt ajīrṇe jāte sati tad tad vidhi codita rogāḥ āvirbhavanti

original: te tu doṣānugatāssantaḥ dhātugatāścet teṣu tadvikārā āvirbhavanti | yadā aviruddharasādanena doṣā aduṣṭāssantaḥ dhātūnāmavikāraṃ kurvanti, śuddhadoṣāśca dhātūn prāṇāṃśca saṃrakṣanti | te tu duṣṭāścet dhātuprāṇendriyaghātakā bhavanti |

analyzed: rasa ādīn doṣa prakopa kāraka tvam doṣa prakopa nivartaka tvam ca vaktum ucitam iti āśayam manasi nidhāya ṣaṣ rasānām ca tad tad guṇān varṇayati dvi iti

original: dvirasārtha iti svādvamlalavaṇaviśiṣṭadravyaṃ pavanaprakopanivartakam | svādurasavaddravyaṃ pavananivartakaṃ na bhavati, ikṣurasakadalīphalanārikelatālaphaleṣu ca vyabhicārāt | svādurasavattvaṃ āmlarasavattvaṃ ca yasmindrabye yadā pratīyate tatra tadrasavadviśiṣṭadravyaṃ pavananivartakaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: dvi rasa arthaḥ iti svādu amla lavaṇa viśiṣṭa dravyam pavana prakopa nivartakam svādu rasavat dravyam pavana nivartakam na bhavati ikṣu rasa kadalī phala nārikela tāla phaleṣu ca vyabhicārāt svādu rasavat tvam āmla rasavat tvam ca yasmin drabye yadā pratīyate tatra tad rasavat viśiṣṭa dravyam pavana nivartakam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: kevalalavaṇarasavaddravyaṃ pavananivartakaṃ na bhavati, ūṣarabhūmijanyalavaṇarasasya pava nanivartakatvāsambhavāt | sāmudrajaṃ tu na tathā | svādurasatvaṃ jaladravyasyāvacchedakam | tathā sati sāmudrajalavaṇaṃ tu jalasya svabhāvaniṣṭhasvādurasasya tatraivāntarbhāvāt lavaṇarasaviśiṣṭabhūdravyeṇa jalaniṣṭhasvādurasasyābhipūritatvāt |
analyzed: kevala lavaṇa rasavat dravyam pavana nivartakam na bhavati ūṣara bhūmi janya lavaṇa rasasya pava na nivartaka tva asambhavāt sāmudra jam tu na tathā svādu rasa tvam jala dravyasya avacchedakam tathā sati sāmudra ja lavaṇam tu jalasya svabhāva niṣṭha svādu rasasya tatra eva antarbhāvāt lavaṇa rasa viśiṣṭa bhū dravyeṇa jala niṣṭha svādu rasasya abhipūrita tvāt

original: tarhi tathā sati atsti cedupalabhyeta | anupalabhyamānatvāt tannāstīti na vaktavyam | lavaṇaviśiṣṭayogyadravyaṃ vyañjanādidravye rucitayā pratīyate | svāduruciretatsvādutayā pratīteti vyavahartuṃ śakyata evetyarthaḥ | kāścidbhuvaḥ lavaṇarasaviśiṣṭā bhavanti | kāścidbhuvaḥ svādurasaviśiṣṭā bhavanti, tattadbhūmijalakūpādau tathā dṛṣṭatvāt |
analyzed: tarhi tathā sati at sti ced upalabhyeta anupalabhyamāna tvāt tat na asti iti na vaktavyam lavaṇa viśiṣṭa yogya dravyam vyañjana ādi dravye ruci tayā pratīyate svādu ruciḥ etat svādu tayā pratītā iti vyavahartum śakyate eva iti arthaḥ kāścid bhuvaḥ lavaṇa rasa viśiṣṭāḥ bhavanti kāścid bhuvaḥ svādu rasa viśiṣṭāḥ bhavanti tad tad bhūmi jala kūpa ādau tathā dṛṣṭa tvāt

original: yatrayatra lavaṇarasopalabdhiḥ tatratatra tāddaśabhūmijanyatvaṃ tatropādhiḥ| svādujalaviśiṣṭakūpajanyajalaguṇasvādurasasya pratītatvāt tatra lavaṇarasajanakabhūmitvābhāvaviśiṣṭabhūjanyalavaṇatvasya tatra vidyamānatvāt | tatra svādurasapratīteḥ vaktuṃ śakyatvāt |
analyzed: yatra yatra lavaṇa rasa upalabdhiḥ tatra tatra tāddaśa bhūmi janya tvam tatra upādhiḥ svādu jala viśiṣṭa kūpa janya jala guṇa svādu rasasya pratīta tvāt tatra lavaṇa rasa janaka bhūmi tva abhāva viśiṣṭa bhū janya lavaṇa tvasya tatra vidyamāna tvāt tatra svādu rasa pratīteḥ vaktum śakya tvāt

original: saindhavadeśajanyalavaṇarasaviśiṣṭadravyasya śuddhabhūjanyatyāt āmlarasavattvaṃ bhūmeravacchedakam | tatratatra dravyajanyatvādeva pavananivartakatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyata evetyarthaḥ | tatra dvirasārthabhūtadvayadravyaguṇaviśiṣṭatvāt tatra dvirasārthapravṛttiḥ pavananivartiketyarthaḥ |
analyzed: saindhava deśa janya lavaṇa rasa viśiṣṭa dravyasya śuddha bhū janya tyāt āmla rasavat tvam bhūmeḥ avacchedakam tatra tatra dravya janya tvāt eva pavana nivartaka tvam vaktum śakyate eva iti arthaḥ tatra dvi rasa artha bhūta dvaya dravya guṇa viśiṣṭa tvāt tatra dvi rasa artha pravṛttiḥ pavana nivartikā iti arthaḥ

original: rasahīnārtha iti rasahīnadravyaṃ pāradādidravyam | tatra auṣadhādirasānāṃ sarvadā sarvakāle'pratītatvāt | tatra pavananivartakatvaṃ sarvajanasiddhaṃ sarvaśāstramatasiddham pārada ityupalakṣaṇam | raso'varalohādisādhāraṇamahārasa iti pāradaśabdena sarvaṃ saṃgṛhyate | asminpāradadravye rasādaya āvirbhūtā bhavanti |
analyzed: rasa hīna arthaḥ iti rasa hīna dravyam pārada ādi dravyam tatra auṣadha ādi rasānām sarvadā sarva kāle pratīta tvāt tatra pavana nivartaka tvam sarva jana siddham sarva śāstra mata siddham pāradaḥ iti upalakṣaṇam rasovara loha ādi sādhāraṇa mahārasaḥ iti pārada śabdena sarvam saṃgṛhyate asmin pārada dravye rasa ādayaḥ āvirbhūtāḥ bhavanti

original: hīnarasavattvaṃ tvanyadravyasya virekakāritvaṃ suprasiddham | tasya guṇasya pavananivartakatvasya suprasiddhatvāditi bahavaḥ ||
analyzed: hīna rasavat tvam tu anya dravyasya vireka kāri tvam su prasiddham tasya guṇasya pavana nivartaka tvasya su prasiddha tvāt iti bahavaḥ

original: sūtrasthānavacanasyāpīdameva tātparyam | tathāhi avyabhicaritatvaṃ vyāpteravacchedakam | yatra svādurasavattvaṃ tatra pavananivartakatvaṃ ityevamākāreṇa vyāptigrahānantaraṃ anumitau pravṛttiḥ | ikṣukāṇḍasthitasvādurasaḥ pavanaprakopanivartakaḥ, jalabhūmyātmakāvayavagrastatvāt urvārukaphalarasavat |
analyzed: sūtrasthāna vacanasya api idam eva tātparyam tathā hi avyabhicarita tvam vyāpteḥ avacchedakam yatra svādu rasavat tvam tatra pavana nivartaka tvam iti evam ākāreṇa vyāpti graha anantaram anumitau pravṛttiḥ ikṣu kāṇḍa sthita svādu rasaḥ pavana prakopa nivartakaḥ jala bhūmi ātmaka avayava grasta tvāt urvāruka phala rasa vat

original: madhuratvaṃ nāma madhurarasavaddravyātiriktasvādurasavaddravyaṃ pavananivartakam tatkālavaśāt madhurībhūtaṃ bhavati | tatsvādurasavaddravyaṃ pittaprakopanivartakaṃ, tadvirasavaddravyaṃ na bhavati | ekarasajātiviśiṣṭadravyatvāt ekarasadravyameveti |

āmla rasavat dravya jāti viśiṣṭa eka rasavat dravyasya pavana nivartaka tva mātre caritārtha tvāt pavana vyatirikta doṣa nivartaka dravya abhāva dravya tvāt iti atas āha āmla iti

original: āmlarasajātiviśiṣṭadravyasya pākakālavaśāt atyāmlarase jāte sati tasya anyadoṣanivartakatvaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate |

original: nanu lavaṇarasasya pavanaprakopakārakatvaṃ vaktumucitam | kaphaprakopakārakamiti vaktuṃ nopayujyate | kṣāradravyatvācca pavananivartakaṃ bhavedityasvarasādāha-- hīneti |

original: nabha ādityabhūtaśarīrajanyatiktarasasya kaphadoṣaprakopanivartakatvaṃ vaktuṃ nabho'niladravyajanyatvādeva tiktarasasya pavanaprakopakārakatvaṃ kaphapittaroganivartakatvaṃ ca vyācaṣṭe-- tikta iti |

original: tikta iti nabho'nilabhūjanyatiktarasaḥ ākāśasya niravayavadravyatvāt, vāyośca niravayavadravyatvāt ubhābhyāṃ jātaśarīraṃ tiktarasavadbhavati | tiktarasadravyādanaṃ kaphaprakopanivṛttiṃ karoti | yatpratipāditaṃ tatsarvaṃ samyageva pratipāditam |

original: sarve te pavanaprakopanivartakā iti vijñātatvātkathaṃ "mārutaṃ kurute" ityuktamiti nāśaṅkanīyam | tiktarasavirasavaddravyādanaṃ pavanaprakopaṃ kuruta iti tātparyāt | virasadravyādanaṃ nāma viruddharasadravyādanam | tadeva viṣavaddravyādanaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |

anala anila bhūta avayava ādhikya jāta kaṭu rasaḥ kapha prakopa nivartakaḥ iti āha kaṭu iti

original: kaṭurasasya kaphanivartakatvaṃ suprasiddhameva | pittaprakopakārakatvamapi suprasiddhameva | kaṭukāḥ śuddharasāḥ kapharoganivṛttikārakāḥ pittaprakopaṃ ca kurvate | ityetaddvayaṃ suprasiddham | analānilabhūtajanyakaṭurasadravyatvena kaphaprakopaṃ nivartayati, pittaprakopaṃ ca kurute | pavanaprakopanivṛttiṃ ca kurute |
analyzed: kaṭu rasasya kapha nivartaka tvam su prasiddham eva pitta prakopa kāraka tvam api su prasiddham eva kaṭukāḥ śuddha rasāḥ kapha roga nivṛtti kārakāḥ pitta prakopam ca kurvate iti etat dvayam su prasiddham anala anila bhūta janya kaṭu rasa dravya tvena kapha prakopam nivartayati pitta prakopam ca kurute pavana prakopa nivṛttim ca kurute

original: śuṇṭhī rāsnā karṇagranthiḥ cavyaṃ mūlakaṃ tamālapatraṃ ardhakaṃ laśunaṃ hiñgu etāni kaṭurasadravyāṇi bhavanti | pavanaprakopa kārakāṇīti sūtrasiddhamapi etadvirasādanaṃ pavanaprakopaṃ karotīti tātparyam | ata eva sūtrāntaraṃ vyācaṣṭe--kaṭuketi |
analyzed: śuṇṭhī rāsnā karṇagranthiḥ cavyam mūlakam tamālapatram ardhakam laśunam hiñgu etāni kaṭu rasa dravyāṇi bhavanti pavana prakopa kārakāṇi iti sūtra siddham api etat virasa adanam pavana prakopam karoti iti tātparyam atas eva sūtra antaram vyācaṣṭe kaṭuka iti

original: nanu ṣaḍrasadravyāṇāṃ madhye ekarasadravyasya tattadroganivṛttikāryaṃ tattatkarma tattatphalaṃ ca pratipāditam | idānīṃ bahurasadravyāṇāṃ yogakāryasya tattadroganivṛttireva phalaṃ yatra dṛśyate tatra anekarasavaddravyāṇāṃ samūhakāryakārakatvaṃ bhavatīti matvā ekaroganivṛrttyarthamanekarasadravyāṇāmanekatvayaṃtropalabhyate, tatra
analyzed: nanu ṣaṣ rasa dravyāṇām madhye eka rasa dravyasya tad tad roga nivṛtti kāryam tad tad karma tad tad phalam ca pratipāditam idānīm bahu rasa dravyāṇām yoga kāryasya tad tad roga nivṛttiḥ eva phalam yatra dṛśyate tatra aneka rasavat dravyāṇām samūha kārya kāraka tvam bhavati iti matvā eka roga nivṛrtti artham aneka rasa dravyāṇām aneka tva yaṃtrā upalabhyate tatra

original: bahurasavaddravyāṇāṃ ekaroganivartakatvasyāyogyatvāt, tattadvyādhīnāṃ nivartakatvamanekadravyāṇāmiti tattadvyādhinivartakatvāvacchedakatvasya vaktumāyogyatvāt, ekaikadravyasya ekaroganivṛrtakaguṇatvāvacchedakasya bhinnatvāt "bahukalpaṃ bahuguṇam" iti nyāyaśāstramavalambya bahudravyayogakāryakārakatvamuktaṃ cet atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt |
analyzed: bahu rasavat dravyāṇām eka roga nivartaka tvasya ayogya tvāt tad tad vyādhīnām nivartaka tvam aneka dravyāṇām iti tad tad vyādhi nivartaka tva avacchedaka tvasya vaktum āyogya tvāt ekaika dravyasya eka roga nivṛrtaka guṇa tva avacchedakasya bhinna tvāt bahu kalpam bahu guṇam iti nyāya śāstram avalambya bahu dravya yoga kārya kāraka tvam uktam ced atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt

original: ekadravyamekaroganivartakamityarthasya bahuśodṛṣṭatvāt | malanirodhanahetujanyaroge ekasyaiva recakadravyasya tannivartakasāmarthyasya bahudravyeṣu bahuśo dṛṣṭatvāt | tatrāpi bahudravyakalpanāgauravāt ekadravyasyaiva ekaroganivartakasāmarthyasya bahuśo dṛṣṭatvāt ityasvarasādāha-- doṣa iti |
analyzed: eka dravyam eka roga nivartakam iti arthasya bahuśas dṛṣṭa tvāt mala nirodhana hetu janya roge ekasya eva recaka dravyasya tad nivartaka sāmarthyasya bahu dravyeṣu bahuśas dṛṣṭa tvāt tatra api bahu dravya kalpanā gauravāt eka dravyasya eva eka roga nivartaka sāmarthyasya bahuśas dṛṣṭa tvāt iti asvarasāt āha doṣaḥ iti

original: tridoṣahetvanyahetuketyatra tridoṣāṇāṃ vikārābhāvaprāgbhāvaparipālanārthaṃ aviruddharasavaddravyādanasya phalaṃ aniṣṭaparihāra eva bhavati | doṣāṇāṃ svabhāvagatikārakarasavaddravyaṃ doṣāhetukam | doṣapravaṇakāryavadrasavirasadravyādanaṃ vikārakārakam |
analyzed: tridoṣa hetu anya hetuka iti atra tridoṣāṇām vikāra abhāva prāgbhāva paripālana artham aviruddha rasavat dravya adanasya phalam aniṣṭa parihāraḥ eva bhavati doṣāṇām svabhāva gati kāraka rasavat dravyam doṣa ahetukam doṣa pravaṇa kāryavat rasa virasa dravya adanam vikāra kārakam
tad viruddha kārya hetu bhūta yāvat rasavat dravya adanam tat yāvat rasavat dravya eka bhāva ātmaka bahu rasavat dravya adana yogya yoga karaṇam eka vyādhi nivartakam
kvāthya dravya yogya yoga janya rasavat dravya adanam tad tad roga nivartakam bahu dravya yogya yoga janya cūrṇīkṛta dravya rasavat dravya adanam tad tad roga nivartakam

original: tailaghṛtalehyarasāyanādyaiḥ anekaikadravyajanyayogyayogakṛtijanyasaṃskārayuktānekarasadravyādanaṃ yāvadrasaikabhāvātmakaṃ yattadekarasavaddravyaṃ bhavati | tadanekadravyāṇāṃ ekaguṇaphalaṃ prayacchati | kaliyuge saṅghe śaktirbhavatīti, na tu ekasya dravyasya roganivartakaśaktiḥ, kaliyuge abhibhūtatvāt saṅghe śaktirbhavatīti pratipāditam |
analyzed: taila ghṛta lehya rasāyana ādyaiḥ aneka eka dravya janya yogya yoga kṛti janya saṃskāra yukta aneka rasa dravya adanam yāvat rasa eka bhāva ātmakam yat tat eka rasavat dravyam bhavati tat aneka dravyāṇām eka guṇa phalam prayacchati kali yuge saṅghe śaktiḥ bhavati iti na tu ekasya dravyasya roga nivartaka śaktiḥ kali yuge abhibhūta tvāt saṅghe śaktiḥ bhavati iti pratipāditam

original: brāhmaṇāśīrvādavat | ekabrāhmaṇavadanoccāritavākye śakterabhibhūtatvāt teṣāṃ saṅghe śaktirbhavatītivat | tattadrasavadbhūruhāṇāṃ ekasyaiva dṛḍhataraśakterabhāvāt saṅghe śaktirbhaviṣyatīti bahudravyamelanaṃ tattannivartakakāryaphalam | bahuyogajanyasaṃskāra eva tatkratuphalaṃ prayacchati | asminkaliyuge adharmabāhulyāt vyādhayo bahavassaṃbhavanti |
analyzed: brāhmaṇa āśīrvāda vat eka brāhmaṇa vadana uccārita vākye śakteḥ abhibhūta tvāt teṣām saṅghe śaktiḥ bhavati itivat tad tad rasavat bhūruhāṇām ekasya eva dṛḍhatara śakteḥ abhāvāt saṅghe śaktiḥ bhaviṣyati iti bahu dravya melanam tad tad nivartaka kārya phalam bahu yoga janya saṃskāraḥ eva tad kratu phalam prayacchati asmin kali yuge adharma bāhulyāt vyādhayaḥ bahavaḥ saṃbhavanti

original: tataśśarīrāṇāmalpatvāt | tannivartakāni kvacitphalaṃ prayacchanti | kvacitsakalasāmagryāmasatyāmapi tat tatphalaṃ prayacchati | ata evoktaṃ--
analyzed: tatas śarīrāṇām alpa tvāt tad nivartakāni kvacid phalam prayacchanti kvacid sakala sāmagryām asatyām api tat tat phalam prayacchati atas eva uktam
tad śāntiḥ auṣadhaiḥ dānaiḥ japa homa arcana ādibhiḥ iti
asmin yuge bahu sāmagrībhiḥ avaśyam bhāvyam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu idaṃ dravyaṃ etaddravyādanajātaroganivartakamiti, ayaṃ rogaḥ tannivartakakaidravyasādhyaḥ tannivartakaikadravyavattvāt ityanumānavidhayā prāmāṇye sthite sati tatra prajāyate | sā pramā samarthapravṛttisādhiketi tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ niścitya tatra pravartate |
analyzed: nanu idam dravyam etad dravya adana jāta roga nivartakam iti ayam rogaḥ tad nivartaka kaidravya sādhyaḥ tad nivartaka eka dravyavat tvāt iti anumāna vidhayā prāmāṇye sthite sati tatra prajāyate sā pramā samartha pravṛtti sādhikā iti tayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvam niścitya tatra pravartate

original: tatra vyādhinivartakadravyasandehe sati tannivṛttikāryaviṣaye pravṛtterabhāvāt, tayorvyāptigrahasya sutarāmaśakyatvāt, ayaṃ roganivartaka iti niścayajñāne sati tatra pravṛttiḥ, niścitārthe saṃśayābhāvāt, tanniścayasya taddhetutvāt | ekapadārthasya tannivartakatvasandehe sati padārthāntarasaṃgrahapravṛttau atiprasaṃgassyādityasvarasādāha--rasādīti |
analyzed: tatra vyādhi nivartaka dravya sandehe sati tad nivṛtti kārya viṣaye pravṛtteḥ abhāvāt tayoḥ vyāpti grahasya sutarām aśakya tvāt ayam roga nivartakaḥ iti niścaya jñāne sati tatra pravṛttiḥ niścita arthe saṃśaya abhāvāt tad niścayasya tad hetutvāt eka padārthasya tad nivartaka tva sandehe sati padārtha antara saṃgraha pravṛttau atiprasaṃgaḥ syāt iti asvarasāt āha rasa ādi iti
rasa ādi dravya sāra jāḥ sakala āmaya nivartakāḥ

original: rasāsṛṅmāṃsamedomajjāśuklādidhātūnāṃ vikāre jāte sati taddravyaṃ tannivartakamiti niścitya tatra virecanavidhiḥ kārya iti jñāne jāte sati harītakīprayogavidhiḥ kriyate | tādṛśaharītakyadanena tadāgatamalanissaraṇaṃ jāyate | tatra tanniścaye spaṣṭe tvaritavyāptigrahasya sukaratvāt | tatra harītakītyupalakṣaṇam |
analyzed: rasa asṛj māṃsa medaḥ majjā śukla ādi dhātūnām vikāre jāte sati tat dravyam tat nivartakam iti niścitya tatra virecana vidhiḥ kāryaḥ iti jñāne jāte sati harītakī prayoga vidhiḥ kriyate tādṛśa harītakī adanena tad āgata mala nissaraṇam jāyate tatra tad niścaye spaṣṭe tvaritavyāpti grahasya sukara tvāt tatra harītakī iti upalakṣaṇam

original: tadrasaguṇaviśiṣṭadravyajātimātrameva vivakṣitam | vikāragrastadoṣāṇāṃ yāvaddhātusaṃcāritvaṃ yatra pratīyate tāvaddhātugataroganivṛttyarthaṃ anekadravyāṇāṃ yogyayogakaraṇaṃ vidhiriti tatra vidhīyate | tannivartakayāvaddravyeṇa rasavaddravyādanaṃ vivakṣitam |

original: tannivartakadravyamātrasya tannivartakatvāvacchedakatvamiti tayorvyāptigrahaṇānantaraṃ samarthapravṛ tterapi niścitatvāt | tatsārajā rasāḥ sakalāmayanivartakā iti sūtrārthassamyakpratipādita ityarthaḥ |

original: ayaṃ kapharogayuktaḥ pavanavikāraḥ dvandvayuktapavanavikārakaphajñāpakagatiṃ karoti | tadā viṣamarasādanajātasaṃskāraguṇaviśeṣapavanadoṣa eva anekadhātumārgagatikārakaśaktyā bhavati | tattaddhātupoṣaṇaṃ ca karotītyarthaḥ |

original: nanu pittaprakoparasavaddravyādanena pittaprakopakārakaguṇān gacchati | sa eva pittapavanaprakopagatyā jñātavyaḥ | evaṃ kaphaprakopakārakarasavirasadravyādanena kaphaprakopaguṇānvidhatte | tadā kaphaprakopadvandvagatiriti vyavahriyate | evamayaṃ tridoṣaroga iti evamākārajñānena vyavahartuṃ śakyate |

original: evaṃ tattadrogāṇāṃ bahūni nivartakāni | doṣā ajīrṇena prakupitāssantaḥ yāvatkālaṃ dhātukṣobhaṃ kurvanti | tatrāyaṃ laṅghanakaraṇavidhiḥ |

original: ajīrṇajanyasaṃskāre dhātuśoṣaikakārye vikāre dṛṣṭe sati tattajjvaro jāyate | tatra āmadoṣapacanarasya niyāmakatvāt | tadajīrṇajanyamantassthitaṃ sat tadvirasasarvarasāntaraṃ bhajati | tatsaṃskārajanyadoṣaḥ doṣāntaraṃ bhajati |
analyzed: ajīrṇa janya saṃskāre dhātu śoṣa eka kārye vikāre dṛṣṭe sati tad tad jvaraḥ jāyate tatra āma doṣa pacanarasya niyāmaka tvāt tat ajīrṇa janyam antar sthitam sat tad virasa sarva rasa antaram bhajati tad saṃskāra janya doṣaḥ doṣa antaram bhajati

original: sa doṣaḥ dhātumārgaṃ gatvā dhātukṣobhakāryakaraṇaṃ karotīti yattasya svahastatale virasagandhajñānabhedaṃ yadādāvupalabhate tadaiva tattaddoṣāvirbhāvakāryasya tattatprāgabhāvajñānābhāvajñānavicchedanaparyantaṃ doṣaprakopajanyarogāntarakāryasya hetubhūtatvāt tādṛśajvarasya nidānaṃ svahastatale tattadgandhajñānameva niyāmakaṃ labhyate |
analyzed: sa doṣaḥ dhātu mārgam gatvā dhātu kṣobha kārya karaṇam karoti iti yat tasya sva hasta tale virasa gandha jñāna bhedam yad ādau upalabhate tadā eva tad tad doṣa āvirbhāva kāryasya tad tad prāgabhāva jñāna abhāva jñāna vicchedana paryantam doṣa prakopa janya roga antara kāryasya hetu bhūta tvāt tādṛśa jvarasya nidānam sva hasta tale tad tad gandha jñānam eva niyāmakam labhyate
tāvat paryantam laṅghana karaṇam bheṣajam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: dhātupoṣakapuruṣārthopakārakakarmaṇi taddoṣapacanārthaṃ laṅghanakarmakaraṇasya doṣasya balahīnakāryakarmaṇassamarthanaikasvabhāvatvāt | kāraṇabalādhikyakārye kartavye sati taddhetubalahīnakāryakarmakaraṇasya tathātvāt | dhātupoṣakapuruṣārthopakārakakarmaṇi taddoṣapacanārthaṃ laṅghanakarmakaraṇasya tathātvāt |

original: iti vārtikavacanānusāreṇa jñātavyam | rasavirasavaddravyādane jāte sati keṣāṃcidvyādhayassabhavanti | iti sarvatra niyamena vaktumaśakyatvāt "sarvaṃ balavataḥ pathyaṃ" iti nyāyavacanānusāreṇa balavadviṣaye rasājīrṇavirasādhikaviruddharase jāte satyapi tatra rogo na dṛṣṭaḥ | laukikasāmagrīmātrameva kvacinna kāraṇam |

original: āmādyātmakakāryāṇāṃ saṃbhāvitatvāt prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ balitvāt sarvatrāpi rasājīrṇajanyarogāssambhavāntītyetatpratipādanaṃ vyarthaṃ syāditi | tena yatra rogotpādakāmavṛddhirbhavati tatra tādṛgrogakāryamāvirbhavati | tathāhi--rasājīrṇavirasadhikaviruddharasajakāryavaicitryāt tattadrogajanakakāraṇavaicitryaṃ punarvaktuṃ śakyate |
analyzed: āma ādi ātmaka kāryāṇām saṃbhāvita tvāt prārabdha karmaṇām bali tvāt sarvatra api rasa ajīrṇa janya rogāḥ sambhavānti iti etat pratipādanam vyartham syāt iti tena yatra roga utpāda kāma vṛddhiḥ bhavati tatra tādṛś roga kāryam āvirbhavati tathā ahi rasa ajīrṇa virasa dhika viruddha rasa ja kārya vaicitryāt tad tad roga janaka kāraṇa vaicitryam punar vaktum śakyate

original: yāvadajīrṇajanyāmayasya laṅghanameva nivartakaṃ roganivartakasāmagryatiriktasāmagrīnivartyatvāt, laṅghanādisāmagrīkāryaṃ vinā anirvartyatvācca | tasmādvirasadravyādanasāmagrī yādṛśī bhavati tadrogakāryavaicitryaṃ tādṛśaṃ saṃbhavati | tathāhi-- sarve rogāssaṃjātāssvajanakādhikyavaśāttrayodaśarūpajvarāssannipātavikārāssaṃbhavanti |
analyzed: yāvat ajīrṇa janya āmayasya laṅghanam eva nivartakam roga nivartaka sāmagrī atirikta sāmagrī nivartya tvāt laṅghana ādi sāmagrī kāryam vinā anirvartya tvāt ca tasmāt virasa dravya adana sāmagrī yādṛśī bhavati tad roga kārya vaicitryam tādṛśam saṃbhavati tathā hi sarve rogāḥ saṃjātāḥ sva janaka ādhikya vaśāt trayodaśa rūpa jvarāḥ sannipāta vikārāḥ saṃbhavanti

original: svādurasavirasatvajātayāvatkāryaṃ śiraḥkamalasthāmṛtaṃ sarvasirāndhrabhāgamupagamya virasaviṣamadoṣasaṃparkavaśāt yadā vikāro jāyate tadā āmarasaḥ svādurasajātatāndrikadoṣanāmakarogākṛtijvaraṃ jvalayati | rasājīrṇavirasādhikaviruddharasājīrṇajātatvāt | taddhi svādurasaḥ rasājīrṇarogaḥ tāndrikadoṣaḥ |

original: sa tadadhīnarasavirasaḥ saṃgrahajātarogatvāt pavanagativaśāt āmavirasasaṃgrahasaṃsargājjāyate | tatra amṛtasaṃparkaḥ poṣako bhavati |
analyzed: sa tad adhīna rasa virasaḥ saṃgraha jāta roga tvāt pavana gati vaśāt āma virasa saṃgraha saṃsargāt jāyate tatra amṛta saṃparkaḥ poṣakaḥ bhavati

original: ayamāntaradoṣaḥ jānupadmagatevarṇabodhakapṛṣṭhapārśvagatanābhipradeśasthevarṇopadhacavargavarṇapañcakātmakapadārthāvabodhaka varṇasamūhapadakadambakavākye cavargocitavarṇetarebhyo bhinnaghoṣātmakavākyaṃ śrāvayati | tadvarṇabhedamavaśyaṃ vijñāya tadā tadvirasārthajanyāmapittasaṃsparśāt tatsirāmārgagatāmṛtaṃ tatpadmādhiṣṭhitadhātuśoṣaṇaṃ karoti |

viruddha āma viśiṣṭa sāma jvaram jaṅghā padma nābhi āvṛta padma romarāji pārśva padma hṛdaya padmāni jaṅghā padma stha varṇa prayukta kavarga pañcaka jñāpaka uvarṇa epadha ga varṇa ātmaka pada samūha vākya janya jñānam

original: jaṅghāpadmāvalambakaviṃśatisirāvabodhakanābhyāvṛtapadmāvalambakatriṃśatsirāvabodhakaromarājipārśvādhārakadvidvisirāvṛtavarṇabodhakahṛdayapadmasthāvalambakacatustriṃśatsirāvṛtavarṇabodhakasakalasirāsaṃsparśavaśāt vedanāsahitarūkṣopasamarthaṃ dahyate | nābhyāvṛtacakrapadmasya vṛttāvṛtapradeśatvāt | tatra jvaraḥ jvalayati |
analyzed: jaṅghā padma avalambaka viṃśati sirā avabodhaka nābhi āvṛta padma avalambaka triṃśat sirā avabodhaka romarāji pārśva ādhāraka dvi dvi sirā āvṛta varṇa bodhaka hṛdaya padma stha avalambaka catustriṃśat sirā āvṛta varṇa bodhaka sakala sirā saṃsparśa vaśāt vedanā sahita rūkṣa upasamartham dahyate nābhi āvṛta cakra padmasya vṛtta āvṛta pradeśa tvāt tatra jvaraḥ jvalayati

original: kukṣau ca tadvadeva pratibhāti | hṛdayapadmamapi jvalayati | dāhaṃ karoti | bhramo'pi bhavati | tasmādetallakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt sa rogī jīvati | ayaṃ sāmajvaraḥ pittadoṣaprakopajanyaḥ, pittadoṣaprakopakāryakatvāt | tattatpadmāvalambakasirārandhragatāmṛtasya rasājīrṇavirasādhikaviruddharasajadoṣādhikyasaṃsparśavaśāt jaṅghāpadmapradeśaṃ jvalayati |
analyzed: kukṣau ca tadvat eva pratibhāti hṛdaya padmam api jvalayati dāham karoti bhramaḥ api bhavati tasmāt etad lakṣaṇa lakṣita tvāt sa rogī jīvati ayam sāma jvaraḥ pitta doṣa prakopa janyaḥ pitta doṣa prakopa kāryaka tvāt tad tad padma avalambaka sirā randhra gata amṛtasya rasa ajīrṇa virasa adhika viruddha rasa ja doṣa ādhikya saṃsparśa vaśāt jaṅghā padma pradeśam jvalayati

original: nābhyāvṛtapadmapradeśaśca tadvadeva dahyate | hṛdayapadmapradeśe ca tathaiva duḥkhaṃ karoti | tatpadmagatavarṇavikārajñāpakapadārthātmakaviṣamarasasaṃskāravyāptavarṇāmṛtapoṣakadravyatvāddāhaṃ karoti | mūrcchāmāpādayati | sa eva doṣajvaraḥ vibhramadoṣa iti vyavahriyate |
analyzed: nābhi āvṛta padma pradeśaḥ ca tadvat eva dahyate hṛdaya padma pradeśe ca tathā eva duḥkham karoti tad padma gata varṇa vikāra jñāpaka padārtha ātmaka viṣama rasa saṃskāra vyāpta varṇa amṛta poṣaka dravya tvāt dāham karoti mūrcchām āpādayati saḥ eva doṣa jvaraḥ vibhrama doṣaḥ iti vyavahriyate

original: ṛvarṇajanakamūrupadmaṃ ca tavargapañcakapañcāśatsirāvṛtastanadvayapadmaṃ ca triṃśatsirāvṛtakaṇṭhadeśapadmaṃ ca ṣoḍaśasirāvṛtagrīvāntassthitapadmaṃ ca pavanagatidhārakasirārandhramārgaṃ rasājīrṇavirasādhikaviruddharasajadoṣādhikyasirāsaṃsparśavaśāt jātadoṣaḥ sirāṅgadoṣayuktassāmajvaraḥ pañcadaśadivasaparyantaṃ dhātumārgeṣu saṃcaran
analyzed: ṛvarṇa janakam ūru padmam ca tavarga pañcaka pañcāśat sirā āvṛta stana dvaya padmam ca triṃśat sirā āvṛta kaṇṭha deśa padmam ca ṣoḍaśa sirā āvṛta grīvā antar sthita padmam ca pavana gati dhāraka sirā randhra mārgam rasa ajīrṇa virasa adhika viruddha rasa ja doṣa ādhikya sirā saṃsparśa vaśāt jāta doṣaḥ sirā aṅga doṣa yuktaḥ sāma jvaraḥ pañcadaśa divasa paryantam dhātu mārgeṣu saṃcaran

original: tatpradeśasthitapadmapratāpakāmayatvāt sadoṣasirāgatasarvāṅgagatajvaranivṛttyā rasadhāturasājīrṇavirasasaṃsparśavaśāt sa rasaḥ dhātuvikāro bhūtvā śītāṅgaṃ karoti | ṛ ṣavarṇajanakaśroṇipradeśapadmaṃ triṃśatsirāvṛtaṃ paphavarṇabodhakaṣoḍaśasirāvṛtapadmaṃ ca babhavarṇāvalambakapañcāśatsirāvṛtapadmaṃ ca varṇodvacanapralāpanakaram |

original: nanu yāvaddoṣaprakopahetukavirasadravyājīrṇajanyajvarāḥ tattaddoṣanivartakāḥ, doṣaprakopajanakasvādurasavirasadravyajātājīrṇajanyajvarāḥ tattaddoṣanivartakāḥ doṣaprakopajanakasvādurasavirasadravyajātājīrṇajanyatvāt | ajīrṇajanyavirasarasāḥ jvaropadravakāryaṃ kurvanti, tadupadravaviśiṣṭajvaranimittakadravyatvāt |

original: tattajjvarotpādakāmarasavirasasāmagrīkāryaṃ jvarotpādakakāryamātraṃ saptadhātūnviśoṣya prāṇānvimocayati iti yaduktaṃ taccintyam | āmo jvaramātrotpādakasāmagrī jvaraṃ janayitvā svayaṃ tatkṣaṇajanyasaṃskāraṃ tattatkārye vidhāya svarūpānna dṛśyate | teṣu poptadasāmagrījanyeṣuvat sarvajyarāṇāmajīrṇajanyatvāt |

jvara utpādaka sāmagrī mātra janya jvaraḥ prāṇān vimocayati iti yat tat tathā ced atiprasaṃgaḥ syāt iti asvarasāt āha evam iti
