original: evamuktarītyā tadupadravarogāśca prāṇaghātakāḥ | tadvirasajanyadoṣānusaritajvarahetukaprāṇāpakārakadravyatvāt | viṣādanajātarogavaccharīravat | varṇapadhagapadmānusārikavargapañcakajñāpakapadmādhārakasirāḥ dhātuśoṣakapoṣakāḥ | tadādhārakarasavadāśritaśarīra tvāt |
analyzed: evam ukta rītyā tad upadrava rogāḥ ca prāṇa ghātakāḥ tad virasa janya doṣa anusarita jvara hetuka prāṇa apakāraka dravya tvāt viṣādana jāta roga vat śarīra vat varṇa padhaga padma anusārika varga pañcaka jñāpaka padma ādhāraka sirāḥ dhātu śoṣaka poṣakāḥ tad ādhāraka rasa vat āśrita śarīra tvāt

original: tadvirasānusaritasaṃskārodbodhakasaṃsargasirādhigatadoṣagativikārakāryakārakopayogirasadhātutvāt | adhautadhātuṃ saṃprāpya pavanavikārakārakagatiḥ tadanyavikārakārakatvāt śvāsaṃ ca mūrchāṃ ca (karoti) | tadubhayorapi rasadhātujatvena dṛśyatvāt | evaṃ rasadhātuṃ saṃśoṣya anyadhātuśoṣaṃ kartuṃ sa eva jvaraḥ taddhātuṃ saṃprāpyojjṛmbhate |
analyzed: tad virasa anusarita saṃskāra udbodhaka saṃsarga sirā adhigata doṣa gati vikāra kārya kāraka upayogi rasa dhātu tvāt adhauta dhātum saṃprāpya pavana vikāra kāraka gatiḥ tad anya vikāra kāraka tvāt śvāsam ca mūrchām ca karoti tad ubhayoḥ api rasa dhātu ja tvena dṛśya tvāt evam rasa dhātum saṃśoṣya anya dhātu śoṣam kartum saḥ eva jvaraḥ tad dhātum saṃprāpya ujjṛmbhate

original: bhramacchardī bhavataḥ | evaṃ māṃsadhātuṃ saṃprāpya hikkādiśokau bhavataḥ | evamevānyadhātuṃ saṃprāpya bhramahikkārogau jāyete | sa eva jvaraḥ kāsamanvahaṃ janayan vartate | asthi saṃprāpya śophaṃ karoti | sa eva jvaraḥ vātapittakaphānusaritassanmajjādhātumavalambya vijṛmbhate | tadā sa daśavidharogākāro bhavati |
analyzed: bhrama chardī bhavataḥ evam māṃsa dhātum saṃprāpya hikkā ādi śokau bhavataḥ evam eva anya dhātum saṃprāpya bhrama hikkā rogau jāyete saḥ eva jvaraḥ kāsam anvaham janayan vartate asthi saṃprāpya śopham karoti saḥ eva jvaraḥ vāta pitta kapha anusaritaḥ san majjā dhātum avalambya vijṛmbhate tadā sa daśavidha roga ākāraḥ bhavati
evam anya doṣa jāḥ ca iti sūtra vyākhyānam kṛtam

original: nanu rasavirasajanyavirasādhikaviruddharasadoṣāḥ sarvarogahetukāḥ | ajīrṇaguṇāvirbhāvajñānābhāvajanyavirasajanyadoṣavikārābhāvajñāpakaśuddharasajñānadoṣāḥ vikārābhāvakāryakārakāḥ | evaṃ doṣāḥ sarvarogahetukāḥ |
analyzed: nanu rasa virasa janya virasa adhika viruddha rasa doṣāḥ sarva roga hetukāḥ ajīrṇa guṇa āvirbhāva jñāna abhāva janya virasa janya doṣa vikāra abhāva jñāpaka śuddha rasa jñāna doṣāḥ vikāra abhāva kārya kārakāḥ evam doṣāḥ sarva roga hetukāḥ

original: evaṃ doṣāḥ duṣṭāssantastrayo'pi vikārakārakā bhaveyuḥ doṣadhātvātmaśarīriṇaḥ | sukarmaparipākavaśāt doṣā aduṣṭāssantaḥ vikārapratibandhakā bhaveyuḥ | sarve rogāḥ virasajātā iti yatpratipāditaṃ tanna, kṣodakṣamamityasvarasādāha--adoṣā iti |
analyzed: evam doṣāḥ duṣṭāḥ santaḥ trayaḥ api vikāra kārakāḥ bhaveyuḥ doṣa dhātu ātma śarīriṇaḥ su karma paripāka vaśāt doṣāḥ aduṣṭāḥ santaḥ vikāra pratibandhakāḥ bhaveyuḥ sarve rogāḥ virasa jātāḥ iti yat pratipāditam tat na kṣoda kṣamam iti asvarasāt āha adoṣāḥ iti
adoṣāḥ sa doṣāḥ sama doṣāḥ sa rujāḥ rujaḥ

original: prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānāḥ pañca vāyavaḥ śarīrakāryopakārakāḥ | śarīrādhārakasya adoṣatvaṃ kathaṃ samyaktayā bhāsate ? pittasyāpi doṣatvādeva sadoṣapañcarūpopapannaṃ saṃgṛhṇāti pacati, vide śayati, muñcati--ityeteṣāṃ pañcavidhakarmaṇāṃ śarīrādhārakatvācca kaphadoṣasyāpi śarīradārḍhyakārakatvāt doṣatrayaṃ śarīraṃ rakṣati |
analyzed: prāṇa apāna vyāna udāna samānāḥ pañca vāyavaḥ śarīra kārya upakārakāḥ śarīra ādhārakasya adoṣa tvam katham samyaktayā bhāsate pittasya api doṣa tvāt eva sa doṣa pañcarūpa upapannam saṃgṛhṇāti pacati vide śayati muñcati iti eteṣām pañcavidha karmaṇām śarīra ādhāraka tvāt ca kapha doṣasya api śarīra dārḍhya kāraka tvāt doṣa trayam śarīram rakṣati
tasmāt adoṣatvam katham śarīra upakārakam iti na āśaṅkanīyam

original: doṣāṇāṃ vikārakārakatvābhāvaḥ adoṣaśabdārthaḥ | sadoṣāḥ vikārakāryāpādakagatiguṇaviśiṣṭadoṣāḥ | sadoṣāssaptadhātuśoṣakārakāḥ | tasmāccharīrasya sadoṣatvaṃ duṣkarmānubhavavaśāllabhyate | tena dhātavaḥ pīḍyante | duḥkhaṃ cānubhūyate | samadoṣatvaṃ nāma tadubhayābhāvagativiśiṣṭadoṣāpravivardhakatvam | tena dhātavaḥ puṣṇanti | nīrogatvaṃ prāpnuvanti |
analyzed: doṣāṇām vikāra kāraka tva abhāvaḥ adoṣa śabda arthaḥ sa doṣāḥ vikāra kārya āpādaka gati guṇa viśiṣṭa doṣāḥ sa doṣāḥ sapta dhātu śoṣa kārakāḥ tasmāt śarīrasya sa doṣa tvam duṣkarma anubhava vaśāt labhyate tena dhātavaḥ pīḍyante duḥkham ca anubhūyate sama doṣa tvam nāma tad ubhaya abhāva gati viśiṣṭa doṣa a pravivardhaka tvam tena dhātavaḥ puṣṇanti nīroga tvam prāpnuvanti

original: tasmātsamadoṣaṃ yathā bhavati tathā śarīraṃ saraṃkṣaṇīyamityarthaḥ | sarvadā śarīrasthadoṣāṇāṃ ekarasahetubhūtakāryasya kiṃcinnimittaṃ vaktavyam | tadetadrasajanyavirasapariṇāmajātarogakāryamevamiti jñātavyam ||
analyzed: tasmāt sama doṣam yathā bhavati tathā śarīram saraṃkṣaṇīyam iti arthaḥ sarvadā śarīra stha doṣāṇām eka rasa hetu bhūta kāryasya kiṃcid nimittam vaktavyam tat etat rasa janya virasa pariṇāma jāta roga kāryam evam iti jñātavyam

original: nanu viṣamagativiśiṣṭo yo doṣaḥ tasya vaiṣamye rogaḥ | doṣasya samā gatirārogyamiti vyapadeśaḥ kṛtaḥ | tathā sati ṣaḍrasāḥ saptadhātvātmakāḥ | virasaṣaṭkasyādanaṃ dhātuśoṣakam, tadrasātmakadoṣadhātuvirasadravyatvāt ityanumānena dhātuśoṣakakāryasya rasādihetutvam | tasmāddoṣavaiṣamyaṃ rogaḥ | doṣasāmyamaroga iti |
analyzed: nanu viṣama gati viśiṣṭaḥ yaḥ doṣaḥ tasya vaiṣamye rogaḥ doṣasya samā gatiḥ ārogyam iti vyapadeśaḥ kṛtaḥ tathā sati ṣaṣ rasāḥ sapta dhātu ātmakāḥ virasa ṣaṭkasya adanam dhātu śoṣakam tad rasa ātmaka doṣa dhātu virasa dravya tvāt iti anumānena dhātu śoṣaka kāryasya rasa ādi hetu tvam tasmāt doṣa vaiṣamyam rogaḥ doṣa sāmyam arogaḥ iti
yat pratipāditam tat viruddham iti atas āha tasmāt iti
te trayaḥ doṣa hetu bhūtāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ iti

original: saptadhātava iti vyapadeśamātraṃ bhavati | ṣaḍrasā eva niścitam | teṣāṃ saptasaṃkhyākatvaṃ kathaṃ syāditi na vaktavyam | rasa evāsṛk iti tayoḥ pārthakyābhāvavivakṣayā satyaṃ ṣaḍrasāssaptadhātava iti vyavahartuṃ śakyate | tathāhi--
analyzed: sapta dhātavaḥ iti vyapadeśa mātram bhavati ṣaṣ rasāḥ eva niścitam teṣām sapta saṃkhyāka tvam katham syāt iti na vaktavyam rasaḥ eva asṛk iti tayoḥ pārthakya abhāva vivakṣayā satyam ṣaṣ rasāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ iti vyavahartum śakyate tathā hi

original: svādurasavaddravyatvaguṇavat rasadravyamityanubhūyate udbhūtarasavyatiriktarasavaddravyābhāvāt | tasmādrasādayo guṇā guṇinamantareṇa guṇā nāvatiṣṭhanta iti dravyamāvaśyakam, dravyāśrayā guṇā iti | saptadhātukaśarīradravyatvāt rasādīnāṃ guṇatvāt guṇaguṇinorbhedasya avasitatvāt rasādayo dravyāśrayā bhavanti |
analyzed: svādu rasavat dravya tva guṇavat rasa dravyam iti anubhūyate udbhūta rasa vyatirikta rasavat dravya abhāvāt tasmāt rasa ādayaḥ guṇāḥ guṇinam antareṇa guṇāḥ na avatiṣṭhante iti dravyam āvaśyakam dravya āśrayāḥ guṇāḥ iti sapta dhātuka śarīra dravya tvāt rasa ādīnām guṇa tvāt guṇa guṇinoḥ bhedasya avasita tvāt rasa ādayaḥ dravya āśrayāḥ bhavanti

original: tasmātsaptadhāttvātmakaṣṣaḍrasavyatirikta iti na vācyam, dravyarasātmakatvāt | śarīrāntassthitarasāḥ dhāturūpeṇa pariṇamanti | tāvaddhātūnāṃ dravyaniṣṭhatvāt dhātūnāṃ dravyaguṇatvāt rūpādivat bhedo na dṛśyate | rasavaddravyaṃ rasanendriyaviṣayakam | rūpavaddravyaṃ cakṣurindriyaviṣayakam |
analyzed: tasmāt sapta dhāttva ātmakaḥ ṣaṣ rasa vyatiriktaḥ iti na vācyam dravya rasa ātmaka tvāt śarīra antar sthita rasāḥ dhātu rūpeṇa pariṇamanti tāvat dhātūnām dravya niṣṭha tvāt dhātūnām dravya guṇa tvāt rūpa ādi vat bhedaḥ na dṛśyate rasavat dravyam rasanā indriya viṣayakam rūpavat dravyam cakṣuḥ indriya viṣayakam

original: rasadravyaṃ rūparasavaddravyaṃ sādṛśyāt ! ṣaḍrasavikāra eva dhāturiti rasasapta ... nendriyeṇa gṛhyate | tatsajātīyaṃ saptadhātusajātīyaraseṣu labhyate | te'ntassthitāssantaḥ dhātumeva puṣṇanti | tadyathā– ikṣukāṇḍasthitasvādurasaḥ yatrayatra bhedavaśāt vartate tanniṣṭhasvādurasaṃ saṃgṛhya tatsaṃsargajātidravyaṃ vibhajan rasaṃ karoti |
analyzed: rasa dravyam rūpa rasavat dravyam sādṛśyāt ṣaṣ rasa vikāraḥ eva dhātuḥ iti rasa sapta na indriyeṇa gṛhyate tat sajātīyam sapta dhātu sajātīya raseṣu labhyate tena tassthitāḥ santaḥ dhātum eva puṣṇanti tat yathā ikṣu kāṇḍa sthita svādu rasaḥ yatra yatra bheda vaśāt vartate tad niṣṭha svādu rasam saṃgṛhya tad saṃsarga jāti dravyam vibhajan rasam karoti

original: tadanantaraṃ tatsvādurasaṃ vihāya tatsaṃyogidravyaṃ pṛthaktayā tadbhaktatayā bhajate rūpādivat | asigābhavanaṃ budrābhāvāt ?| nīlo ghaṭa iti ghaṭaniṣṭhanīlarūpaṃ vihāya anyadravyāvayavatayā sa bhāsate | atra rasavyatiriktadravyasyābhāvāt tadvat eṣu ca dhātutvapṛthagākārakatattadguṇaviśiṣṭatayā cakṣuḥpratītiḥ jāyate |
analyzed: tad anantaram tad svādu rasam vihāya tad saṃyogi dravyam pṛthaktayā tad bhakta tayā bhajate rūpa ādi vat budra abhāvāt nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti ghaṭa niṣṭha nīla rūpam vihāya anya dravya avayavatayā sa bhāsate atra rasa vyatirikta dravyasya abhāvāt tadvat eṣu ca dhātu tva pṛthak ākāraka tad tad guṇa viśiṣṭa tayā cakṣuḥ pratītiḥ jāyate

original: tadvat lavaṇoṣaṇakaṣāyā ityāhvayante, āśrayādivat | śarīrāṅgasthitāni bhavanti | tena rasādaya ityāhūyante | na vācyam, śarīraṃ saptadhātvātmakam | dhātavaśca rasātmakāḥ śarīraṃ rasātmakadravyaṃ saptadhātvāvṛtatvāt | tadarthaṃ pṛthubudhnodarākāratvaikabhāsaṃ tat | svādurasaśśukraśleṣmarūpavattvena pariṇamati | āmlarasaḥ majjārūpākṛtiḥ pariṇamati |
analyzed: tadvat lavaṇa ūṣaṇa kaṣāyāḥ iti āhvayante āśraya ādi vat śarīra aṅga sthitāni bhavanti tena rasa ādayaḥ iti āhūyante na vācyam śarīram sapta dhātu ātmakam dhātavaḥ ca rasa ātmakāḥ śarīram rasa ātmaka dravyam sapta dhātu āvṛta tvāt tad artham pṛthu budhna udara ākāra tva eka bhāsam tat svādu rasaḥ śukra śleṣma rūpavat tvena pariṇamati āmla rasaḥ majjā rūpa ākṛtiḥ pariṇamati

original: lavaṇarasaḥ asthirūpākṛtiḥ pariṇamati | tiktarasaḥ medovikārākṛtissan pariṇamati | ūṣaṇarasaḥ majjādhātvākāratvena pariṇamati | kaṣāyarasaḥ rasāsṛgdhātvākṛtissan bhāsate | tasmātpṛthaktayā abhidheyatve'pi āśrayādivat rasādivyañjakaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate | bahiḥpradeśasthitāḥ śarīrāntaḥ praviṣṭāssantaḥ tattatsajātīyadhātuṣu vilīyante tattadrasāḥ |
analyzed: lavaṇa rasaḥ asthi rūpa ākṛtiḥ pariṇamati tikta rasaḥ medaḥ vikāra ākṛtiḥ san pariṇamati ūṣaṇa rasaḥ majjā dhātu ākāra tvena pariṇamati kaṣāya rasaḥ rasa asṛj dhātu ākṛtiḥ san bhāsate tasmāt pṛthaktayā abhidheya tve pi āśraya ādi vat rasa ādi vyañjakam vaktum na śakyate bahis pradeśa sthitāḥ śarīra antar praviṣṭāḥ santaḥ tad tad sajātīya dhātuṣu vilīyante tad tad rasāḥ

original: tattaddhātūnāṃ poṣaṇaṃ ca kurvanti | saṃśayaṃ vinā śuddhaguṇaviśiṣṭabahurasavaddravyaṃ śarīradārḍhyakaraṇaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat tat dhātūnām poṣaṇam ca kurvanti saṃśayam vinā śuddha guṇa viśiṣṭa bahu rasavat dravyam śarīra dārḍhya karaṇam bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: nanu rasavaddravyādanena prakupitapavanadravyasya rasāsṛgdhātuśoṣaṃ kartumicchataḥ pavanabhūtasya prakopanivartakaṃ kaṣāyarasavadekaṃ bhavati | kaṣāyarasasya rasāsṛgdhātūnāṃ pavanaprakopanivartakatvaṃ vaktumayogyamiti pūrvasūtravyākhyānaṃ na kṣodakṣamamityasvarasādāha--seti |
analyzed: nanu rasavat dravya adanena prakupita pavana dravyasya rasa asṛj dhātu śoṣam kartum icchataḥ pavana bhūtasya prakopa nivartakam kaṣāya rasa vat ekam bhavati kaṣāya rasasya rasa asṛj dhātūnām pavana prakopa nivartaka tvam vaktum ayogyam iti pūrva sūtra vyākhyānam na kṣoda kṣamam iti asvarasāt āha sa iti

original: asyārthaḥ dravyasaṃyogaviśiṣṭajanyakaṣāyatvasajātīyarasā na dhātuvikārakārakapratibandhakā iti vaktuṃ śakyate, tatsajātīyavirodhipratibandhakadravyatvāt | tadrasāsṛgdhātupravartakoṣṇasvabhāvaguṇavattvaṃ laghutvasvabhāvaguṇavattvaṃ bhajat rasāsṛgdhātuśoṣaṇaṃ karoti |
analyzed: asya arthaḥ dravya saṃyoga viśiṣṭa janya kaṣāya tva sajātīya rasāḥ na dhātu vikāra kāraka pratibandhakāḥ iti vaktum śakyate tad sajātīya virodhi pratibandhaka dravya tvāt tad rasa asṛj dhātu pravartaka uṣṇa svabhāva guṇavat tvam laghu tva svabhāva guṇavat tvam bhajat rasa asṛj dhātu śoṣaṇam karoti

original: ataḥ bahiḥpradeśasthitapavanadravyādane tatsaṃjātaviśiṣṭarasaguṇaviśiṣṭassan dhātuśoṣaṇaṃ karoti | tatsarvametadvākyena pratīyate | na pūrvasūtravirodhaśca | tatra śrutireva pramāṇam |
analyzed: atas bahis pradeśa sthita pavana dravya adane tad saṃjāta viśiṣṭa rasa guṇa viśiṣṭaḥ san dhātu śoṣaṇam karoti tat sarvam etad vākyena pratīyate na pūrva sūtra virodhaḥ ca tatra śrutiḥ eva pramāṇam

original: ṣaḍrasāssaptadhātujanakāḥ rasavyāptatvāt | rasānāṃ dhātūnāṃ ca upavyañjakatvabhāvasaṃbandhāt | rasāsṛgdhātujātarasaprakārajatvena bhedasyāpratīyamānatvāt | āmlaśarīrā eva dhātava ityevaṃ ta ttaddhātubhedena tattaccharīrabhedāt rasabhedajanyasya tadadhīnajñānajanyatvāt |
analyzed: ṣaṭ rasāḥ sapta dhātu janakāḥ rasa vyāpta tvāt rasānām dhātūnām ca upavyañjaka tva bhāva saṃbandhāt rasa asṛj dhātu jāta rasa prakāra ja tvena bhedasya apratīyamāna tvāt āmla śarīrāḥ eva dhātavaḥ iti evam tat tad dhātu bhedena tad tad śarīra bhedāt rasa bheda janyasya tad adhīna jñāna janya tvāt

analyzed: iti anunayet sakala varṇa udbodhaka sirā ādhāra cakra madhye adṛṣṭa tvāt sahasra sirā dhāraka ṣaṭkoṇa cakrasya amṛta upajanya tvāt etāvat paryantam varṇa bodhaka sirāṇām eva tad poṣaka tvam na anyeṣām iti dhātu madhye ntargata tvāt sattvena tad tad varṇa bodhaka padmānām sahasra sirā dhāraka tvāt teṣām amṛta sirā saṃsargāt

analyzed: iḍā piṅgala pūrita anila ātmaka ṣaṭkoṇa cakra bodhaka kumbhaka anila pūraṇa kārya hetukaḥ saḥ iḍā piṅgala pūrita anila śiraḥ kamalāt amṛtam āvṛtya tāvat sirāḥ saṃpūrya ṣaṭkoṇa anila cakrasya unmīlina dravya tvāt anala anila dravyayoḥ saha saṃcārayoḥ dravya piṅgala pūrita anila anala prajvalana kāryasya vyañjana anila tvāt tasmāt pavana pūraṇa cakra pratibhāsa hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nanu recakapūrakakumbhakānilena udarakumbhamāpūrya amṛtaṃ siñcatīti yat taccintyam, ṣaṭkoṇacakrasya kuṇḍalyadhassthitatvāt | kuṇḍalyuparigatapadmānāmeva tatpūraṇakāryakaraṇapratipādanāt | kuṇḍalīḍāpiṅgalapavanena amṛtasecanakavarṇassyādityasvarasādāha-- pṛṣṭheti |
